chapters.title: Chapter 751 - 423: The Formidable Power of a Top Demigod
paragraphs: The space within a radius of ten thousand miles was instantly shattered by that demonic claw.
And with the appearance of that demonic claw, a monstrous Power of the Demon overflowed.
It almost spread to the vicinity of the Holy Land.
With the explosion of the Elf King’s Holy Light, the spread of the Power of the Demon was successfully halted.
At the same time, everyone heard a deep and evil voice.
"Holy Spirit Realm, World Tree..."
"Unbelievably, the location has actually been marked by that Demon God!"
"Very well, the next step is to destroy the World Tree, allowing the Abyss Realm to fully descend upon the Holy Spirit Realm!"
The next moment.
A humanoid creature with two horns and muscles bulging explosively all over its body appeared!
It had four arms, two bovine hooves, and everyone felt a strong sense of oppression from it!
High-tier Demigod!
This was actually a Great Demon Monarch with high-tier demigod strength!
Although it was slightly weaker than the Elf King, it was still an extremely terrifying power.
At this moment.
The demon stretched out its right hand, a black-red energy ball gathering in its palm.
The energy ball contained a strong aura of destruction, even causing signs of space fracture!
A grim smile appeared on its face, seemingly ready to hurl this energy ball towards the World Tree.
And at this moment.
The figure of the Elf King suddenly appeared in front of it.
Then, a pillar of white light erupted instantly, colliding with the black energy ball.
"Boom!"
After a dull explosive sound.
The sky within a radius of tens of thousands of miles instantly lost its color.
Once the energy fluctuations dissipated, the high-tier demon murmured.
"Elf King, top demigod..."
Before it could finish, the Elf King had already charged forward.
He aimed to slay this high-tier Great Demon Monarch as quickly as possible!
The demon seemed to understand the terror of the Elf King and immediately clenched its four arms tightly, all its muscles taut.
Then, it shouted loudly!
"Blood-Inviting Demon’s Arrival!"
Boom!
The demon instantly used the forbidden technique from the Abyss Realm: Blood-Inviting Demon’s Arrival!
This move could bring it extremely terrifying combat power, but at the cost of burning all its demon blood to death!
A high-tier demigod, no matter in which era, was an extremely terrifying combat power.
But facing the oppression of the Elf King, it didn’t hesitate to sacrifice its life in exchange for powerful strength.
"Boom!"
The two terrifying presences immediately clashed together.
The world changed color, various destructive pillars of light continuously erupted!
Under the state of Blood-Inviting Demon’s Arrival, the demon of high-tier demigod level even gained the strength to contend with the Elf King!
The two beings, nearly divine spirit level, fought to the brink of the Holy Land, even the Holy Light of the World Tree was overshadowed!
And at this moment.
A look of ruthlessness appeared in the eyes of the Great Demon Monarch.
It clasped its four arms together, then a terrifying burst of Abyssal Power exploded!
Even the Elf King was directly forced back thousands of miles!
As the Elf King prepared to charge forward again to engage in a fierce battle with the Great Demon Monarch.
Another black energy ball appeared in its hands, and it hurled it directly at the Golden Tree.
At the same time, a madly triumphant smile appeared in the eyes of the Great Demon Monarch!
"Feel it... This is the main theme of the Abyss Realm!"
The energy ball shot forth instantly, and one could imagine the terrifying destructive power contained in the full-force strike of the top Demigod-level Great Demon Monarch.
If it hit, the already wounded World Tree could potentially suffer another severe blow!
"Damn it!"
The Elf King was furious. He was just about to turn around to block the Dark Energy Ball.
However, the Great Demon Monarch clung onto him, preventing him from breaking free!
"Get away from me!"
The Elf King was enraged, he pushed towards the Great Demon Monarch with a palm containing terrifying white light!
Yet, the Great Demon Monarch withstood the attack, not retreating, but using its four stout arms to lock the Elf King in place!
The Elf King felt both angry and helpless.
Though he was strong, the Great Demon Monarch, in its state of burning demon blood, was almost equally strong.
Moreover, the Elf King had to also protect the World Tree.
Seeing the black energy ball about to strike the World Tree, but there was no one else to stop it!
Elinora gritted her teeth, turning into a radiant multicolored stream, rushing into the sky.
She actually intended to withstand the high-tier demon’s attack head-on!
At this moment, Han Xing’s voice echoed in her ears.
"Divine Maiden, return."
In Elinora’s confused gaze, she suddenly saw a figure holding a shield rushing to her front.
And charged fiercely toward the energy ball!
Facing the strike from a top Demigod level, Shen Yun dared not be careless.
In an instant, he activated all his equipment effects and unleashed the Church Secret Technique, as well as the Legendary Level [Descent of the Great Angels]
Including Su Xiaoyang, who was also using the [Tree of Life] skill at the first moment.
To ensure Shen Yun wouldn’t be killed in one hit.
"Buzz!"
When the energy ball struck the shield.
Shen Yun was blasted tens of thousands of kilometers away!
Then he disappeared into the horizon.
Everyone’s hearts were in their throats.
If they hadn’t seen the system interface, the news of the team member’s death.
They might have even suspected Shen Yun had been killed instantly!
Yet moments later.
Shen Yun’s figure reappeared, with a smile of surviving a near-death experience.
Although the strike of the top demigod was terrifying.
But with the support of so many states, they ultimately managed to withstand it.

chapters.title: Chapter 752 - 423: The Formidable Power of a Top Demigod
paragraphs: Seeing this scene, the Elf King and the team members on the field simultaneously let out a sigh of relief.
"This human... seems to only have the combat strength of a High-tier Legend, right?"
"To withstand the attack of a Top Demigod, it’s truly unbelievable..."
thought the Elf King.
The eyes of the Great Demon Monarch were also full of surprise.
If it had been Elinora taking that hit, she would have been severely injured, if not dead.
Elinora gave everyone a grateful glance.
At the same time, the Elf King once again engaged in combat with that Great Demon Monarch.
At this moment, a large number of Elf Race troops also appeared near the Holy Land.
They immediately rushed to the battlefield, hunting down those solitary Abyssal Monsters.
At this point, Shen Yun also flew back, his face slightly pale.
Cheng Jianyong asked, "Xiaoyunzi, how are you feeling?"
"How is the strength of a Top Demigod?"
Shen Yun forced a smile and said, "Damn, it’s really strong."
"Just that one strike almost shattered all my bones."
"If it weren’t for Little Sister Yang’s Tree of Life, I would’ve been instantly killed by it!"
Hearing this, everyone instantly tensed up.
They now had a clearer understanding of the combat strength of these Top Demigods.
They are truly terrifying. Previously, it was because Han Xing suppressed Hawthorne Glaser with the Territory Defense Tower, so everyone didn’t feel it so strongly.
Now, they understand that a Top Demigod at least has the Attack Power to instantly kill a Middle-tier Demigod.
And just at this moment, the battle over by the Elf King seemed to be nearing its end.
The Demon Monarch’s [Blood-Inviting Demon’s Arrival] state was about to end.
If it continued like this, its only path was to be directly slain by the Elf King.
The Great Demon Monarch seemed to sense its impending doom.
In its final moments of life.
It cast its gaze towards Shen Yun!
It was this Legendary Level ant that blocked its most powerful strike and ruined its plan!
If it could take this ant with it before dying, that would be acceptable.
The next moment, the Great Demon Monarch broke free from the Elf King and charged swiftly towards the crowd.
The team members immediately entered combat state.
Cheng Jianyong asked at this time, "Brother Xing, should we go all out?"
Han Xing nodded, "Don’t let this guy get close. If it really destroys the World Tree, where am I going to claim my reward?"
The team understood.
However, before they could rush into the sky.
A flash of white light intercepted the Great Demon Monarch.
It was the Elf King!
He directly took this High-tier Demigod Level demon to fight in the distance!
The team members were stunned for a moment,
as if to say, we don’t have anything to do now?
They stood in place, waiting for the battle on the Elf King’s side to conclude.
Meanwhile.
With the arrival of all the mighty figures on the Sky Island near the Holy Land.
There was basically no suspense left in the battle.
The Holy Land where the World Tree is located is the most sacred area for the Elf Race.
Even the Royal City is not as important as the Holy Land.
Here, the Elf Race has arranged extraordinarily powerful defensive forces, making it impossible for the Abyss Realm to break through so easily!
However, this also sent a signal to everyone.
The teleportation array of the Abyss Realm can be located.
They seemed to have detected that the Elf Race intended to help restore the World Tree, so they came to prevent it at the first moment.
But now, the power that the Abyss Realm can mobilize is limited.
A Great Demon Monarch capable of bursting with Top Demigod combat strength is already the limit of the Abyss Realm.
Ten minutes later.
The battle ended.
Including that Great Demon Monarch, it was shattered into pieces by the Elf King.
Due to the rules of the Holy Spirit Realm not affecting the Abyss Realm.
The deaths of these Demigod Level demons would not trigger any celestial phenomena.
Meanwhile, the elf maidens beside the World Tree collectively let out a breath of relief.
At this time, the Elf King flew back again.
His clothes were as spotless as before the battle, with not a trace of blood on them.
At this moment, looking at Han Xing and the others, the Elf King apologetically said, "Saint Master Han Xing, I am really sorry."
"Now, let us continue."
Han Xing nodded.
Although there was a small interlude of the Demon Race invasion, he paid it no mind.
Then continued approaching the root of the World Tree.
The resounding song echoed once more.
All the elf maidens gazed at Han Xing with sincere eyes.
This time, there was no surprise.
Han Xing successfully arrived beside the root of the World Tree.
Feeling the vast life force emitted by the World Tree.
At this moment, he seemed as insignificant as a speck of dust under a mountain.
Just as the Elf King said, the World Tree is the Supreme Holy Tree of the Holy Spirit Realm, containing unfathomably terrifying mighty power.
Especially now at a close distance, the sensation was particularly evident.
Han Xing couldn’t help but think.
Just one branch holds such vast Divine Power.
If it were the actual body of the World Tree, how terrifying would it be?
What does its actual body look like?
All of this aroused great curiosity in Han Xing.
However, Han Xing also knew that getting down to business was important now.
So, he directly took out an Ancient Spirit Wood from his backpack and placed it beneath the root of the World Tree.
Under Han Xing’s watchful gaze.
The section of Ancient Spirit Wood, infused with Spiritual Qi and Life Force, seemed to rapidly lose its power.
Within seconds, it turned from a tender white color to gray.
Until it lost all its life force, directly turning into a gray powder, dissipating on the spot...
At the same time, the dense golden canopy of the World Tree began to tremble slightly.
The golden leaves rustled.
The Elf King watched this scene with joy.
Because, he could feel that the World Tree’s life force had indeed increased slightly.
Although it seemed extremely faint compared to the World Tree’s terrifying life force.
However, it was indeed recovering.
Han Xing also watched this scene with some novelty.
Then continued to invest more Ancient Spirit Wood, and the quantity invested at once increased.
A hundred, five hundred, a thousand...

chapters.title: Chapter 753 - 424: The World Tree’s Gift
paragraphs: Han Xing continuously added more Ancient Spirit Wood.
And the World Tree welcomed everything without exception.
No matter how many pieces of Spirit Wood, it could completely absorb them within seconds...
Until the number of sacrificed Ancient Spirit Wood reached five thousand.
The golden light on the World Tree became a bit brighter.
Even the ordinary Elves could feel the changes occurring with the World Tree.
Each one was incredibly excited.
"Oh my god... the World Tree seems to really be recovering!"
"It’s unbelievable!"
"We’ve struggled for hundreds of years to no avail, and yet this Human Race just arrived and the World Tree is already showing signs of improvement!"
The Elf maidens cheered in joy.
However, a different system prompt appeared in Han Xing’s ear.
[Due to your assistance in restoring the World Tree, you have triggered a special reward: the Gift of the World Tree...]
Gift? What’s that?
Before Han Xing could react.
At this moment, Han Xing found himself suddenly enveloped in a sacred glow.
His Life Force and Divine Power Value skyrocketed at a crazed speed once again!
[Due to receiving the Life Blessing from the World Tree, Life Force +20000, Divine Power Value +100...]
[Due to receiving the Life Blessing from the World Tree, Life Force +20000, Divine Power Value +100...]
When the screen-filling system prompts ended.
Han Xing was surprised to find his Life Value had surged by 200,000 again!
And his Divine Power Value directly increased by 1000.
Now, his Divine Power Value had officially broken through 8000!
Han Xing paused in place, not expecting that helping the World Tree recover would bring such benefits.
The next moment, Han Xing, even more excited, invested more Ancient Spirit Wood.
Six thousand, seven thousand, eight thousand...
And he occasionally looked up at the World Tree.
Han Xing was implying: Any more? Can you take some more?
When the number of invested Ancient Spirit Wood reached ten thousand,
Han Xing indeed heard the system prompt again.
[Due to your assistance in restoring the World Tree, you have triggered a reward: the Gift of the World...]
Everyone only saw that Han Xing was once again enveloped in a golden light.
When the golden light ended, Han Xing’s momentum surged by yet another notch!
Even the Elf King was very surprised, looking at the changes in Han Xing.
"Third blessing..."
"In history, only a few of the previous Elf Kings have experienced this, and now it happens to this Saint Master Han Xing."
"It’s simply unbelievable!"
At this moment, even Han Xing couldn’t help but feel very excited.
The recent blessing from the World Tree had further boosted his Life Value by 200,000, and his Divine Power Value broke through 9000!
"My god, if calculated based on each 5000 pieces of Ancient Spirit Wood triggering a blessing,"
"Wouldn’t my Divine Power Value directly reach 26,000 after I finish investing these 130,000 pieces of Ancient Spirit Wood?"
Han Xing was shocked by this number he calculated!
Because before coming to the Elf Race’s Holy Land, his Divine Power Value was only 6500, but it already crushed countless Legends, even general Initial-tier Demigods!
If he could increase it to 26,000, Han Xing’s Divine Power Value would have increased by four times and more!
Even general Middle-tier Demigods couldn’t reach his level.
Cooperating with Han Xing’s Golden Divine Power, he could even directly suppress High-tier Legends!
"My god... this upgrade effect is terrifying!"
Han Xing excitedly continued to invest Ancient Spirit Wood.
However, upon investing the 15,000th piece, no new blessing appeared.
Han Xing frowned.
Is it not there? Isn’t it calculated as one blessing per 5000 pieces of Spirit Wood?
He held his patience and continued investing.
At the 20,000th piece,
The blessing appeared again.
Han Xing was once again enveloped in the golden aura of life.
His eyes revealed joy.
It turns out that after investing ten thousand pieces of Ancient Spirit Wood, the subsequent actions reward a blessing every next 10,000 pieces.
Although this data was more than Han Xing anticipated.
But the effect of the World Tree’s blessing was too strong, he simply could not refuse it!
So, Han Xing continued to extract more Ancient Spirit Wood from his backpack.
30,000 pieces, 40,000 pieces, 50,000 pieces...
Each time the Holy Tree’s blessing enveloped Han Xing, his power grew at a terrifying pace.
By this time, Han Xing’s Divine Power Value had already broken through 13,000.
Even the Elf King watching nearby was taken aback.
Because so far, Han Xing had received seven blessings.
This is an achievement only the First Generation Elf King has accomplished in the history of the Elf Race.
However, when Han Xing was once again enveloped by the golden aura, and the eighth blessing of the Holy Tree appeared,
The Elf King gaped, momentarily at a loss for words.
When the 130,000 pieces of Ancient Spirit Wood were completely invested,
Han Xing’s aura underwent an extremely terrifying transformation!
Divine Power Value officially broke through 21,000!
blessings increased his Life Value by 3,000,000.
If armor is not counted, Han Xing now could even be more resilient than Shen Yun, this Holy Knight.
At the same time.
After the World Tree absorbed so much Spiritual Qi from the Ancient Spirit Wood, it too underwent a change.
Its golden canopy became even brighter,
Everyone felt that the surrounding Life Force became richer.
When Han Xing, walking out from underneath the World Tree roots, proclaimed the end of this ceremony,
The Elf King looked at Han Xing with a face of both delight and gratification.
"Saint Master Han Xing, this time, you have truly gained an immense opportunity!"
Han Xing smiled and nodded, not denying it.
After all, this time, his gains were indeed tremendous.
So many blessings from the World Tree significantly enhanced his Life Force and Divine Power Value.
And crucially,
The Elf King also promised to give him a large amount of Waveless Metal and Ancient Elf Secret Ingots.

And his Divine Power Value directly increased by 1000.
Now, his Divine Power Value had officially broken through 8000!
Han Xing paused in place, not expecting that helping the World Tree recover would bring such benefits.
The next moment, Han Xing, even more excited, invested more Ancient Spirit Wood.
Six thousand, seven thousand, eight thousand...
And he occasionally looked up at the World Tree.
Han Xing was implying: Any more?
Can you take some more?
When the number of invested Ancient Spirit Wood reached ten thousand,
Han Xing indeed heard the system prompt again.
[Due to your assistance in restoring the World Tree, you have triggered a reward: the Gift of the World...]
Everyone only saw that Han Xing was once again enveloped in a golden light.
When the golden light ended, Han Xing’s momentum surged by yet another notch!
Even the Elf King was very surprised, looking at the changes in Han Xing.
"Third blessing..."
"In history, only a few of the previous Elf Kings have experienced this, and now it happens to this Saint Master Han Xing."
"It’s simply unbelievable!"
At this moment, even Han Xing couldn’t help but feel very excited.
The recent blessing from the World Tree had further boosted his Life Value by 200,000, and his Divine Power Value broke through 9000!
"My god, if calculated based on each 5000 pieces of Ancient Spirit Wood triggering a blessing,"
"Wouldn’t my Divine Power Value directly reach 26,000 after I finish investing these 130,000 pieces of Ancient Spirit Wood?"
Han Xing was shocked by this number he calculated!
Because before coming to the Elf Race’s Holy Land, his Divine Power Value was only 6500, but it already crushed countless Legends, even general Initial-tier Demigods!
If he could increase it to 26,000, Han Xing’s Divine Power Value would have increased by four times and more!
Even general Middle-tier Demigods couldn’t reach his level.
Cooperating with Han Xing’s Golden Divine Power, he could even directly suppress High-tier Legends!
"My god... this upgrade effect is terrifying!"
Han Xing excitedly continued to invest Ancient Spirit Wood.
However, upon investing the 15,000th piece, no new blessing appeared.
Han Xing frowned.
Is it not there?
Isn’t it calculated as one blessing per 5000 pieces of Spirit Wood?
He held his patience and continued investing.
At the 20,000th piece,
The blessing appeared again.
Han Xing was once again enveloped in the golden aura of life.
His eyes revealed joy.
It turns out that after investing ten thousand pieces of Ancient Spirit Wood, the subsequent actions reward a blessing every next 10,000 pieces.
Although this data was more than Han Xing anticipated.
But the effect of the World Tree’s blessing was too strong, he simply could not refuse it!
So, Han Xing continued to extract more Ancient Spirit Wood from his backpack.
30,000 pieces, 40,000 pieces, 50,000 pieces...
Each time the Holy Tree’s blessing enveloped Han Xing, his power grew at a terrifying pace.
By this time, Han Xing’s Divine Power Value had already broken through 13,000.
Even the Elf King watching nearby was taken aback.
Because so far, Han Xing had received seven blessings.
This is an achievement only the First Generation Elf King has accomplished in the history of the Elf Race.
However, when Han Xing was once again enveloped by the golden aura, and the eighth blessing of the Holy Tree appeared,
The Elf King gaped, momentarily at a loss for words.
When the 130,000 pieces of Ancient Spirit Wood were completely invested,
Han Xing’s aura underwent an extremely terrifying transformation!
Divine Power Value officially broke through 21,000!
blessings increased his Life Value by 3,000,000.
If armor is not counted, Han Xing now could even be more resilient than Shen Yun, this Holy Knight.
At the same time.
After the World Tree absorbed so much Spiritual Qi from the Ancient Spirit Wood, it too underwent a change.
Its golden canopy became even brighter,
Everyone felt that the surrounding Life Force became richer.
When Han Xing, walking out from underneath the World Tree roots, proclaimed the end of this ceremony,
The Elf King looked at Han Xing with a face of both delight and gratification.
"Saint Master Han Xing, this time, you have truly gained an immense opportunity!"
Han Xing smiled and nodded, not denying it.
After all, this time, his gains were indeed tremendous.
So many blessings from the World Tree significantly enhanced his Life Force and Divine Power Value.
And crucially,
The Elf King also promised to give him a large amount of Waveless Metal and Ancient Elf Secret Ingots.

chapters.title: Chapter 754 - 424: The World Tree’s Gift
paragraphs: It can be described as one investment, two returns.
Han Xing felt very gratified, hoping for more good things like this.
His gaze towards the group of Elves became even more affable.
At this moment, the Elf King said with emotion, "Saint Master Han Xing, you are the first human in Elf Race history to receive the blessing 15 times."
"In our race’s history, the strongest Elf King only received the blessing seven times."
"Later, this generation’s Elf King broke through to the Divine Realm."
"Saint Master Han Xing, your future achievements are almost limitless..."
The gaze of the Elf King towards Han Xing carried envy.
After all, such a thing, he wouldn’t dare to imagine.
Let alone it truly happening to a human.
Han Xing smiled and shook his head, "It’s nothing; I just got lucky with a large batch of Spirit Wood at hand."
The Elf King nodded, looking at the World Tree with emotion, "That’s great..."
"In this way, the World Tree can slowly begin to recover."
"Maybe in one or two thousand years, it could return to its perfect state."
"By then, the space in the Holy Spirit Realm will be incredibly stable, and those demons will no longer be able to easily open teleportation arrays."
Han Xing furrowed his brow, "Can we still not stop the Abyss Realm from opening teleportation arrays now?"
The Elf King shook his head, "As long as the World Tree has not recovered, the space in the Holy Spirit Realm is unstable."
"Currently, it only makes the space barriers slightly more solid, making teleportation from the Abyss Realm more difficult."
"In the short term, it’s unlikely that demons with high-tier demigod strength like the ones we just encountered will appear."
"So, how can we stop the Abyss Realm’s teleportation arrays?" Han Xing continued to ask.
The Elf King shook his head again, "I am also searching for the relevant methods."
"However, I have already consulted the ancestors of the clan, and before they respond, we can only continue to defend the Elf Realm and not let those demons occupy it."
Han Xing nodded after hearing this.
And at this time, the Elf King suddenly changed the topic.
"By the way, Saint Master Han Xing, may I know your age this year?"
Han Xing was taken aback when he heard this question.
This was the first time he heard a resident of the Holy Spirit Realm ask his age.
Han Xing thought for a moment.
"Um... about twenty-seven or eight?"
Counting the three years he spent in the Holy Spirit Realm, he was indeed around this age.
Upon hearing this number, not only the Elf King but also Elinora were stupefied.
Because it was the first time they heard such a young age.
In the Elf Race’s concept.
Twenty years old is merely reaching adulthood...
The Elf King tentatively asked, "Saint Master Han Xing, are you sure you haven’t made a mistake."
"Not two hundred, but over twenty?"
Han Xing nodded without further explanation.
However, they confirmed that Han Xing was truly over twenty.
And he wasn’t joking.
The Elf King stared blankly for a long time before recovering.
He looked at Han Xing with a complex expression.
In his heart, it seemed like he was making some decision.
The Elf King muttered softly, "Well, over twenty is over twenty."
"It’s a bit young, but the younger folks probably won’t mind..."
Han Xing asked, "Your Excellency, Elf King, what are you saying?"
The Elf King shook his head and spoke directly.
"Saint Master Han Xing, do you have any plans to marry soon?"
"My daughter, Elinora, although a bit older than you, is still peerlessly beautiful."
As the Elf King finished speaking, everyone present was stunned.
Elinora was even more astonished, "Fa-fa-fa-fa-father! What are you saying!"
Her cheeks were flushed red, and her words were somewhat unclear.
The Elf King continued, "Daughter, I’m serious."
"I know you have high standards, and there are barely any young talents in the Holy Spirit Realm that catch your eye."
"But Saint Master Han Xing has received the Holy Tree’s blessing 15 times, surpassing all previous Elf Kings, and he surely has boundless potential."
Elinora shyly said, "Father... I’m not saying that..."
"What I mean is... you should first seek Saint Master Han Xing’s opinion..."
The more she spoke, the softer her voice became, like a mosquito’s whisper.
Her head was almost entirely buried down.
The Elf King seemed to remember this detail and patted his head, "Indeed, I almost forgot something so important."
So, he looked at Han Xing and said, "Saint Master Han Xing, I’m really sorry for forgetting to ask for your opinion."
"This is merely my personal idea, and of course, you may refuse."
"But I believe if the Human Race and Elf Race could unite, it would be beneficial for both sides."
The Elf King stated his purpose and thoughts very directly.
At this time, others also understood the Elf King’s intention.
Seeing Han Xing’s boundless potential, he wanted to marry off the Divine Maiden of his race to Han Xing, thereby taking the opportunity to unite the Human and Elf Races.
It sounded casual.
But it was actually a matter influential enough to affect the Holy Spirit Realm.
Because if Han Xing agreed.
It would mean the union of two major races in the Holy Spirit Realm.
And if the Witch Race was included, it would be three major races.
By then, they would become a dominant race in the Holy Spirit Realm.
Even Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang had nothing much to say about such a significant matter.
Because they knew, compared to personal emotions, the greater good of humanity was more important.
Everyone quietly awaited Han Xing’s response.
A moment later, Han Xing suddenly smiled and said, "Thank you, Elf King, for your consideration and kindness."
"But now, with the Abyss Race invasion, it’s not the time to talk about this."
"Let’s first unite our efforts to overcome the current challenges, and then we’ll talk."
Although his words were a roundabout refusal, he did not make it absolute.
He didn’t let the Elf King lose face, nor did he embarrass the Elf Goddess.
The Elf King also caught his implication, smiling, "It seems I was too impatient."
"Indeed, we must first get through the crisis from the Abyss Realm."
"Since that is the case, let me send someone to escort Saint Master Han Xing and the human friends back for some rest?"
Han Xing nodded and said, "Thank you, Your Excellency, Elf King."
Exactly, Han Xing and his companions did wish to rest a bit.
As Han Xing and others were about to leave the Holy Land of the Elf Race.
A system prompt suddenly appeared in Han Xing’s ears.
[For saving the World Tree, this act has moved the Elf Race; affinity +6000, current affinity: Amiable.]
Gaining 6000 affinity points at once, it’s indeed worthy of the epic-level task of saving the World Tree.
Feeling that with a few more times, he could directly max out the Elf Race’s affinity.
Han Xing nodded with satisfaction.
Then, he led everyone away from there.
At this moment, the Elf King and Elinora still stood there.
The Elf King seemed to notice a trace of loss in his daughter’s eyes and chuckled softly, "What’s wrong, daughter."
"Being rejected by Saint Master Han Xing, do you feel a bit defeated?"
"Is it the first time you discovered that your charm isn’t appreciated by other males?"
Elinora blushingly looked at the Elf King and said, "Father... please don’t tease me..."
"Whether Saint Master Han Xing will favor me, I’m not sure..."
The Elf King chuckled, "Daughter, that’s no big deal."
"You have to know that people like him will achieve unimaginable feats in the future."
"Moreover, he possesses an aura comparable to mine as a king."
"He’s only at the Legend level, yet as your father, I already feel a strong threat from him!"
"It’s hard to imagine how terrifying he would be once he breaks through to the initial-tier demigod or even the middle-tier demigod..."
The more the Elf King spoke, the lower Elinora’s head dropped.
Since childhood, she had been extremely confident in her looks and talent.
Among her peers, there was no one who could compare with her.
Even when she fully matured, looking across the entire Holy Spirit Realm, there were only a few among her generation stronger than her in cultivation.

chapters.title: Chapter 755 - 425: Tower of Annihilation Lightning, First Display of Power!
paragraphs: This also resulted in Elinora having high standards for a long time.
But now, she felt very uncertain about herself when facing Han Xing.
The Elf King seemed to see through his daughter’s thoughts and smiled encouragingly, "Daughter, have confidence in yourself."
"This Saint Master Han Xing already has two women beside him, which means he isn’t the type to focus solely on growing stronger and abandon all feelings."
"So, you still have a chance, and I’ll try to help you."
The Elf King added, "By the way, if you don’t want to, I won’t force you."
"Daughter, what are your thoughts?"
Elinora was somewhat dazed when she heard the Elf King’s inquiry.
Then she said shyly, "Father, now isn’t the time to talk about this."
Upon hearing this, the Elf King smiled even more merrily.
Several hours later.
Han Xing and his companions returned to Ten Thousand Stars City once more.
This restoration of the World Tree brought him considerable gains.
It even made Han Xing urgently wish to find more Ancient Spirit Wood to continue to frantically enhance his Life Value and Divine Power Value!
Thinking of this, Han Xing directly opened his contact list and sent a message to Lanlan.
"Lanlan, keep an eye out for Ancient Spirit Wood materials in the trading channel recently."
"All those pieces of equipment, secret elixirs, runes in my warehouse can be traded."
"As for the price, you evaluate it yourself, and if you need any assistance, you can also look for Wu Ling’Er."
"Make sure to gather all the Ancient Spirit Wood from the hands of the Survivors."
Han Xing explained his requirements quickly and concisely.
Lanlan responded with a gentle "Mm" from the other side.
"Alright, Lord."
Han Xing nodded in satisfaction.
Now, logistics are basically handled by Lanlan.
Including managing Xingyu City and shops in the Witch Race Territory, as well as the materials Han Xing needed, are all procured by Lanlan.
And she does an excellent job.
Of course, this is also because Lanlan can mobilize a large workforce from Xingyu City to assist her in her work.
She certainly couldn’t manage so many things by herself.
Under Lanlan, there is an extremely efficient and large-scale team.
At this moment, Lanlan suddenly remembered something and said, "By the way, Lord, I have something to report to you."
"Hm? What is it?"
"Recently, the All Gods Daily has brought their entire team to join us."
"Also, Sister Mumu actively requested to work with me in managing Xingyu City and Ten Thousand Stars City."
"Sister Mumu is really amazing; with her help, my workload has reduced a lot!"
After listening, Han Xing said with a smile, "These matters, you can decide on your own."
"Mm-hmm!"
Lanlan replied, "By the way, Lord, Sister Mumu wants me to ask when you’ll be back."
"She says she has something she’d like to see you about."
Upon hearing this question, Han Xing appeared puzzled.
Of course, he remembers Tangxin Mumu, whom he had even interviewed.
But isn’t this woman supposed to have her own friends?
Why did she specifically have Lanlan convey this matter to him?
After pondering for a moment, Han Xing shook his head.
"Tell her that some big events have occurred recently in the Holy Spirit Realm, and I probably won’t be back anytime soon."
"I’ll contact her when I’m free."
Lanlan nodded and replied, "Alright, Lord."
After hanging up the communication.
Lanlan stared blankly ahead, then said a little disappointedly, "Actually... I also want to see you..."
Arriving back at Ten Thousand Stars City, Han Xing looked at his team and said, "Alright, go take a rest."
"Tomorrow, Elinora will arrange our defensive area."
"In the upcoming period, our task is to stay in the Elf Realm, defending and destroying any Teleportation Arrays from the Abyss Realm."
Upon hearing this, everyone nodded.
Then, each returned to their rooms to rest.
However, that night.
Zhang Lianmeng secretly knocked on Han Xing’s door.
She seemed somewhat fearful, tightly holding onto Han Xing.
That night, she was especially passionate and wild.
Han Xing was surprised by her enthusiasm.
The two shared another tender night...
The next day...
Han Xing and his companions awoke in Ten Thousand Stars City.
Today, the same Elf Race girl from yesterday, Eliza, came to greet them.
Seeing Han Xing and the others appear, the elf girl Eliza chuckled, "Saint Master Han Xing, His Majesty asked me to take you to the next area you’ll be defending."
"Are you all ready to go now?"
"Ready," Han Xing replied.
The team members also nodded.
Then, Eliza opened transparent wings and flew in front to lead the way.
Behind, Han Xing and the others followed steadily in flight, not at high speed.
After a period of travel.
Eliza suddenly turned her head, showing a cute smile, and said, "By the way, Saint Master Han Xing."
"The Divine Maiden wanted me to tell you she’ll be defending the Royal City area today, so can’t attend to you all today. We hope you understand."
After the events of yesterday, Han Xing and Elinora meeting indeed felt slightly awkward.
Han Xing nodded, "No worries, defending against the Abyss Race’s invasion takes priority."
Eliza smiled gently and continued leading the way.
Along the way, everyone passed through the vast domain of the Elf Realm.
They saw thousands of Sky Islands of various sizes.
They also encountered many beings from other races in the Holy Spirit Realm.
Some were operating warships, others were simply using Divine Power to float, persistently surveying the area around them.

"Are you all ready to go now?"
"Ready," Han Xing replied.
The team members also nodded.
Then, Eliza opened transparent wings and flew in front to lead the way.
Behind, Han Xing and the others followed steadily in flight, not at high speed.
After a period of travel.
Eliza suddenly turned her head, showing a cute smile, and said, "By the way, Saint Master Han Xing."
"The Divine Maiden wanted me to tell you she’ll be defending the Royal City area today, so can’t attend to you all today.
We hope you understand."
After the events of yesterday, Han Xing and Elinora meeting indeed felt slightly awkward.
Han Xing nodded, "No worries, defending against the Abyss Race’s invasion takes priority."
Eliza smiled gently and continued leading the way.
Along the way, everyone passed through the vast domain of the Elf Realm.
They saw thousands of Sky Islands of various sizes.
They also encountered many beings from other races in the Holy Spirit Realm.
Some were operating warships, others were simply using Divine Power to float, persistently surveying the area around them.

chapters.title: Chapter 756 - 425: Tower of Annihilation Lightning, First Display of Power!
paragraphs: Ensure you can detect the Abyssal Teleportation Array the moment it appears, and then destroy it.
Nearly eight hours later.
The group traveled across millions of kilometers.
They arrived in the area near the center of the Elf Realm.
In front of them appeared a vast Sky Island.
On it were continuous mountain ranges, active volcanoes, and even glaciers...
This Sky Island alone had an extremely complete ecological system.
On the land were various green plants, with flowers everywhere.
Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang, the two girls, instantly couldn’t take their eyes off the Sky Island when they saw it.
What girl could resist a Sky Island full of flowers?
"Saint Master Han Xing, this is Firefly Island of our race. Besides the beautiful scenery, there is an active energy organism called the Red Glowing Insect."
"They have no physical form, usually parasitizing on those flowers and plants, making them nearly invisible during the day."
"But at night, all the Red Glowing Insects will float out, emitting an orange glow that lights up every corner of Firefly Island, as beautiful as a sunset!"
In Eliza’s beautiful pupils appeared a sparkle, as if she greatly admired Firefly Island.
The group nodded, also acknowledging that the Sky Island was indeed remarkable.
Eliza continued, "Before, this Sky Island was once the moonlit rendezvous place for couples of our race... and many moving stories have circulated."
"Now, this Firefly Island will be your temporary base."
"With this island as the center, the area within roughly 500,000 kilometers around it is your responsibility."
"In this region, all Abyssal Teleportation Arrays will be left to you to handle."
"Of course, if you have any spare capacity, you can also support other areas."
Eliza finished with a light laugh.
The group had somewhat peculiar expressions upon hearing this.
They originally thought the Elf King would have them guard an area of millions of kilometers.
But unexpectedly, they only needed to be responsible for a relatively small area.
A 500,000-kilometer radius already sounds vast.
If it were any other race, they might need to mobilize the entire race’s forces for defense.
However, it should be known that.
Those high-tier defense towers Han Xing possesses have a terrifying attack range!
The Spiritual Godslaying Cannon has a farthest strike distance of 50,000 kilometers, and enhanced by two Sun Crown Steles, it’s 150,000 kilometers.
The Dark Energy Cannon has a strike range of 100,000 kilometers, enhanced to 300,000 kilometers.
And the most powerful of Catastrophe-level Defense Towers: Silent Annihilation Lightning, has a strike range of 200,000 kilometers.
Enhanced by two Sun Crown Steles.
The Tower of Annihilation Lightning’s farthest attack range has reached 600,000 kilometers.
It can be said.
Even if Han Xing stands still on this Sky Island, he could achieve full-scale fire coverage over the area they need to defend.
However, Han Xing didn’t say much more and continued to ask, "Miss Eliza, after our forces arrive, how should they be arranged?"
"Do they fall under the unified command of your Elf Race? Or do we command them ourselves?"
This question likely interests many large races.
After all, they certainly wouldn’t want to entrust their forces to be commanded by another race.
There’s a chance they might become mere cannon fodder.
Hearing Han Xing address her as "Miss," Eliza covered her face in a light laugh.
"Saint Master Han Xing, your subsequent forces will naturally be under your own command."
Han Xing and the others nodded; this was indeed a good outcome.
Evidently, the Elf King also wanted to avoid unnecessary misunderstandings, so they simply decided not to get involved in other races’ military command rights.
They only need to ensure the defense of the area they’re responsible for.
At this point, Eliza continued to add: "However, once Saint Master Han Xing’s troops arrive, the area needing defense might increase a bit."
"And if the frequency of the Abyssal Teleportation Arrays increases or suddenly bursts."
"Perhaps all races’ armies will need to be fully mobilized for battle.
"No problem with that." Han Xing nodded.
After giving these instructions, Eliza officially bid farewell to the group, then flapped her elf wings and departed.
Han Xing stood in place, speaking to his team members.
"Alright, you’ve all heard."
"Next, we have to defend this area."
"Defending towers has always been our forte. Let’s aim not to let a single Abyssal Monster escape!"
The group nodded together, encouraged and confident: "No problem!"
"Don’t worry, Brother Xing! We’ll make sure not a single monster gets away!"
Thus, the five of them began residing on Firefly Island.
Meanwhile, Ten Thousand Stars City remained floating above Firefly Island, unmoved.
At the same time.
The five of them appeared in mid-air, scattered in different directions, watching ahead.
Just then, Cheng Jianyong suddenly shouted, "Brother Xing, something’s happening!"
"Coordinates: 1079231, 2043013, 582814, two Abyss Realm Teleportation Arrays have appeared."
Han Xing nodded after hearing this.
At the same time.
In a certain area of Ten Thousand Stars City, there was a stretch of deep purple, resembling a pile of giant stone spires.
On the tower’s body, there faintly appeared a lightning ’Z’ symbol.
Usually, just getting close would make everyone feel a tingle all over their body.
These were the Catastrophe-level Defense Towers: Silent Annihilation Lightning!
At this moment, under Han Xing’s command.
Two Towers of Annihilation Lightning instantaneously began to charge, the atmosphere, active thunder elements were instantly condensed.

chapters.title: Chapter 757 - 425: Tower of Annihilation Lightning, First Display of Power!
paragraphs: The ’Z’ symbol on the stone tower became increasingly bright, with even visible Thunder Element particles appearing on it.
"Sizzle... sizzle sizzle..."
Terrifying currents began to gather, and the light atop the Tower of Annihilation Lightning became even more radiant!
If not for the presence of the two Sun Crown Steles, the charging time of the Tower of Annihilation Lightning would be around four seconds.
But now, with the support of two Holy Artifacts.
The charging time is less than a second!
The next moment.
Two deep blue electric lights burst from the tower’s tip at an extremely fast speed.
"Boom!"
A dull roar appeared.
The instantaneous burst speed almost caught even someone as skilled as Han Xing by surprise!
In the distance, the Abyssal Monsters were just appearing in the Teleportation Array, carrying manic smiles on their faces.
"Haha! We’ve finally come over!"
"Holy Spirit Realm! Prepare to meet our slaughter!"
At this moment, a demon with flame marks on his face looked around with a peculiar smile.
"It seems we have luck on our side this time, with none of the Holy Spirit Realm blocking our way nearby."
"If things continue like this, we might actually manage to break through the Elf Realm, find other weak spots in the Holy Spirit Realm, and set anchor points."
"Then we can open more Teleportation Arrays, and the Holy Spirit Realm will be ours for the taking!"
Other demons, upon hearing this, also appeared with sneering smiles.
However, before their smiles could last long.
Suddenly, a giant ’Z’ shaped lightning struck down.
"Boom!"
As if a crack of thunder exploded over their heads!
Terrifying currents rampaged in an instant.
The space in that region directly collapsed, with chaotic energy surging.
More terrifying was the lightning plasma that had solidified into a tangible form!
Within a radius of three kilometers (with the Sun Crown Stele expanding the Attack Range by 200%), all Abyssal Monsters below Legendary Level were instantly electrocuted to ash.
Even the Legendary Level Abyssal Monsters turned into charred shapes in just 0.1 seconds under the rampaging currents...
When the attack from the Annihilation Lightning faded.
All Abyssal Monsters in the two regions, including the two Abyssal Teleportation Arrays, vanished together.
As if they had never appeared at all.
And this was the power of the strongest Defense Tower in Han Xing’s territory!
The Tower of Annihilation Lightning boasts an Attack Power of one million, enhanced to three million by the two Sun Crown Steles.
This almost matches the Demon God Battleship Main Cannon, which has five million Attack Power.
Attacks of this magnitude, not to mention these Legendary demons.
Even if Initial Tier or Middle-tier Demigods were to come.
They wouldn’t die but would be severely injured!
Han Xing nodded contentedly.
Although these Defense Towers on Ten Thousand Stars City are his trump cards, he doesn’t reveal them easily.
However, those ancient existences also know that the Territory Defense Tower in Han Xing’s domain possesses godslaying abilities.
Therefore, exposing a few Towers of Annihilation Lightning doesn’t affect much.
After all, they cannot guess.
This is just the tip of the iceberg for Ten Thousand Stars City.
Everyone marveled at the terrifying power of the Tower of Annihilation Lightning.
This thing is too scary, with just a random lightning attack, likely only Shen Yun and Han Xing would survive on the field.
At this moment, Su Xiaoyang softly said, "Brother Han Xing, coordinates: 1489771, 1528891, 683298, three Teleportation Arrays have appeared."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing immediately turned his gaze.
"Boom! Boom!"
Three Towers of Annihilation Lightning burst instantly.
And then, nothing followed.
The Abyssal Monsters didn’t even realize how they died before being electrocuted to ash.
Next, everyone remained in place, monitoring the area they were responsible for from all angles without any blind spots.
Another corner of the Elf Realm.
Legends and Demigod powerhouses from the Realm of Darkness were flying in the air, performing patrol duties.
Since the Elf Race divides their defense regions based on the strength of those large races.
This time, a region with a diameter of roughly eight hundred thousand kilometers was allocated to the Realm of Darkness.
Slightly smaller than Han Xing’s territory.
But it was also a fairly vast area.
There’s no choice; the territory of the Elf Realm is just too big, and even with the help of so many large races, they cannot cover everything.
Furthermore, none of them brought Defense Towers.
Compared to Han Xing and the others, those strong in the Holy Spirit Realm seldom rely on Defense Towers after breaking through to Legendary Level.
Because they believe it’s a waste of resources to painstakingly build a Defense Tower.
While the destructive power is decent, the inability to move is a major flaw.
Legendary powerhouses have terrifying mobility and destructive power.
If it’s accidentally destroyed, they’d have nowhere to cry about it.
If Han Xing didn’t have the Sun Crown Stele.
He might also abandon development of Defense Towers and focus on enhancing his personal abilities.
But with the exclusive Holy Artifact, he undoubtedly channels this advantage to the utmost!
This is the enhancement brought by the exclusive Holy Artifact for the Human Race.
The Dark Divine Son, holding a Longsword, swiftly swept through the air.
He must ensure that any Teleportation Arrays appearing in his responsible area are discovered immediately.
Otherwise, should some monsters slip through to regions other races are accountable for or reach the edge of Elf Realm, it would be laughable.
So, the Dark Divine Son maintained full vigilance.
As he advanced a little further.
The Dark Divine Son suddenly sensed fluctuations of energy waves surrounding the area.
When he reacted.
Tens of red lights soared into the sky!
Tens of thousands, even hundreds of thousands of Abyssal Monsters erupted!
The Dark Divine Son saw dozens of Teleportation Arrays appearing simultaneously, all right beside him.
"Damn it! So many?"
At that moment, his pupils contracted sharply, and a strong sense of crisis surged within him!

chapters.title: Chapter 758 - 426: Massive Teleportation Array
paragraphs: The Dark Divine Son is indeed powerful, even hailed as a once-in-a-millennium genius.
Yet even at full power, he can only barely contend with Initial-tier Demigods.
Furthermore, these dozen teleportation arrays signify at least dozens of Legendary Level Abyssal Monsters!
Some might even be Demigods among the Demons!
The Dark Divine Son set aside his so-called arrogance of the strong and cried out loudly for help: "There are numerous teleportation arrays appearing near me!"
"At least dozens of Legendary Creatures, Clan Leader save me!"
"What?"
The powerful figures patrolling this territory from the Realm of Darkness were taken aback upon hearing the call for help.
They too saw the radiant red light shooting into the sky from tens of thousands of kilometers away and felt a rush of shock and urgency.
Fear gripped them that something might have happened to their Divine Son.
"Divine Son! Quickly distance yourself, do not engage those Abyssal Monsters directly!"
"The Clan Leader is on the way!"
Meanwhile, the powerful individuals from the Realm of Darkness transformed into streams of black light, their movement speed surging immensely!
They dashed swiftly between the Sky Islands of the Elf Realm!
"Whoosh! Whoosh whoosh!"
The sound of air being pierced echoed, and even those powerful figures from major clans nearby sensed the situation arising from the Realm of Darkness.
At this moment, the Dark Divine Son was fleeing at high speed.
He wasn’t foolish; knowing he couldn’t win, he certainly wouldn’t stay in place.
A pack of Abyssal Monsters chased him relentlessly, some attacks they made had even struck the Dark Divine Son’s body.
The Dark Divine Son endured several attacks without a word and pressed on.
"Hahaha! Keep running! Keep running!"
"I just love watching you Holy Spirit Realm folks panic and flee!"
"Don’t scare this guy too much, seeing us in such numbers, he might already be frightened enough to wet his pants, hahaha!"
Boisterous laughter and mockery echoed in his ears but were ignored by the Dark Divine Son.
After fleeing for some distance.
He finally saw several streams of black light rushing in from afar.
They were his fellow clan members!
Hope surfaced in the Dark Divine Son’s heart.
"Divine Son! Come to me!"
A voice emerged and then, a Demigod Level Dark Energy Body erupted instantly.
In that moment, the sky within a hundred-mile radius turned completely black!
This group of Abyssal Monsters was entirely enveloped by the Dark Domain.
"This kid’s clan members have come to aid; it seems we won’t be able to kill him."
"Looks like one of them is a Demigod too."
"No worries, we have a Demigod Level Demon Monarch coming as well."
"Kill him!"
The battle between both sides immediately commenced!
At this moment, having briefly recovered from some injuries.
The Dark Divine Son once more extended the Dark Energy on his body, transforming into a nearly two-meter-long Great Sword.
Taking a deep breath, he charged into the Dark Domain and began fighting the Abyssal Monsters!
The sound of battle cries echoed incessantly.
In the heart of the Dark Divine Son, he believed that since he had promised to aid the Elf Race, he had to do the job well.
Moreover, now the entire Holy Spirit Realm had most races stationed in the Elf Realm to collectively resist Abyss Realm.
If the Realm of Darkness failed to hold its ground, allowing Demons to breach the border defense, it would be a laughingstock among other races.
In truth, not just the Realm of Darkness experienced this.
Other races faced the same situation.
With the increasing frequency of teleportation array appearances, the count of simultaneous Abyssal Monsters grew too.
Major clans found themselves entangled in arduous battles.
Fortunately, as the reinforcements from the Elf Race arrived, the frenzied Abyss Legion was swiftly suppressed.
Over the next few days, more powerful figures from across the Holy Spirit Realm gathered.
Han Xing and his team continued their defensive tasks.
However, compared to other races, the five seemed particularly relaxed.
After all, they simply had to stand where they were, observing for any Abyss Race teleportation arrays.
Then activate the Tower of Annihilation Lightning, and bombard them directly.
There was no need to fly around for inspections.
Undoubtedly, this kind of ultra-long-range point blast attack with overwhelming firepower felt incredibly enjoyable!
The enemies didn’t even know where the attack originated, being scorched and reduced to ashes instantly.
Moreover, the Souls from the obliterated Abyssal Monsters would be absorbed and stored by the Demon Furnace atop the Ten Thousand Stars.
Awaiting Han Xing to refine them into Soul Crystals.
Time passed day by day.
The invasions from the Demon Race also grew more frequent.
Initially, within the area Han Xing’s group was responsible for, teleportation array signs might appear seven or eight times per day.
But now, it had increased to twenty to thirty times, even forty to fifty times daily.
Not only was the frequency increasing, but also the strength of the monsters.
Over these days, the number of Souls stored in Han Xing’s Demon Furnace had already exceeded 50 billion.
Showing just how many Abyssal Monsters they had eliminated.
Until four days later.
On the fifth day of their time in the Elf Realm.
After Han Xing operated six Towers of Annihilation Lightning, obliterating over a dozen teleportation arrays from Abyss Realm.
A large cluster of green souls floated toward Ten Thousand Stars City, and was collected by the Demon Furnace.
Han Xing glanced at the Soul reserve tally on the Demon Furnace.
[Stored Souls]: 53.2 billion.
This wave of bombardment added over a dozen billion Souls to his count.
The Soul intensity of these Abyssal Monsters is immense, one Tier Five Elite Level Abyss Monster alone can provide Han Xing 1000 Soul Points.

Keep running!"
"I just love watching you Holy Spirit Realm folks panic and flee!"
"Don’t scare this guy too much, seeing us in such numbers, he might already be frightened enough to wet his pants, hahaha!"
Boisterous laughter and mockery echoed in his ears but were ignored by the Dark Divine Son.
After fleeing for some distance.
He finally saw several streams of black light rushing in from afar.
They were his fellow clan members!
Hope surfaced in the Dark Divine Son’s heart.
"Divine Son!
Come to me!"
A voice emerged and then, a Demigod Level Dark Energy Body erupted instantly.
In that moment, the sky within a hundred-mile radius turned completely black!
This group of Abyssal Monsters was entirely enveloped by the Dark Domain.
"This kid’s clan members have come to aid; it seems we won’t be able to kill him."
"Looks like one of them is a Demigod too."
"No worries, we have a Demigod Level Demon Monarch coming as well."
"Kill him!"
The battle between both sides immediately commenced!
At this moment, having briefly recovered from some injuries.
The Dark Divine Son once more extended the Dark Energy on his body, transforming into a nearly two-meter-long Great Sword.
Taking a deep breath, he charged into the Dark Domain and began fighting the Abyssal Monsters!
The sound of battle cries echoed incessantly.
In the heart of the Dark Divine Son, he believed that since he had promised to aid the Elf Race, he had to do the job well.
Moreover, now the entire Holy Spirit Realm had most races stationed in the Elf Realm to collectively resist Abyss Realm.
If the Realm of Darkness failed to hold its ground, allowing Demons to breach the border defense, it would be a laughingstock among other races.
In truth, not just the Realm of Darkness experienced this.
Other races faced the same situation.
With the increasing frequency of teleportation array appearances, the count of simultaneous Abyssal Monsters grew too.
Major clans found themselves entangled in arduous battles.
Fortunately, as the reinforcements from the Elf Race arrived, the frenzied Abyss Legion was swiftly suppressed.
Over the next few days, more powerful figures from across the Holy Spirit Realm gathered.
Han Xing and his team continued their defensive tasks.
However, compared to other races, the five seemed particularly relaxed.
After all, they simply had to stand where they were, observing for any Abyss Race teleportation arrays.
Then activate the Tower of Annihilation Lightning, and bombard them directly.
There was no need to fly around for inspections.
Undoubtedly, this kind of ultra-long-range point blast attack with overwhelming firepower felt incredibly enjoyable!
The enemies didn’t even know where the attack originated, being scorched and reduced to ashes instantly.
Moreover, the Souls from the obliterated Abyssal Monsters would be absorbed and stored by the Demon Furnace atop the Ten Thousand Stars.
Awaiting Han Xing to refine them into Soul Crystals.
Time passed day by day.
The invasions from the Demon Race also grew more frequent.
Initially, within the area Han Xing’s group was responsible for, teleportation array signs might appear seven or eight times per day.
But now, it had increased to twenty to thirty times, even forty to fifty times daily.
Not only was the frequency increasing, but also the strength of the monsters.
Over these days, the number of Souls stored in Han Xing’s Demon Furnace had already exceeded 50 billion.
Showing just how many Abyssal Monsters they had eliminated.
Until four days later.
On the fifth day of their time in the Elf Realm.
After Han Xing operated six Towers of Annihilation Lightning, obliterating over a dozen teleportation arrays from Abyss Realm.
A large cluster of green souls floated toward Ten Thousand Stars City, and was collected by the Demon Furnace.
Han Xing glanced at the Soul reserve tally on the Demon Furnace.
[Stored Souls]: 53.2 billion.
This wave of bombardment added over a dozen billion Souls to his count.
The Soul intensity of these Abyssal Monsters is immense, one Tier Five Elite Level Abyss Monster alone can provide Han Xing 1000 Soul Points.

chapters.title: Chapter 759 - 426: Massive Teleportation Array (Part 2)
paragraphs: A leader is worth 5000, and if they are a Legend, they can provide as much as 100 million souls directly.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong complained, "Wow, there really are a lot of these Abyssal Monsters."
"Just in this one area, we’ve taken down hundreds of millions of Abyssal Monsters over the past few days."
"If we consider other regions, in just five days, the Abyss Realm has lost at least tens or even hundreds of billions of Abyssal Monsters."
"Just how much military force does the Abyss Realm actually have?"
No wonder Cheng Jianyong would pose such a question.
After all, this isn’t the Abyssal Rift, where Abyssal Monsters killed by powerhouses from the Holy Spirit Realm do not revive.
However, Han Xing grinned and said, "It’s certainly more terrifying than we imagined."
"After all, that represents the strength of an entire world."
"Moreover, it’s been ten thousand years since the last invasion."
"During this lengthy period, the Abyss Realm must have amassed an incredibly fearsome number of powerhouses!"

"So don’t look at how easy things seem now, but if it truly is as the Elf King claims, that the Abyss Realm wants to launch a full-scale invasion and replicate the battle from ten thousand years ago."
"It will be a big trouble then."
Everyone heard the concern in Han Xing’s words.
Cheng Jianyong tentatively asked, "Brother Xing, you mean even you aren’t confident?"
Han Xing shook his head, "No."
"Not just me; even the Elf King and Dwarf King probably aren’t confident."
"After all, just one Demon Emperor, and there’s no existence in the Holy Spirit Realm that can contend with him."
Cheng Jianyong nodded at this, feeling a sense of crisis as well.
Lately, seeing Abyssal Monsters being constantly obliterated, he did underestimate the Abyss Realm a bit.
With Han Xing’s reminder, everyone realized the power of the Abyss Realm far exceeded expectations.
Those demons now present themselves, just like Han Xing’s Ten Thousand Stars City,
merely the tip of the iceberg.
If a full-scale invasion occurs, it would be a disaster for the entire Holy Spirit Realm.
A disaster countless times more terrifying than the Blood Tide!
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly felt the Communication Jade Pendant in his backpack vibrating slightly.
Upon checking, he found it was a message from High Priest Xiao.
He left a message on the pendant: "Saint Master, we are about to reach the Elf Realm, in about two to three hours, we’ll be at the border."
Seeing the message, Han Xing’s face lit up with joy.
Because ten days ago, he had already instructed High Priest Xiao to mobilize half of the Witch Race Territory’s troops to the Elf Realm for support.
Calculating the time, they should arrive around today.
After ending the communication.
Han Xing lay leisurely on a patch of grass on Firefly Island.
It was the early hours of the morning.
The Elf Realm was cloaked in night, with some time before dawn.
Around Han Xing, a large cluster of orange-red energy bodies appeared, like fireflies, constantly emitting an orange-red glow.
These are the Red Fireflies.
Just as Eliza described.
Those orange-red energy bodies emerge from various plants at night to absorb the Spiritual Qi of heaven and earth.
The light they emit made the entire Sky Island incredibly bright and magnificent.
"The scenery of the Elf Realm is truly splendid."
Han Xing thought with some contentment.
Next, once Xiao arrives with the army, Han Xing would have even less to do.
Just as he thought about this, his eyelid suddenly twitched.
A feeling of being targeted by a venomous snake emerged in his heart, tightening instantly!
Han Xing abruptly sat up from the ground, then flew into the air!
When his gaze shifted to the central area of the Elf Realm, his pupils contracted sharply!
At this moment, all the legendary powerhouses across the Elf Realm sensed something.
They appeared in mid-air, directing their gaze toward the central area.
These powerhouses, like Han Xing, displayed expressions of shock.
Voices of astonishment echoed: "Oh my heavens..."
"How could such a large Teleportation Array exist?"
Yes, in their view, an exceptionally massive Teleportation Array had appeared.
Even separated by millions of miles, the pillar of light reaching the sky was visible!
The extent of the array’s coverage was evident, with a diameter exceeding millions of miles!
Before they could react, the surging Abyssal Monsters had already poured out through that gigantic Teleportation Array like a tidal wave.
"Clatter!"
"Whoosh... whoosh..."
The sound waves from the flapping of demon wings echoed in waves.
In that instant.
The entire Elf Realm sounded the alarm!
"Woo—"
The piercing alarms reverberated across the sky above the Elf Realm.
The suddenness of the event left everyone unable to respond.
At this moment, the powerhouses of the Holy Spirit Realm exclaimed, "Oh my god! With such a large Teleportation Array, is the Abyss Realm planning a full-scale invasion?"
"So many Legendary Monsters, already reaching several thousand! And so many Demigod Level demon auras!"
"Is this the strength of the Abyss Realm? Truly terrifying!"
At the same time.
The voice of the Elf King resounded: "All powerhouses of the Holy Spirit Realm!"
"The Abyss Realm is launching a major invasion, please quickly proceed to the central area of the Elf Realm for support!"
"We... can’t hold on for long!"
Upon hearing the Elf King’s plea for help, everyone realized the gravity of the situation.
Even Han Xing and the others dashed toward the center of the Elf Realm at once.
At this moment.
The Elf King had already mobilized all soldiers from the central area.
Amid them were at least several hundred Legends, plus five or six Demigod Level auras.
In any group within the Holy Spirit Realm, this was a fairly significant force.

chapters.title: Chapter 760 - 426: Massive Teleportation Array (Part 3)
paragraphs: However, in the face of this invasion from the Abyss Realm, this amount of troops is far from enough!
Moreover, that massive Teleportation Array continues to frantically transport Abyssal Monsters.
At this rate, it won’t be long before the number of Legendary Level demons exceeds ten thousand!
And the aura of Demigod Level entities, they’ve sensed no less than a hundred!
Too terrifying!
At this moment.
Strong warriors from various races are frantically rushing towards the central area of the Elf Realm.
And the Elf King and his army have already engaged in battle with that horde of Abyssal Monsters.
"Kill! Tear them apart!"
The eyes of the Abyssal Monsters glinted with a Bloodthirsty gleam.
Seeing the army of the Elf Race charging toward them, a cruel smile appeared on their faces.
Then, a massive throng of Abyssal Monsters rushed towards them.
That army of the Elf Race barely numbered a million.
But the number of monsters charging at them had exceeded twenty million.
Facing a force several times, even dozens of times larger in number.
The army of the Elf Race was instantly engulfed by the Abyssal Monsters.
You could even hear the screams of the elves inside!
At this moment, this Elven unit is forming a defensive formation to resist the invasion of the Abyssal Monsters.
A delicately featured, cold-tempered female Elven officer ordered.
"Soldiers, hold on! Reinforcements from the Holy Spirit Realm are on the way, even if it means sacrificing our lives, we must not let these demons destroy the Royal City!"
The Elven soldiers also knew the situation had reached a very dire point.
They replied in unison: "Yes!"
They abandoned the attack in favor of an all-round defense.
However, those demons seemed to play with them, constantly circling around the army of the Elf Race.
The black and red Abyssal Monsters, spinning around now, formed a whirlpool of flesh and blood.
Aiming to drag the Elven soldiers into an abyss of unending misery.
Also, those Legendary Level Abyssal Monsters would occasionally unleash a range attack, taking away the lives of a large number of Elven soldiers.
"Damn it!" the female Elven officer was furious.
She knew well that these Abyssal Monsters were toying with them.
Yet, they had no means to counter it.
Even if they could use their lives to delay a little longer, it would be worth it!
At this moment, the Great Demon Monarch inside seemed to grow tired and directly ordered: "Alright, time’s up."
"Tear them all apart!"
Upon hearing this, a mad grin spread across the faces of the demons.
Then, they surged forward like a tidal wave!
Just when the elves were sinking into despair.
A figure dressed in a white long robe, emitting a white Divine Power, appeared.
Then, a terrifying burst of white light emanated from him, illuminating the sky within ten thousand miles as bright as day!
On the field, billions of pairs of eyes looked towards that figure simultaneously.
"Damn it! It’s the Elf King!"
"Retreat quickly!"
The demons shouted in shock.
However, this burst of white light was the Elf King’s area-kill skill.
At this moment, at least billions of Abyssal Monsters were engulfed in the white light and then disappeared without a trace.
Only a few Abyssal Monsters at the High-tier Legend or Demigod Level survived.
These demons looked at each other, eyes filled with astonishment.
In one attack, billions of Abyssal Monsters were evaporated.
This guy is terrifyingly strong!
At this moment, seeing those few demons still alive, the Elf King extended his fingers, consecutive beams of white light shot out.
The demons, sensing the terrifying destructive power from the beams of light unleashed by the Elf King, shouted frantically: "Run!"
They scattered in terror.
However, this obviously proved futile.
They were immediately caught by the beams of light, which pierced through their bodies, sending them plummeting from the sky.
This wave of the Abyssal Army was directly wiped out in one go by the Elf King.
After eliminating this batch of monsters, the Elf King didn’t look back and continued charging towards other Abyssal Monster forces!
"Hum!"
"Hum!"
Bursts of white light exploded like suns instantly detonating.
Each burst signified the end of at least billions, and even tens of billions, of Abyssal Monsters at the hands of that terrifying being.
After several bursts, the number of Abyssal Monsters slain by the Elf King reached hundreds of billions!
Seeing the white light rushing towards them, those monsters fled at top speed in terror!
However, their escape was doomed to be ineffective.
With the Elf King’s full burst, his speed reached an unimaginable, nearly Instant Movement-like realm.
"Hum!"
A terrifying white orb appeared once more, illuminating the sky completely!
And this is the power of a Top Demigod.
Without considering the cost, the Elf King alone can annihilate this overwhelming swarm of Abyssal Monsters.
The Abyssal Monsters cried out in terror.
"Ah! Damn Elf King, he’s coming again!"
"What a terrifying creature! Is this the top combat power of the Holy Spirit Realm? It feels like only Lord Demon God can contend with such a being!"
"Run!"
However, compared to the panic in the Abyss Realm, the Elf Race was greatly inspired.
Each and every one of them flushed with excitement, then shouted aloud.
"Long live His Majesty the Elf King!"
"Fight to the death alongside His Majesty the Elf King!"
"Charge, brave people of the Elf Race!"
At this moment, after evaporating this vast swathe of Abyssal Monsters, the Elf King’s face was slightly pale.
The continuous bursts, even for a Top Demigod, were taxing.
Yet he did not show it and continued to charge toward the other Abyssal Monsters.
Just then.
A monstrous demonic aura, blazing with blood-colored flames, suddenly appeared in front of him.
This was the aura of a High-tier Demigod Level demon!
Moreover, not just one, but there were three of them!
"Elf King, come play with us?"

chapters.title: Chapter 761 - 427: Blood-Inviting Demon’s Arrival
paragraphs: At this moment, three high-level demons, one wielding a giant axe, one barehanded, and one holding a great sword, stared fiercely at the Elf King.
Their eyes were filled with surging war intent.
Then, they shouted in unison.
"Blood-Inviting Demon’s Arrival!"
Boom!
Three pillars of flame shot into the sky, causing these high-level demons’ aura to surge wildly!
These demons completely disregarded their survival, immediately employing the forbidden technique [Blood-Inviting Demon’s Arrival] that consumes their life force upon appearance!
At this moment, their aura was closing in on that of the top demigod level Elf King.
Previously, the Elf King felt pressured dealing with just one.
Now with three, even the Elf King felt a shadow looming over his heart.
"Kill!"
In an instant, three terrifying attacks struck simultaneously.
Forcing the Elf King to muster all his spirit to respond.
"Bang!"
"Boom!"
The void exploded, and four terrifying figures stood together.
The Elf King fought three high-level demons alone, barely holding on.
This meant that the Elf King couldn’t aid the other elves!
The footsteps of the abyssal demon army could no longer be stopped.
The abyssal monsters overwhelmed the elven army in a frenzy.
Millions of elves died at the hands of those demons.
The screams continued.
Moreover, the methods of the abyssal monsters were extremely cruel!
The corpses of fallen elves would be torn apart on sight or directly devoured!
This bloody scene was utterly horrifying!
"Damn it! Damn you abyss race, I’ll kill you all!"
The eyes of the elven soldiers were blood-red.
This was no longer hatred between races; it was hatred between worlds!
The fury in their hearts dispelled fear, and the elves willingly charged at the abyssal army!
Like moths to a flame.
Yet, despite this, the numerical difference between both sides was still too vast.
After taking down the airborne elven army, the abyssal monsters began landing on the Sky Islands of the Elf Race, wreaking havoc on various buildings and vegetation.
This was the darkest night for the Elf Race.
The originally peaceful scene was shattered.
One Sky Island after another was set ablaze by demonic flames, illuminating the sky.
The elven maidens wailed and wept.
Yet these sounds fell on the ears of the abyssal monsters like beautiful and enchanting music.
Seeing the flames about to spread to the Elf Main City.
Suddenly, a large shadow appeared in the distance.
As those shadows approached, everyone realized they were high-level battleships!
This was an immense fleet!
Some sharp-eyed elven elites instantly recognized them as the battleships of the Dwarf Race.
At this moment, they exclaimed with joy: "It’s the Dwarf Race!"
"Great, reinforcements have finally arrived!"
"Everyone, hold fast!"
The elves felt hope rekindled in their hearts.
Meanwhile.
The Dwarf Race’s fleet had just arrived and began firing wildly.
The battleships equipped with several middle-to-high tier ancient weapons counted in the hundreds.
Under a barrage, it wielded part of the power of Ten Thousand Stars City!
"Boom!"
Cannonballs were fired right at the densest area of abyssal monsters.
Thousands of mushroom clouds rose simultaneously, engulfing countless abyssal monsters!
In an instant, the aura of the abyssal monsters halted!
They looked in shock at the mushroom clouds surging nearby and the fleet behind.
As the flames dissipated.
Tens of billions of abyssal monsters had been bombarded to death on the spot.
Even those abyssal monsters that survived the cannonballs were now engulfed in an eerie flame, which not only scorched their bodies but also burned their souls.
The abyssal monsters ran around in pain.
Yet they spread the flames onto other monsters.
The flames surged once more, igniting more abyssal monsters.
The abyssal army fell momentarily into chaos,
before they could take any actions.
The second wave of bombardment was already brewing within the fleet.
Compared to the short charging time of the high-tier ancient weapons in Han Xing’s territory.
The Dwarf Race’s fleet had a much longer interval between volleys.
At least a minute was needed for the second round.
But this speed was already fast relatively speaking.
At least, on such a vast battlefield, the destructive power of these hundreds of battleships was comparable to hundreds of demigods.
The abyssal monsters looked tense.
At that moment, a mid-tier Demon Monarch pointed behind.
"It’s the Dwarf Race!"
"Deploy forces and destroy their battleships!"
No sooner had the words left his mouth, at least a dozen demigod-level auras, accompanied by hundreds of Legendary, rushed towards the dwarf fleet!
However, the Dwarf Race’s fleet did not retreat, choosing instead to face them head-on.
"Boom! Boom boom!"
After the terrifying blast, a continuous rise of mushroom clouds covered that group of demigod and Legendary demons completely.
When the flames dissipated, many strong demons charged forward, seemingly not too damaged.
Still, this bout of bombing was not without effect.
This round of bombardment claimed at least dozens of Legendary level demons, and even one demigod level demon fell on the spot.
The remaining demons were also inflicted with various degrees of injury, their aura beginning to decline.
As the group of demons charged madly in that moment.

sentences.text: At this moment, three high-level demons, one wielding a giant axe, one barehanded, and one holding a great sword, stared fiercely at the Elf King.
Their eyes were filled with surging war intent.
Then, they shouted in unison.
"Blood-Inviting Demon’s Arrival!"

Three pillars of flame shot into the sky, causing these high-level demons’ aura to surge wildly!

"Boom!"

Millions of elves died at the hands of those demons.

This bloody scene was utterly horrifying!

The originally peaceful scene was shattered.
One Sky Island after another was set ablaze by demonic flames, illuminating the sky.
The elven maidens wailed and wept.
Yet these sounds fell on the ears of the abyssal monsters like beautiful and enchanting music.

This was an immense fleet!

"Great, reinforcements have finally arrived!"

Cannonballs were fired right at the densest area of abyssal monsters.
