chapters.title: Chapter 762 - 427: Blood-Inviting Demon’s Arrival (Part 2)
paragraphs: The distant Elves couldn’t help but feel a sense of worry.
If the warships were approached by those demons, given the warship’s mobility, it wouldn’t take long for them to be completely destroyed.
Not only would the Dwarf Race suffer heavy losses, but the situation, which had barely started to improve, would once again teeter on the brink of collapse.
Just as the group of demons was about to charge in.
Suddenly, several demigods and hundreds of Legendary beings appeared within the Dwarves’ warships!
At this moment, a Dwarf demigod with a goatee and glaring eyes snorted coldly.
"Trash from the Abyss Realm! How dare you come to the Holy Spirit Realm to wreak havoc!"
"Mighty warriors of the Dwarf Race, slaughter them all!"
With these words, the powerful beings from both sides instantly engaged in battle.
On this battlefield, the combined number of Legendary and demigod-level powerhouses already exceeded a thousand.
In such a terrifying grand melee, strange phenomena continuously appeared in the sky.
The Dwarf Race, being one of the three major races of the Holy Spirit Realm, naturally had no weak combat power.
Despite the greater number of Demon Race powerhouses.
With the firepower support from those warships in the rear, not only could they hold their ground, they could even gain the upper hand.
At the same time, more and more powerhouses from all the major races arrived.
They joined the various battle groups immediately.
This also relieved the immediate crisis for the Elf Race.
Seeing this, the distant Elf King sighed in relief.
The situation nearly collapsed entirely.
At that moment, a sinister laugh rang in his ears: "Elf King, where are you looking?"
As soon as the words fell, this high-tier demon covered in blood flames suddenly swung down the giant axe in its hand!
The swing of the axe brought a terrifying gust of wind.
The sky tens of thousands of miles ahead was directly torn apart!
The Elf King merely snorted coldly and then casually launched a beam of white light!
"Puff!"
The demon’s chest instantly bore a bloody hole, sent flying tens of thousands of meters.
The Elf King transformed into a stream of light, about to pursue the victory.
Two other high-tier demigod-level demons blocked him.
The Elf King frowned deeply but still engaged in entanglement with the two demons.
The Giant Axe Demon, who had been blasted away, wiped the bloodstains at the corner of its mouth.
With a bloodthirsty look in its eyes, it murmured.
"Elf King, truly strong!"
"If I could take him down, surely I’d earn the Emperor’s favor!"
"Perhaps I’d be directly rewarded with a Demon God’s Heart, enabling me to break through to the Demon God Realm!"
Thinking of this, the Giant Axe Demon charged again.
And it was even more frenzied than before!
Under the siege of three demons, the Elf King began to show signs of strain, being relentlessly forced backwards.
"Elf King, die for me!"
The Giant Axe Demon launched its mightiest strike.
Forcing the Elf King to fly backward tens of thousands of meters.
At that moment, a demon wielding a great sword suddenly appeared behind the Elf King.
Then slashed down with the sword.
"Bang!"
The Elf King was sent flying again.
At the same time, a demon barehanded also punched towards him!
The three demons formed a triangular formation, trapping the Elf King inside, forcing him to constantly defend passively.
At this moment.
A thunderous voice resounded.
"Miris, haven’t seen you in years, and you’ve become this weak?"
"Can’t you even handle three demons, being beaten into such a miserable state?"
At this moment, the eyes of the four powerhouses on the battlefield simultaneously turned to look.
To speak to the Elf King in such a manner, it must be a powerhouse of the same level.
They saw a short figure, yet exuding an aura of terrifying planetary Destruction!
"Dwarf King!"
The three demons exclaimed.
Indeed, this formidable being was none other than the mighty Dwarf King, Krumman.
Upon hearing the Dwarf King’s taunt, the Elf King glared at him but did not retort.
In truth, it wasn’t that the Elf King was too weak, but that these three enemies were too powerful.
Moreover, before being entangled by these demons, he had burst out several times, vanquishing hundreds of billions of monsters from the Abyss Realm.
This consumed a massive amount of his Divine Power and Physical Strength.
The Elf King said: "Krumman, stop wasting time, come over and help."
The Dwarf King chuckled lightly.
The next moment, he appeared directly in front of the Giant Axe Demon.
At this moment, the Giant Axe Demon slowly lowered its gaze.
With its towering hundred-meter frame, the Dwarf King standing before it was as small as a bug.
However, the Giant Axe Demon did not underestimate the opponent, speaking in a serious tone: "Another top demigod?"
"Interesting, if I could take you down, it would surely have the same effect as taking down the Elf King!"
"At that time, the Emperor will surely reward me!"
With these words, it swung its giant axe directly at the Dwarf King!
At this point, the Dwarf King casually glanced at it and said: "You know what?"
"I despise those who fight with axes the most."
The Giant Axe Demon showed some confusion in its eyes.
Yet, its axe swing was almost falling, seemingly about to cleave the Dwarf King in two.
At this moment, the Dwarf King suddenly extended a rough right hand.
Amidst the Great Demon Monarch’s horrified gaze, he fiercely grabbed the blade of the giant axe.
"Bang!"
The surrounding space was riddled with countless cracks, demonstrating the terror of the Giant Axe Demon’s strike!
The Giant Axe Demon felt as though it had struck an iron block with its axe.
A powerful recoil surged, blood seeping from its palm.
However, when it saw the tiny figure, holding its giant axe.
This Great Demon Monarch was dumbfounded.
Are you kidding me?
Blocking my giant axe bare-handed, how strong is this guy’s flesh body?

chapters.title: Chapter 763 - 427: Blood-Inviting Demon’s Arrival (Part 3)
paragraphs: It instinctively wanted to pull back the giant axe.
However, it found that its weapon seemed to be pressed by two mountains, no matter how hard it tried, it couldn’t pull it out.
The Great Demon Monarch’s eyes showed a look of bewilderment.
The Dwarf King glanced at it and said casually, "What’s wrong? Is that all the strength you’ve got? Didn’t you eat?"
Upon hearing this, a sense of shame and anger rose in the Great Demon Monarch’s heart.
The football-sized pupils instantly filled with bloodshot lines.
"So you dare to underestimate the great high-level demon!"
"Today, I’ll let you witness my might!"
As soon as the words fell, it beckoned with one hand, and a mass of purple flame directly enveloped its entire body!
"Demonic Flame, ignite!"
"Buzz!"
A terrifying energy fluctuation emerged from its body, and its aura skyrocketed rapidly.
At this moment, the Great Demon Monarch not only ignited all its demon blood, but also its will.
One could say that once the duration of these two states ends, it will be completely obliterated, dead beyond death!
However, the hefty price exchanged for immense power.
"Roar!"
It began to pull the giant axe from its hand with all its might.
The space emitted a cracking sound.
Everyone could feel how terrifying this demon’s power was at that moment!
However, despite burning everything.
That small figure still held its giant axe with one hand.
The Dwarf King also began to mobilize all his power, veins bulging, his entire body swelling two circles larger!
Merely by standing there, the two powerful beings shattered the sky within a radius of ten thousand miles with their contest of power!
Strong and powerful! Strong and powerful!
This is a contest truly belonging to the masculine!
Yet the final result seemed that the Dwarf King still had the upper hand.
The Giant Axe Demon suddenly spewed a mouthful of fresh blood, seemingly hurt due to excessive force.
The demon’s eyes showed a shocked expression, "How is this possible!?"
"I’ve already burned my body and soul, why am I still inferior to you?"
The Dwarf King did not explain but said casually, "You’ve finished your performance, so now it’s my turn!
As soon as he finished speaking, his figure disappeared instantly.
A strong sense of crisis arose in the Giant Axe Demon’s heart!
It instinctively stepped back.
However, the next moment.
The Dwarf King appeared directly under the demon’s nose.
Without giving it a chance to react.
He directly clenched his fist and smashed it down!
"Bang!"
"Crack!"
The space collapsed directly!
At this moment, the Great Demon Monarch felt as if it were struck by a planet, its consciousness went blank.
Its huge body was directly sent flying tens of thousands of meters!
When it still hadn’t reacted, the Dwarf King appeared in front of it once again.
Then, another punch was launched.
"Bang!"
The Great Demon Monarch was blasted away once more!
Next, came the Dwarf King’s unilateral ravaging.
The Great Demon Monarch was like a sandbag, being hammered back and forth.
In the face of absolute power suppression, it had no chance to resist.
If it weren’t for casting two forbidden techniques enhancing physical defense greatly, it might have been directly blown up by the Dwarf King by now!
Even so, the Great Demon Monarch was suffering greatly now.
Being pummeled by the Dwarf King so many times left all its bones fractured.
The demigod-level demon’s recovery ability made it quickly repair its bones.
But then they were shattered again by the Dwarf King!
After several rounds, this demon was already on the brink of death.
Even now, the Giant Axe Demon’s eyes were filled with disbelief.
It originally thought that after arriving in the Holy Spirit Realm, it could accomplish some earth-shattering feat.
Even if worse came to worst, burning its life cost, it intended to slay a few high-tier demigods.
Yet now, it was caught by this short figure, about to be ravaged to death.
Just as the Dwarf King was about to finish it off completely.
A massive number of abyssal monsters burst out from that distant giant teleportation array once more.
"Whoosh!
With the sound akin to a volcanic eruption.
Hundreds and thousands of billions of abyssal monsters covered the sky and sun.
Among them, there were even four beings not losing to the Giant Axe Demon in aura!
Another four high-tier demigod level demons.
The power of the Abyss Realm is truly unfathomable!
Those four high-tier demigod level demons, upon sensing the situation on the Dwarf King’s side, unhesitatingly ignited demon blood and charged towards them.
The Dwarf King’s desire to smash this high-tier demon was dashed.
Then, he was also tangled up by these demon monarchs.
At this moment.
He and the Elf King each faced three high-level demons burning demon blood.
Facing the frenzied attack from those demons, the Dwarf King also felt the kind of pressure the Elf King faced back then.
"Boom! Boom Boom Boom!"
The Dwarf King kept throwing punches, blasting these three demons away time and time again.
Yet they were relentless, charging up once more to surround the Dwarf King.
At this moment, the three high-level demons suddenly burst forth in unison, their aura rising dramatically.
"Hell Godslaying Slash!"
"Wild Flame!"
"Destructive Fist!"
Faced with the combined attack of the three high-tier demons, even the Dwarf King could only defend passively.
The next moment, he was directly blasted to the horizon.
Those three demons chased after instantly.
The Dwarf King’s face turned somewhat pale, it was obvious that the previous strike had dealt him significant injury.
The three high-tier demons had victory smiles in their eyes.
The intensity of their attacks grew even more ferocious, each strike aimed to kill!
And at this moment, the Dwarf King’s combat power was fully unleashed.
His iron-like fists struck out repeatedly, causing these demons to vomit blood again and again.
At this moment, after briefly breaking free from the encirclement of three demons, the Dwarf King quickly communicated, "Miris, how’s it going on your side, can you hold on?"
The Elf King quickly replied, "Still fine, can hold on for a bit longer."
After hearing, the Dwarf King asked, "Then I’ll leave these three guys to you, I’ll go destroy the abyss realm’s teleportation array, any problem?"
The Elf King rolled eyes at him and directly said, "I think you just want me dead."

And at this moment, the Dwarf King’s combat power was fully unleashed.
His iron-like fists struck out repeatedly, causing these demons to vomit blood again and again.
At this moment, after briefly breaking free from the encirclement of three demons, the Dwarf King quickly communicated, "Miris, how’s it going on your side, can you hold on?"
The Elf King quickly replied, "Still fine, can hold on for a bit longer."
After hearing, the Dwarf King asked, "Then I’ll leave these three guys to you, I’ll go destroy the abyss realm’s teleportation array, any problem?"
The Elf King rolled eyes at him and directly said, "I think you just want me dead."

chapters.title: Chapter 764 - 428: Ten Thousand Swords Unite, Strike!
paragraphs: The Elf King shot him a glance and said directly, "I think you want me dead."
What a joke!
The consecutive bursts had already drained him severely.
The Elf King was already feeling overwhelmed dealing with these three Great Demon Monarchs.
If three more came, the Elf King had no confidence he could withstand them.
After all, these Great Demon Monarchs, after igniting their Demon Blood, were almost as strong as them.
Taking on three was already the limit.
"Elf King, what are you looking at?"
Seizing the moment the Elf King got distracted, a Great Demon Monarch swung down with its giant sword, knocking the Elf King flying.
"Miris, you’re really useless," the Dwarf King criticized mercilessly.
The Elf King, knocked flying, quickly steadied himself.
The previous blow made his chest feel tight, and blood even spilled from the corner of his mouth.
But to avoid showing his weakness to the demons, the moment the blood appeared, the Elf King used Divine Power to evaporate it clean.
With a pale face, he said, "Krookum, I admit you’re a bit stronger than me."
"You hold off these six demons, and I’ll go destroy the Teleportation Array, alright?"
The Dwarf King, upon hearing that, straightforwardly refused, "No way."
"Why not?"
"Because I can’t beat that many demons either."
Seeing his straightforward admittance of weakness, the Elf King shot him another glance.
At this moment, the group of demons heard the Dwarf King’s voice, and laughed one by one, "Hahaha! So the Dwarf King finally admits he’s not as good as us!"
"Indeed, the Abyss Realm is the strongest!"
"The Holy Spirit Realm’s weaklings should be ruled by the great Demon Race!"
Ignoring the jeers of the demons, the Elf King asked again, "Krookum, where’s the Giant King? Why hasn’t he come over yet?"
"You ask me? How would I know?"
The Dwarf King said speechlessly, "You know I’ve never gotten along with that guy."
"And his temper is quite odd, who knows what he’s thinking,"
The Elf King also felt somewhat helpless; the Giant King’s temper was indeed odd.
Now, if his help was available, that Abyssal Teleportation Array would have been destroyed long ago.
However, the Elf King had sent a request for help to the Giant Race two months ago.
The other side neither replied nor refused.
To this day, not a single member of the Giant Race had come over.
The Elf King didn’t know what the Giant Race was doing.
Or rather, he wasn’t sure what the Giant Race’s stance was.
As he watched, the situation reached a stalemate.
Although all major races had already arrived at the center of the Elf Realm to participate in the battle,
it seemed they could still hold on.
But continuing like this would result in too many casualties!
Basically, for every four or five Legends from the Abyss Realm that died, one from the Holy Spirit Realm would also fall.
It didn’t seem like a loss.
But everyone knew that comparing the number of strong individuals with the Abyss Realm was suicide!
If that Teleportation Array wasn’t destroyed, even if they got through this time, the number of strong individuals in the Holy Spirit Realm would sharply decrease.
If the Abyss Realm organized a few more assaults of this level, the Holy Spirit Realm would have no hope of holding on.
Thinking of this, not only the Elf King,
but also the strong individuals from the major races on the field felt a growing sense of urgency.
This was just the first large-scale attack from the Abyss Realm and already left them feeling powerless.
If there was a full-scale invasion, how could the Holy Spirit Realm defend?
Moreover, the real top forces of the Abyss Realm hadn’t appeared yet.
They all knew that, apart from the Great Demon Monarchs with Demigod Level strength,
the Abyss Realm also harbored Demon Gods with Divine Level strength!
And not just one.
Only by comparison did they realize how vast the gap truly was.
At this time, the Dwarf King couldn’t help but curse, "Damn, we’ve been screwed by those guys again!"
"If they hadn’t monopolized all the rules, we wouldn’t be cut off from the path to the Divine Spirit!
"Those bastards taking up the latrine but not using it!"
At this moment, as if sensing the Dwarf King’s curses, angered lightning appeared once again in the sky!
However, the Dwarf King remained fearless, continuing to curse at the sky as he fought.
"What? Did I say something wrong?"
"On talent, I can have Divine Level combat power in the Demigod Realm."
"On effort, from birth, I’ve been at war!"
"If you hadn’t hoarded the rules, I would have long broken through to the Divine Realm, maybe even become a True God!"
"How many strong individuals capable of breaking through to the Divine Spirit Level has my lineage of Dwarf Kings produced?"
"But, they all stopped at the Demigod Realm, and after the Power of Rules was exhausted, they quickly declined and died."
"Is this the rule you’ve set?"
"Damn you! What do you take the Holy Spirit Realm for?"
The Dwarf King cursed relentlessly, without a care.
However, his words seemed to have touched upon a taboo!
Thunder roared in the sky, growing even angrier.
The Dwarf King’s eyes were wide with anger, almost wishing to charge into the sky and fight!
The Elf King consoled at this moment, "Krookum, forget it."
"Those guys won’t listen."
The Dwarf King also knew that the Elf King made sense, but couldn’t help feeling bouts of bitterness.
At this moment, both of them simultaneously felt a lonely sense of isolation.
The Dwarf King nodded, "I know, but even if they won’t listen, I want to curse a bit more!"
"Anyway, those guys can’t come over."
The Elf King chuckled.
Just then, his expression suddenly changed.
The Elf King saw the Demigod Demon, which had almost been beaten to death by the Dwarf King, suddenly reappear.

chapters.title: Chapter 765 - 428: Ten Thousand Swords Unite, Strike!
paragraphs: And wielding a giant axe, it suddenly slashed at the Dwarf King!
"Krookum, be careful!" the Elf King exclaimed!
However, the other three demons seemed to have anticipated this scene long ago.
They simultaneously unleashed their full Magic Power, trapping the Dwarf King tightly!
Behind, the aura of the Giant Axe Demon had already reached its peak!
This was its ultimate strike, sacrificing everything.
With this axe swing, the Giant Axe Demon would undoubtedly die!
Yet, it showed no sign of regret.
If it could take away a king from the Holy Spirit Realm before dying, it would be a deal of great profit!
Staring at the Dwarf King’s back, it excitedly shouted, "Dwarf King, die for me!"
"Godslaying Axe!"
The Dwarf King was about to break free but realized he was tightly suppressed by the other three demons!
"Damn it!"
Watching as the Giant Axe Demon’s Attack was about to fall on him.
For the first time, a look of panic appeared in the Dwarf King’s eyes.
"Krumman!" the Elf King exclaimed!
Everyone seemed to foresee the scene of the Dwarf King being split in half.
And at this critical moment.
A full moon suddenly appeared behind the Giant Axe Demon.
That full moon formed in an instant, sealing the Giant Axe Demon within it.
At this moment, both sides of the battlefield fell into a simultaneous standstill.
Both sides looked at each other with puzzled expressions.
From that full moon, they felt an extremely strong Sealing Power.
"Sealing Power, who is it?" the demons murmured.
At this point, they saw Han Xing and others floating in mid-air, manipulating Divine Power from afar.
"Humans? With only Legendary Level power?"
"To actually control a High-tier Demon of our race, how did you do it?"
The demons’ eyes filled with disbelief as they kept questioning.
The Dwarf King, seizing the moment when the demons were stunned, burst forth, breaking free.
He also saw Han Xing and others, his rugged face showing a look of surprise.
"Brother Han Xing!"
Han Xing also smiled and said, "Your Majesty the King, we meet again."
The Dwarf King looked at Han Xing, gratefully saying, "Brother Han Xing, you’ve helped me once again."
"I hereby thank you!"
"Your Majesty, no need for thanks,"
Han Xing smiled, "Fighting against the Abyss Realm is the duty of every being in the Holy Spirit Realm."
At this time, the demon sealed by Han Xing’s Broken Moon began to struggle.
The surface of the full moon was already covered with dense cracks.
"Crack! Crack!"
The sound of shattering continued to ring out.
Since Han Xing became stronger, the control Effect of Broken Moon also became stronger.
Previously, it could barely control a High-tier Legend, but now it could temporarily control even a top Demigod Level existence.
It shows the terrifying extent of Han Xing’s transformation.
Han Xing then said, "Your Majesty, now is not the time for reminiscing. We should handle the current battle."
"I’ll take care of that seriously injured demon, and you hold off the others, okay?"
Upon hearing this, not only the Dwarf King and Elf King but even the other six High-tier Demons showed some surprise.
Although the Giant Axe Demon was heavily injured by the Dwarf King.
Han Xing and his group were only of Legendary Level.
The gap with a Demigod was vast, not to mention a top Demigod.
Even though the Dwarf King knew Han Xing and the others were strong, a trace of doubt and concern arose in his heart.
However, the current situation did not allow him to hesitate.
One of the demons sneered and said, "Brothers, hold off the Dwarf King and Elf King."
"Since these humans are courting death, wanting to challenge Mikhailovic, let them seek their doom!"
"When Mikhailovic finishes, he’ll come back to eliminate the Dwarf King and Elf King."
Upon hearing this, the other demons nodded in agreement.
Meanwhile, the demon trapped by Han Xing’s Broken Moon was about to break free.
The cracks on the Broken Moon were increasing.
At this time, everyone directly entered a battle State.
"Clang!"
Shen Yun directly raised the Holy Hammer, and a beam of Holy Light exploded into the air.
In an instant, everyone felt a strong amplification Effect.
Then, beside Cheng Jianyong, a massive amount of Sword Qi appeared instantly.
It was the new Legendary Skill he acquired — Divine Ghost Swordsmanship: Ten Thousand Swords Cross!
"Swoosh! Swish swish swish!"
As Cheng Jianyong slashed his sword, at least a hundred terrifyingly powerful Sword Qi simultaneously slashed toward the full moon.
Including Han Xing, who also activated the State, and released Dragon-Hunting Arrow Skill madly!
Rumble!
Meteor Technique, Elf Archery.
Various Attacks struck the full moon.
The cracks became more apparent.
In less than 0.1 seconds, it completely shattered!
"Boom!"
Terrifying energy from the full moon began to rage.
When the explosion ended, the demon of High-tier Demigod Level strength still hadn’t died.
But it had sustained extremely serious injuries.
The Giant Axe Demon took a deep breath, relief flashing in its eyes after surviving.
It looked at Han Xing and the others with a Bloodthirsty gaze.
"You human ants, I almost died at your hands!"
"Interesting, but now, it’s my turn!"
As it finished speaking, the demon charged forward.
At this moment.
A terrifying pressure suddenly burst forth from Shen Yun.
"Roar!"
Like an Ancient Fierce Beast waking up, causing the demon’s heart to tremble uncontrollably.
And more terrifyingly, it found its body seemed out of control, constantly shaking, with its mobility greatly reduced.

chapters.title: Chapter 766 - 428: Ten Thousand Swords Unite, Slash!
paragraphs: This skill is the divine-level effect on Shen Yun’s divine artifact shield.

[Beast of Calamity]: Divine-level effect, releases a Breath of Calamity, forcing all enemies into a fear state, reducing defense by 10%~50%, and decreasing mobility by 50%~80% (maximum effect on divine-level creatures).
At the same time.
The collective attack once again descended like a storm!
A meteor as vast as a planet fell directly from the sky.
Zhang Lianmeng’s Meteorite Technique triggered the [Magnifying Glass] effect on the divine artifact necklace, expanding the attack range several times over!
Han Xing and Su Xiaoyang, during this time, shot out arrows madly.
Each arrow contained a terrifying attack power capable of critically wounding a middle-tier demigod.
However, the most exaggerated was Cheng Jianyong.
He was already in the [Divine Ghost Archery: Sword Qi Cross] state.
At this moment, he leapt high into the air.
In that instant, everyone saw the floating sword qi all around converging into his great sword.
"Ten Thousand Swords Unite! Slash!"
"Swish!"
This was a combined strike of all five.
The power that burst forth already surpassed the demigod limit, vaguely reaching that level.
At this moment, that Giant Axe Demon was already in a severely injured state, further reducing its mobility significantly.
Facing this strike, it felt a sense of deathly crisis enveloping its entire being!
As the attack was about to arrive.
The demon roared in unwilling anger.
Boom!
This strike changed the color of the world.
It even outshone the Elf King at his most radiant moment.
On the entire battlefield, all the strong felt a pang of dread in their hearts.
Their gazes turned involuntarily towards this spot.
When the terrifying energy fluctuation disappeared.
The body of the Great Demon Monarch had been blasted into ash, vanishing without a trace.
A massive soul, the largest in recorded history, rose and automatically drifted towards Ten Thousand Stars City in the distance.
At the same time, everyone heard a system notification in their ears.

[Successfully killed Great Demon Monarch: Mikhailovic, high-tier demigod level creature, gained 1023 billion experience points, automatically absorbed the divine power from the opponent, divine power value +100]
[Due to your outstanding performance this time, all team members receive +50 legendary points]
At this moment, six Great Demon Monarchs, along with two rulers of the Holy Spirit Realm, were left in a daze watching this scene.
They even forgot about the battle at hand.
Simply because what Han Xing and the others accomplished was shockingly unprecedented.
A group of legendary-level humans had indeed taken down this demon with high-tier legendary power!
And it seemed without much effort!
This was completely beyond their imagination.
At this moment, the group of demons reacted.
They shouted angrily: "Damn!"
"These humans killed Mikhailovic; they are likely the era’s chosen ones the Emperor spoke of!"
"Let’s charge together; we must kill these humans, or there will be endless trouble!"
Upon hearing these words, all the demons on the scene immediately turned grim.
They seemed to realize the seriousness of the situation.
Compared to the record of these few humans, killing a top demigod, the ’era’s chosen ones’ mentioned by the Demon Emperor was something they took even more seriously.
For a moment, those demons even directly abandoned their current opponents, intending to rush towards Han Xing and the others.
However, the Dwarf King scoffed, "You guys, take care of yourselves!"
"Do you think we don’t exist?"
With that, he unleashed his full combat power.
His big fists continuously pounded, making the three high-level demons cough up blood.
On the other side, as the Elf King’s opponent turned around, he suddenly activated a secret technique.
Three beams of white light shot out, directly piercing through the opponent’s body.
"Puff puff puff!
The demons simultaneously spat blood.
They turned around in anger.
"Sneaky!"
"Despicable!"
The Elf King shrugged, feeling no emotion inside.
The two rulers held their opponents at bay, and victory began to tilt in their favor.
However, the huge teleportation array in the distance continued to transport a large number of abyssal creatures, endlessly.
Han Xing also noticed the problem at hand.
If that huge teleportation array isn’t destroyed, the abyss demons will keep appearing.
Unless Han Xing uses Ten Thousand Stars City to launch a direct bombardment.
Otherwise, the strong from the Holy Spirit Realm will be exhausted by the monsters of the Abyss Realm.
Thinking of this, Han Xing suddenly said: "Elf King, Dwarf King, keep holding your opponents."
"We’ll go and destroy the Abyssal Teleportation Array first."
If Han Xing had said this before, the two rulers would not have believed it at all.
But now, they’ve witnessed firsthand the terrifying strength of these humans.
At this moment, they nodded, saying, "Go ahead, Saint Master Han Xing, wish you success."
"Han Xing, my brother, don’t worry, once I crush these three demons, I’ll come and help you!"
Han Xing nodded.
Then he led his team straight towards the center of the huge teleportation array.
All the monsters encountered along the way were instantly killed by Han Xing and Zhang Lianmeng.
With their current attack power, unless they encounter a demigod, there is basically no creature that can withstand their strike!
Soon, they reached the central area.
About a hundred kilometers away from the teleportation array.
This huge teleportation array was built at a great cost by the Abyss Race.
Having mobilized seven high-tier demigods in succession showed that the Abyss Realm certainly wouldn’t let this teleportation array be destroyed by the Holy Spirit Realm.
Even from over a hundred kilometers away, Han Xing and the others could see the defense near the core.
There was a strong demon squad stationed there.
Even a few middle-tier demigod level Great Demon Monarchs...

At this moment, that Giant Axe Demon was already in a severely injured state, further reducing its mobility significantly.
Facing this strike, it felt a sense of deathly crisis enveloping its entire being!
As the attack was about to arrive.
The demon roared in unwilling anger.
Boom!
This strike changed the color of the world.
It even outshone the Elf King at his most radiant moment.
On the entire battlefield, all the strong felt a pang of dread in their hearts.
Their gazes turned involuntarily towards this spot.
When the terrifying energy fluctuation disappeared.
The body of the Great Demon Monarch had been blasted into ash, vanishing without a trace.
A massive soul, the largest in recorded history, rose and automatically drifted towards Ten Thousand Stars City in the distance.
At the same time, everyone heard a system notification in their ears.

[Successfully killed Great Demon Monarch: Mikhailovic, high-tier demigod level creature, gained 1023 billion experience points, automatically absorbed the divine power from the opponent, divine power value +100]
[Due to your outstanding performance this time, all team members receive +50 legendary points]
At this moment, six Great Demon Monarchs, along with two rulers of the Holy Spirit Realm, were left in a daze watching this scene.
They even forgot about the battle at hand.
Simply because what Han Xing and the others accomplished was shockingly unprecedented.
A group of legendary-level humans had indeed taken down this demon with high-tier legendary power!
And it seemed without much effort!
This was completely beyond their imagination.
At this moment, the group of demons reacted.
They shouted angrily: "Damn!"
"These humans killed Mikhailovic; they are likely the era’s chosen ones the Emperor spoke of!"
"Let’s charge together; we must kill these humans, or there will be endless trouble!"
Upon hearing these words, all the demons on the scene immediately turned grim.
They seemed to realize the seriousness of the situation.
Compared to the record of these few humans, killing a top demigod, the ’era’s chosen ones’ mentioned by the Demon Emperor was something they took even more seriously.
For a moment, those demons even directly abandoned their current opponents, intending to rush towards Han Xing and the others.
However, the Dwarf King scoffed, "You guys, take care of yourselves!"
"Do you think we don’t exist?"
With that, he unleashed his full combat power.
His big fists continuously pounded, making the three high-level demons cough up blood.
On the other side, as the Elf King’s opponent turned around, he suddenly activated a secret technique.
Three beams of white light shot out, directly piercing through the opponent’s body.
"Puff puff puff!
The demons simultaneously spat blood.
They turned around in anger.
"Sneaky!"
"Despicable!"
The Elf King shrugged, feeling no emotion inside.
The two rulers held their opponents at bay, and victory began to tilt in their favor.
However, the huge teleportation array in the distance continued to transport a large number of abyssal creatures, endlessly.
Han Xing also noticed the problem at hand.
If that huge teleportation array isn’t destroyed, the abyss demons will keep appearing.
Unless Han Xing uses Ten Thousand Stars City to launch a direct bombardment.
Otherwise, the strong from the Holy Spirit Realm will be exhausted by the monsters of the Abyss Realm.
Thinking of this, Han Xing suddenly said: "Elf King, Dwarf King, keep holding your opponents."
"We’ll go and destroy the Abyssal Teleportation Array first."
If Han Xing had said this before, the two rulers would not have believed it at all.
But now, they’ve witnessed firsthand the terrifying strength of these humans.
At this moment, they nodded, saying, "Go ahead, Saint Master Han Xing, wish you success."
"Han Xing, my brother, don’t worry, once I crush these three demons, I’ll come and help you!"
Han Xing nodded.
Then he led his team straight towards the center of the huge teleportation array.
All the monsters encountered along the way were instantly killed by Han Xing and Zhang Lianmeng.
With their current attack power, unless they encounter a demigod, there is basically no creature that can withstand their strike!
Soon, they reached the central area.
About a hundred kilometers away from the teleportation array.
This huge teleportation array was built at a great cost by the Abyss Race.
Having mobilized seven high-tier demigods in succession showed that the Abyss Realm certainly wouldn’t let this teleportation array be destroyed by the Holy Spirit Realm.
Even from over a hundred kilometers away, Han Xing and the others could see the defense near the core.
There was a strong demon squad stationed there.
Even a few middle-tier demigod level Great Demon Monarchs...

chapters.title: Chapter 767 - 429: Combined Strike, Heaven and Earth Destruction
paragraphs: The mission of these Demon Guard Army members is to prevent all creatures from the Holy Spirit Realm from approaching that Teleportation Array.
Han Xing considered letting Coal Ball get close.
But Coal Ball’s ability to escape into the void only hides its form, and once it starts attacking that Teleportation Array, it will still be detected.
Without planning to use Ten Thousand Stars City, Han Xing decided to lead the team straight through.
Along the way, they encountered a large number of Abyssal Monsters blocking their path.
However, they quickly annihilated them all with their bomber-like destructive power.
Including the team members, they had all cleared Abyssal Rifts countless times.
They were already thoroughly familiar with the attack methods of these monsters.
Without even looking, they could directly grasp the attack methods of those Abyssal Monsters.
In less than a minute, they charged into the central area of the Abyssal Teleportation Array.
The defending forces from the Abyss Realm stationed here fell into chaos.
At the same time, the strong ones on the nearby battlefield also noticed this new force.
Those few individuals had actually rushed to the center of the Teleportation Array.
Only one step remained to destroy the Teleportation Array.
Various strong individuals had somewhat bewildered looks in their eyes, seemingly not knowing where these strong ones came from.
However, they soon saw the man holding a bow and arrow.
Immediately, they knew the other party’s identity.
"These people seem to be from the Human Race!"
"That man is the contemporary Master of the Human Race?"
"So strong! They’ve already charged to this place!"
At this moment, Han Xing looked at the demon squad blocking his way.
Without any hesitation, he directly said to the team members, "Activate all states, make it quick!"
Everyone nodded simultaneously.
Then, one special effect after another on their bodies crazily activated.
In a mere moment, their aura broke through the Legendary Limit, reaching the Demigod Realm.
And it continued to climb, stopping only upon reaching the middle-tier Demigod level.
However, this was not the end!
Han Xing’s gaze sharpened.
In the next moment,
within a range of over a thousand kilometers, the scenery suddenly changed!
From the Holy Spirit Realm’s battlefield, they instantly arrived in a gray world, with countless broken weapons stuck in the ground.
It was Han Xing’s ultimate skill—Endless Arrow Prison!
At this moment, panic appeared in the eyes of those demons, puzzled by the changing surroundings.
"Be careful, these humans are peculiar!"
"It was them who just killed our high-level demon!"
Upon hearing this, the demons’ eyes grew more vigilant.
As Han Xing released the first arrow, the battle officially began!
The opponents were at least five middle-tier Demigod level demons, fifteen initial-tier Demigods, along with dozens of Legends!
This kind of force would require an entire race to contend with.
But Han Xing’s group only had five people.
"Boom!"
The Dragon-Hunting Arrow Skill combined with Endless Arrow Prison instantly triggered a tremendous explosion!
A few Legendary level demons, unable to dodge, were killed on the spot!
[Successfully killed Abyss Demon: Salazar, middle-tier Legendary creature, gaining 4.794 billion experience value, Divine Power Value +5]
[Successfully killed Abyss Demon: Vasquez, high-tier Legendary creature, gaining 7.823 billion experience value, Divine Power Value +10]
[Successfully killed...]
A total of 5 Legendary level demons were killed, adding over 20 billion experience value, which was quite a nice reward.
As for the Divine Power Value increasing by just a few points each time.
In the past, it might have excited Han Xing.
But since experiencing the World Tree’s blessing effect, Han Xing no longer felt anything from these few points of Divine Power Value.
At this moment, suddenly attacked, the group of demons angrily shouted, "Attack together, tear them apart!"
And just then,
Huge meteor firestorm suddenly appeared in the sky.
"Boom! Rumble!"
Zhang Lianmeng’s forbidden curse, under her more than ten ten thousand Spiritual Power boost and all effects fully activated,
each meteor firestorm already had the power of Meteor Technique!
Those demons immediately sensed the horror of these fire rains, exclaiming angrily, "Damn it! Block it with all your might!"
All demons gave up the attack, switching to a dodging state.
They didn’t intend to withstand it head-on.
Under the might of the Heaven-Burning Fire Rain, the demons completely lost their combat power.
However, the few middle-tier Demigod strength demons on the field were unaffected.
Relying on their robust flesh bodies, they advanced against the skyfire and rain.
In fact, whether Legendary Realm or Demigod Realm, they were divided into initial, middle, and high tiers.
The gap between each stage was enormous, and rarely would an initial tier defeat a middle or even high tier.
Han Xing’s group was just an exception.
At this moment, seeing those middle-tier demons charging them, Shen Yun unhesitatingly raised his shield and charged out!
"Attack together, tear them apart!"
The demons showed no hesitation or complacency, all attacks aimed simultaneously at Shen Yun!
The terrifying Power of the Demon surged.
"Bang! Bang bang bang!"
Shen Yun was hit repeatedly, the powerful recoil making his face turn pale again and again.
And just then, Han Xing said, "Cheng Jianyong, go assist Shen Yun."
"Your task is to hold off these few middle-tier Demigod demons, any problems?"
"No problem!" Cheng Jianyong quickly replied.
Then, his form flashed, directly arriving beside Shen Yun, assisting him in combat.
They were to rely on the power of two to hold off these five middle-tier Demigod demons.
Meanwhile, Han Xing’s group focused all firepower on the group of Legendary-level demons!

chapters.title: Chapter 768 - 429: Combined Strike, Heaven and Earth Destruction
paragraphs: They must kill all these demons as quickly as possible.
Meanwhile, Su Xiaoyang was observing the situation and providing support to both battlefields.
"Boom! Rumble!"
In less than two seconds,
Under the bombardment of [Heaven-Burning Fire Rain] and [Endless Arrow Prison], more than a dozen Legendary Demons were reduced to ashes on the spot.
The system notifications kept flooding the screen.
Seeing the rapidly increasing Divine Power Value, joy appeared in Han Xing’s eyes!
Then, he started to pull the bowstring even faster.
The demons, seeing the arrows flying toward them, already had a foreboding feeling.
Then, before they could react,
the Dragon-Hunting Arrow Skill triggered an earth-shattering explosion!
Each demon was devoured by the terrifying energy waves.
More and more demons fell, including even two Initial-tier Demigod level demons.
Those five Middle-tier Demigod level demons nearby were anxious.
They couldn’t just watch that human slaughter them.
At this rate, it wouldn’t take long before this demon squad was wiped out by them.
"Charge over quickly! Interrupt that human!" the demons urgently shouted.
However, no matter how hard they tried, that human with a shield was like an insurmountable mountain, always blocking their way.
This made the demons feel a slight sense of helplessness.
A few seconds passed.
The duration of [Heaven-Burning Fire Rain] ended.
Yet, the number of demons had been reduced by at least half.
Looking at the corpses of their companions, a chill rose in the hearts of the remaining demons.
They seemed to realize how troublesome these humans were.
If this continued, they would be unable to complete the mission given by their superiors.
This Teleportation Array would also be destroyed by those humans.
The demons exchanged glances, then nodded.
"Everyone, we have no choice!"
"These humans are too strong; at this rate, the Teleportation Array will inevitably be destroyed by them!
"For the Emperor’s plan, sacrifice your lives!"
Upon hearing this, the other demons had no hesitation and shouted in unison, "For the Emperor!"
"Blood-Inviting Demon’s Arrival!"
With these words,
over thirty demons remaining on the battlefield simultaneously used this life-burning Forbidden Technique!
Their momentum began to rise rapidly!
Especially those five Middle-tier Demigod level demons, who now even possessed High-tier Demigod strength!
Han Xing frowned slightly.
The demons of the Abyss Realm were indeed a bit troublesome.
Not only did they possess combat power and physical strength surpassing those of the same tier in the Holy Spirit Realm,
but at the moment of life and death, they could also use such a Secret Technique to explode, achieving a cross-tier battle.
Han Xing took a deep breath and said, "Don’t hold back, unleash your strongest attack to annihilate them."
Everyone understood.
The next moment, a Void fluctuation appeared.
The world, originally covered by the Endless Arrow Prison, suddenly had a Void area appear out of nowhere.
The Void directly shrouded those Middle-tier Demons.
Then, a series of songs rang in everyone’s ears.
Holy white light descended, and a phantom of a Six-winged Archangel descended from the sky.
At this moment, the demons were simultaneously forced into a blind state.
"Damn it! I can’t see!"
"I can’t see either, it’s those humans who did it!"
At the same time,
a colossal planet was descending from the sky.
Yes, an actual planet!
On it, various meteor craters and mountains could be seen.
This skill was none other than Zhang Lianmeng’s other Legendary Skill: Star Burst!
At this moment, Han Xing also shot an arrow into the sky.
An endless meteor shower of destruction fell.
Moreover, Su Xiaoyang activated the [Nature’s Fury] state.
At the instant that planet descended, it detonated!
"Rumble!"
This was indeed the power of planetary destruction.
The tremendous impact caused the sky for a radius of millions of miles to tremble.
Then, the attacks of the other team members also fell one after another.
This piece of heaven and earth was instantly enveloped by surging energy.
Whether one was a Legend or a Demigod, upon contact with this energy, death was inevitable!
One could say that the power of this strike had completely exceeded when they focused fire that High-tier Demon before!
All the powerhouses couldn’t help but cast their gaze, staring blankly at this scene.
And at the center of the Teleportation Array, an energy vortex even appeared.
The endless roars of the demons echoed from within!
If it wasn’t witnessed firsthand, they would never believe it; this was the commotion caused by several humans with Legendary Powers!
"Rumble!"
As the energy storm subsided,
the vortex gradually stalled.
At this moment, powerhouses of various races simultaneously stopped their actions, staring blankly at the explosion center.
However, they could no longer see the figures of those demons.
At this time, a crazy thought suddenly rose in the hearts of the surrounding powerhouses.
Could it be... those demons were one-shot killed by them?
At the moment this thought appeared, a chill ran down the spine of every powerhouse!
Are you kidding me? That was over a hundred Legends, plus more than a dozen Demigods!
In just one concentrated attack, they were actually all killed instantly on the spot!
This was beyond everyone’s imagination.
This scene directly plunged the entire battlefield of the Central Realm into a halt.
Even the Elf King and the Dwarf King forgot about their opponents in front of them.
At this moment, the Dwarf King suddenly shook his head and smiled, "Brother Han Xing, you really can repeatedly refresh my understanding!"
"Originally, I thought they being able to take down a Top Demigod was already frightening enough!"
"Now it seems, this isn’t even their limit."

chapters.title: Chapter 769 - 429: Combined Strike, Heaven and Earth Destruction
paragraphs: "I really don’t know how many hidden cards Han Xing has up his sleeve, or where his limits truly lie."
The Elf King beside him nodded in agreement.
Then, seizing the moment when the three Demons were stunned, he launched another attack.
"Splat! Splat! Splat!"
The three Demons coughed up blood again, angrily saying, "Elf King! Despicable!"
The Elf King ignored them; having gained the upper hand, he became relentless.
He pressed these three High-level Demons with a frenzied attack!
At this moment.
Han Xing and the others looked at the screenful of system prompts, a strong joy evident in their eyes.
In this burst, they had wiped out at least over a billion Abyssal Monsters, including over a hundred Legends, plus a dozen Demigods, and five Middle-tier Demigods.
Rough estimates.
They had just gained over 10 trillion Experience Points.
Although these Experience Points were useless for Han Xing and the others, they also received 470 Divine Power Value and 120 Legendary Points as rewards!
Furthermore, the Soul Value of the Demon Furnace had surpassed 20 billion.
This was also a tremendous gain.
Now, there was only a huge Hexagram Array left on the field, flickering with red light.
And there was no Demon guarding it anymore.
This meant that Han Xing and the others could destroy this Teleportation Array at any time.
At the same time, the attributes of this Teleportation Array appeared in front of Han Xing.
[Abyss Realm One-Way Teleportation Array (Top Level)]
[Defense Value]: 10 million.
By this time, the nearby Demons had also reacted.
They shouted in panic, "Rush over quickly!"
"Stop those Humans, we mustn’t let them destroy the Teleportation Array!"
All the Abyssal Monsters began to charge desperately, doing everything they could to stop Han Xing and the others from destroying the Teleportation Array.
However, Han Xing and the others would absolutely not give them any opportunity.
The 10 million points of Defense Value on the Teleportation Array seemed like a lot.
But with the terrifying Attack Power of Han Xing and the others, those 10 million points of Defense Value would last less than a minute!
"Whoosh! Whoosh whoosh!
"Boom! Boom boom!"
Arrows and Large Fireballs rained down like a barrage of cannon fire.
Under the horrified eyes of the Abyssal Monsters.
They watched as the Hexagram Array began to show dense cracks.
A few seconds later, those cracks covered its whole structure.
A few more seconds, and it collapsed directly!
At the same time.
This gigantic Teleportation Array, with a diameter of over several hundred thousand kilometers, disappeared.
The pillar of red light abruptly ceased.
The Abyssal Monsters seemed to lose their energy source, a look of desolation in their eyes.
"Damn Humans... they’ve ruined our grand plan in the Abyss Realm!"
"Hateful! We were so close!"
Their gaze toward Han Xing and the others was filled with deep-seated hatred.
On the other hand, in the Holy Spirit Realm, all the strong warriors had the glow of victory in their eyes!
They shouted excitedly, "The Teleportation Array is destroyed, it’s time to counterattack!"
"Everyone, follow us and charge out!"
"These Demons don’t have reinforcements anymore, kill them all!"
"Kill!"
The shouts of battle filled the sky.
The Abyssal Monsters grew increasingly desperate.
Even the six Abyssal Demons fighting the Elf King and Dwarf King looked somewhat frustrated.
Clearly, the situation had been in their favor.
Yet, with the sudden appearance of these few Humans, they crushed their lifeline with overwhelming force.
"Damn! How did these few Humans suddenly appear?" a High-level Demon wielding a Great Sword shouted angrily.
The voice was filled with intense unwillingness.
Another Demon said solemnly, "I reckon these people are probably what the Emperor referred to as the Children of the World...
"The Children of the World are a choice of the era, beings sensed by the Holy Spirit Realm in times of great crisis."
"Wherever the Children of the World are, they are almost always victorious, turning the tide in adversity..."
However, Han Xing and the others knew nothing about so-called Children of the World.
They never needed to reverse a losing game, always winning with the wind at their backs.
Defeating those Demons didn’t even force them to use their full strength.
The Demon continued with a furrowed brow, "This can’t go on."
"I hope the Emperor can sense what’s happening here and send stronger Demons to kill these Humans!"
However, the voice of the Dwarf King suddenly rang in their ears.
"Dare to get distracted while fighting with me?"
As he spoke, the Dwarf King’s fist, as large as a cauldron, came crashing down.
A High-level Demon failed to dodge in time and took a solid punch to the chest.
"Thud!"
A dull sound of flesh echoed, and a horrifying blood hole appeared in the chest of the Demon!
It looked at the Dwarf King in disbelief and said, "You’re also hiding your strength? Is this your true power?"
The Dwarf King gave no response, delivering a punch that sent it flying!
However, with the Dwarf King unleashing his full power, punch after punch, he made the remaining two Demons spit blood continuously.
All these Demons were dumbfounded by the sudden outburst of the Dwarf King.
Even on the side of the Elf King, the situation changed dramatically, becoming reinvigorated and energetic, as if injected with vitality.
"Whoosh! Whoosh whoosh!"
White-hot light continuously burst forth, and the might exhibited by the Elf King at this time even surpassed the Dwarf King.
He struck the Demons with blood holes appearing on their bodies, some even facing imminent demise.
The Dwarf King looked at the Elf King’s performance in wonder, unable to resist cursing, "You old fox, still pretending to be weak."
"Damn, I think I’ve seen this move before?"
The Elf King explained, "A kind of Secret Technique, can’t last long, don’t worry Krookum."
However, at this moment, the Dwarf King was no longer willing to believe his nonsense.
The Elf King always said this, but would always pull out new tricks at the last moment.
Krookum had known the Elf King for so many years and still didn’t know his true strength.
In fact, even the Dwarf King himself had not shown his full power.
For example, his best weapon, the [Hammer of Storms], had not been brought out yet.

The Elf King beside him nodded in agreement.

"Splat!

Splat!"
The three Demons coughed up blood again, angrily saying, "Elf King!

The Elf King ignored them; having gained the upper hand, he became relentless.
He pressed these three High-level Demons with a frenzied attack!
At this moment.
Han Xing and the others looked at the screenful of system prompts, a strong joy evident in their eyes.
In this burst, they had wiped out at least over a billion Abyssal Monsters, including over a hundred Legends, plus a dozen Demigods, and five Middle-tier Demigods.
Rough estimates.
They had just gained over 10 trillion Experience Points.
Although these Experience Points were useless for Han Xing and the others, they also received 470 Divine Power Value and 120 Legendary Points as rewards!
Furthermore, the Soul Value of the Demon Furnace had surpassed 20 billion.
This was also a tremendous gain.
Now, there was only a huge Hexagram Array left on the field, flickering with red light.
And there was no Demon guarding it anymore.
This meant that Han Xing and the others could destroy this Teleportation Array at any time.
At the same time, the attributes of this Teleportation Array appeared in front of Han Xing.
[Abyss Realm One-Way Teleportation Array (Top Level)]
[Defense Value]: 10 million.

They shouted in panic, "Rush over quickly!"
"Stop those Humans, we mustn’t let them destroy the Teleportation Array!"

The 10 million points of Defense Value on the Teleportation Array seemed like a lot.
But with the terrifying Attack Power of Han Xing and the others, those 10 million points of Defense Value would last less than a minute!
"Whoosh!
Whoosh whoosh!
"Boom!
Boom boom!"
Arrows and Large Fireballs rained down like a barrage of cannon fire.
Under the horrified eyes of the Abyssal Monsters.

A few seconds later, those cracks covered its whole structure.
A few more seconds, and it collapsed directly!
At the same time.
This gigantic Teleportation Array, with a diameter of over several hundred thousand kilometers, disappeared.
The pillar of red light abruptly ceased.
The Abyssal Monsters seemed to lose their energy source, a look of desolation in their eyes.

"Hateful!
We were so close!"
Their gaze toward Han Xing and the others was filled with deep-seated hatred.
On the other hand, in the Holy Spirit Realm, all the strong warriors had the glow of victory in their eyes!

"Everyone, follow us and charge out!"
"These Demons don’t have reinforcements anymore, kill them all!"
"Kill!"

chapters.title: Chapter 770 - 430: The Demon God Descends!
paragraphs: The[Hammer of Storms]is a sacred artifact weapon exclusive to the Dwarf Race.
The Dwarf King in possession of the sacred artifact is the most terrifying.
At this moment, the Dwarf King is completely relying on his formidable flesh body to suppress his opponents.
However, those Demons burning their Demon Blood won’t survive much longer either.
As long as we hold out until their secret technique’s duration ends.
So, there’s no need to reveal all our trump cards right now.
Sure enough, once the teleportation array was destroyed and the Abyssal Army had no new forces replenishing, the tide began to turn.
Abyssal monsters were being slaughtered in droves, and seeing the end of the line,
even the Dwarf King felt his opponents were weakening.
A smile appeared at the corner of his mouth.
Because it signaled that the enemy’s burst period was nearly over.
Meanwhile, Han Xing heard a strange system notification.
[You destroyed the Abyss Realm One-Way Teleportation Array (Top Level), successfully defending the Holy Spirit Realm. Your heroic actions are commended, and you’ve received World Mark *10 layers.]
Han Xing looked at this system notification strangely.
At the same time, his status bar indeed had a new[World Mark]effect.
However, there was no description or attributes on it.
Han Xing didn’t know what this thing was for.
Shaking his head, taking advantage of Shen Yun’s buff still being active, he seized the moment and began crazily slaughtering those Abyssal monsters.
Due to the characteristics of the Endless Arrow Prison, as long as he kills enemies, he can extend the skill’s duration.
And in a battlefield teeming with enemies, Han Xing could essentially maintain the Endless Arrow Prison state throughout, with his attack power soaring significantly.
After all, a 500% attack power boost is no joke.
At this moment, he was indeed like a bulldozer.
Abyssal monsters along the way were slaughtered in droves.
Everyone once again felt the thrill experienced when rapidly clearing an Abyssal Rift.
Unfortunately, they’ve reached the level limit and can no longer gain experience.
But that’s okay.
After all, by killing these monsters, the Demon Furnace can also extract the souls from their bodies.
These souls can be refined into crystals, increasing Han Xing’s Divine Power Value, which also enhances his strength.
No matter how you calculate it, he isn’t losing out.
With this in mind, Han Xing put more effort into slaughtering the Abyssal monsters.
"Boom! Boom!"
The Dwarf Race’s warship continued bombing relentlessly.
Mushroom clouds rose en masse.
Although it was nighttime, it lit up as bright as day,
Ten minutes later.
As they watched, the number of Abyssal monsters dwindled.
Including the Dwarf King and Elf King’s opponents, those high-tier Demon Venerables had already been blown up twice.
With the Abyss Realm’s large-scale invasion seeing its end,
even the remaining four high-tier Demigods felt a sense of despair.
They even contemplated imitating the Giant Axe Demon, igniting their Divine Thought in a final desperate burst.
However, the Elf King and Dwarf King had long been prepared for this.
At the slightest movement, they would deliver a powerful strike without hesitation to break it.
These four high-tier Demigods grew ever more despairing.
Just as they were about to be annihilated,
suddenly, from afar, the sky once again revealed a soaring teleportation array.
Compared to the kingdom’s central teleportation array, it was slightly smaller, but still quite large.
At this moment, a surging tide of monsters emerged from the teleportation array again.
Countless Abyssal monsters burst forth from the teleportation array.
Among them, besides a large number of Legends and Demigods.
They even sensed two demons with auras reaching high-tier Demigod level!
The Abyss Realm’s monsters had hope rekindled in their eyes.
The Giant Sword Demon rejoiced, "Indeed, Emperor has more in reserve!"
"Holy Spirit Realm! It’s not so easy to drive us away!"
The other demons also rallied, one by one shouting crazily, "The Emperor is watching us."
"Charge with me and shred them apart!"
As the Elf King fought and saw the teleportation array’s location, a foreboding feeling crept into his heart.
Upon seeing the demons directly charging toward a specific location as soon as they appeared, he was suddenly shocked.
He urgently shouted, "Damn! These demons are heading to attack our sacred land!"
"Everyone, quickly block them, don’t let them reach the sacred land and damage the World Tree!"
The other Holy Spirit Realm powerhouses, having never heard of the sacred land,
were unsure why the Elf King reacted so strongly.
However, when they heard the words ’World Tree,’ they instantly realized the gravity of the situation!
A look of shock appeared in their eyes.
They never expected those demons to be so cunning, going straight for the World Tree.
Meanwhile, the Elf soldiers showed expressions of horror, frantically charging toward the demons’ location.
However, the fastest was still Han Xing and his group.
The moment the teleportation array appeared, Han Xing and his companions summoned the Oracle Throne and rushed over.
With the Oracle Throne’s enhancement, the group’s speed increased tenfold!
What does this mean?
In their all-out burst state, their movement speed had already rivaled that of middle-tier Demigods.
Under the Oracle Throne’s state, they were propelled directly to the Elf King’s level!
The five transformed into five streaks of light, crossing tens of thousands of kilometers in a blink, arriving next to the teleportation array.
Under everyone’s gaze, Han Xing and his group stopped moving.
Because a problem appeared before them.

chapters.title: Chapter 771 - 430: The Demon God Descends!
paragraphs: The question is whether to destroy the teleportation array first or stop the demons from attacking the Holy Land.
This teleportation array has millions of defense points, and now that they have exited their peak state, it’ll take at least half a minute to destroy it.
Half a minute is enough time for the demons to charge into the Holy Land and damage the World Tree.
Right now, there’s not even time for them to think.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong said directly, "Brother Xing, Xiaoyunzi and I will go first to block those demons."
"You and Sister Lian Meng along with Xiaoyang will destroy the teleportation array!"
Shen Yun solemnly nodded in agreement.
However, Han Xing hesitated a bit.
Because relying solely on the two of them, there’s no way to stop the charge of so many abyssal monsters.
After all, those demons are not fools.
Knowing they can’t win, they choose to bravely rush forward to engage in frontal combat.
While he was caught in hesitation.
The demons also saw that the humans seemed to have encountered trouble.
At this moment, a demon shouted, "Ignore those humans!"
"All demons, attack the World Tree with full force!"
As soon as the words fell, the newly appeared demons also abandoned blocking Han Xing and others from destroying the teleportation array.
And crazily dashed towards the location of the Holy Land.
At this moment, Han Xing made his decision.
Forget about the teleportation array, they must prevent the demons from destroying the World Tree.
This is an important way he plans to enhance his Divine Power Value.
"Let’s charge through, we absolutely cannot let them destroy the World Tree!"
Upon hearing this, everyone nodded simultaneously.
Just as Han Xing was about to rush over.
He suddenly saw bursts of electric light appearing in the distance.
The electric light, like the first glimmer of dawn, instantly illuminated the entire sky.
"Zzzt... Zzzt zzzzt..."
A dense current sound echoed in everyone’s ears.
Even from over a thousand kilometers away, they could sense the terrifying aura contained in that electric light.
Everyone couldn’t help but turn their gaze towards it.
Then, they saw High Priest Xiao leading the way, along with Beastman King Uman, and three other Thunder Beasts each over ten thousand meters tall!
"Lord Saint Master! We’re here to assist you!"
"Master! Uman is here!"
"Screech!"
Cheng Jianyong said joyfully, "It’s those Thunder Beasts, Xiao is here!"
Han Xing nodded with a smile, sensing Xiao’s presence.
Then, the aura of four demigod-level beings transformed into five streams of light rushing toward them.
Especially those three demigod-level Thunder Beasts, their speed was astonishingly fast.
Almost turning into three bolts of lightning.
"Zzzt... Zzzt zzzzt..."
All the abyssal monsters encountered along the way were turned to charcoal and fell from the sky.
Under Han Xing’s command, all the Thunder Beasts rapidly charged to the Holy Land’s location, intercepting the group of abyssal monsters.
The situation stabilized once more.
Everyone looked at the scene with relief.
However, when the Saint Spirit level experts saw so many demigod and legendary-level Thunder Beasts appear, they were genuinely startled.
And upon discovering that those Thunder Beasts were subordinates of the Human Race group.
Besides being pleasantly surprised, they were even more astounded.
Unconsciously, the Human Race had somehow developed to this extent, possessing so many legendary and demigod-level creatures.
This scale is nearly comparable to the three major races!
The Elf King and Dwarf King exchanged a glance, seeing the shock in each other’s eyes.
At this point, Han Xing, with no concerns left, could attack the teleportation array recklessly.
In front of him, the attributes of the teleportation array appeared.
[Abyss Realm One-Way Teleportation Array (High-Level)]
[Defense Value]: 5,000,000.
"Boom! Boom rumble!"
The attacks from Han Xing and the others were directly unleashed.
That area fell into a frenzy of quaking.
Before all the demons rushed out, their attacks had already bombarded the area.
Some abyssal monsters even had only half of their bodies transported out before Han Xing killed them directly.
The other half of their bodies couldn’t return to the Abyss Realm and disappeared into the void.
This was a scene the demons had never experienced before!
Equivalent to being blocked and killed at the spring source.
One could imagine how depressed their mood was.
Moreover, making the abyss realm monsters even more depressed was, the defense value of the teleportation array was draining like water.
At this rate, it won’t be long before this high-level teleportation array is destroyed.
At this moment, the abyssal army, initially intent on attacking the Holy Land, rushed back in a frenzy.
Compared to the Holy Land, preserving the teleportation array in front of them was far more important.
However, with the inclusion of Xiao and the others, Han Xing and the others felt far less pressure.
There was no need to worry about being surrounded by those monsters.
"Boom!"
A dozen seconds later, a blasting sound occurred.
The Abyss Realm’s teleportation array was blown up once again!
In the sky, the red light dissipated, and a system notification appeared before Han Xing.
[You’ve destroyed the Abyss Realm One-Way Teleportation Array (High-Level), with merit in defending the Holy Spirit Realm, gaining 5 layers of World Mark.]
Another 5 layers of World Mark gained.
Though still not knowing what it’s for.
Being related to the world, it shouldn’t be something simple.
Seeing the teleportation array destroyed once again, everyone breathed a sigh of relief.
However, before they could celebrate for long.
Not far away, another teleportation array appeared!
And judging by its size, it’s strikingly similar to the one Han Xing had just destroyed.
The smiles on the faces of the Holy Spirit Realm experts froze.
"Damn it! Are those demons completely insane?"

chapters.title: Chapter 772 - 430: The Descent of the Demon God! (Part 3)
paragraphs: "Didn’t they say, activating a one-way teleportation array requires a huge sacrifice?"
The Elf King was utterly confused, unable to believe what had happened.
How could the Abyss Realm continue to activate so many teleportation arrays!
Compared to the shock of the strong from the Holy Spirit Realm.
The group of demons’ eyes once again showed delight.
They knew, the Abyss Realm hadn’t lost yet, there was still a fight!
However, before those demons could voice their ridicule.
They found that the five figures had once again transformed into five beams of light, rushing to the high-level teleportation array!
One minute later.
The teleportation array was once again blown up by the five people!
Upon seeing this, the demons on the field were instantly filled with hatred.
"Damn it! It’s those humans again!"
At the same time, not long after Han Xing destroyed the third teleportation array.
Soon, a fourth high-level teleportation array appeared.
It was evident that the Abyss Realm still hadn’t abandoned this invasion!
They prepared a lot of contingencies, one teleportation array appearing after another.
However, no matter how many teleportation arrays the Abyss Realm summoned, Han Xing would arrive first.
"Boom! Boom!"
Often, a new teleportation array would be directly destroyed in less than a minute after appearing.
In just under ten minutes, Han Xing and the others had already destroyed seven teleportation arrays.
Looking at the bag, already reaching a 40-layer World Mark, Han Xing said with a strange look: "Still no change."
"Could I have guessed wrong?"
A demon wielding a scythe furiously said, "Can’t anyone stop these few humans?"
"If this continues, no matter how many teleportation arrays we open, it will all be futile!"
At this point, the group of demons also realized this.
These few humans had already influenced the outcome of the entire battlefield.
And just then.
In the center of the kingdom, from six different positions, a sky-piercing red light appeared simultaneously.
Han Xing was just about to lead people over when Shen Yun said, "Brother Xing, wait a moment."
Han Xing looked at him with confusion, "What is it?"
Shen Yun frowned as he looked at where the six red lights appeared and said, "Brother Xing, don’t you think there’s a certain pattern to the distance between these six teleportation arrays?
Upon hearing this, Han Xing also cast his gaze.
The next moment, his pupil shrank.
"My god, a Hexagram Array!"
Indeed, the area where these six teleportation arrays were was exactly at the six corners of a hexagram array.
Connecting them together formed a massive hexagram array.
Before they could react.
The six teleportation arrays had already begun to emit red light and then connected with each other.
In an instant, that hexagram array had already taken shape, directly enveloping the entire Elf Realm, central region!
At this moment, the strong from the Holy Spirit Realm all simultaneously thought of something, their eyes showing a look of fear.
The Elf King exclaimed, "Damn it! It’s a composite teleportation array! Quickly, break them!"
From the previous high-level and top-level teleportation arrays, high demi-god level demons had already appeared.
And what level of demons could appear from this composite teleportation array was imaginable!
"My god... this time, could we really summon a divine demon?" Cheng Jianyong exclaimed.
Han Xing also realized the severity of the situation.
He frowned and was about to rush towards the direction of one of the teleportation arrays to destroy it.
The next moment, a surge of overwhelming demonic qi erupted, everyone on the scene felt their hearts tighten.
"Buzz!"
An invisible energy wave swiftly enveloped the entire Elf Realm, even the far boundary area millions of kilometers away could feel the overwhelming presence!
All the strong on the scene, felt as if they were being stared at by a primal beast.
In the terrified gaze of everyone.
At the center of this composite teleportation array, suddenly a huge mountain emerged.
The surface of the mountain was covered with wrinkles, reaching a height of ten thousand meters in an instant!
Then came the second mountain, the third, until the fifth mountain appeared!
At this point, everyone was shocked to find out this was actually not a mountain.
But a monster’s hand!
Those mountains were its five fingers.
Just one finger reached ten thousand meters in height!
And when that withered hand appeared, it exceeded thirty thousand meters.
Then came the arm, over a hundred thousand meters long!
That arm grabbed in the air, like a ghost about to crawl out of hell!
"Crack! Crack!"
The space of the Holy Spirit Realm seemed to start collapsing under the pressure of its terrifying flesh!
A large-scale space rift appeared.
It seemed long, but actually very short.
When everyone came to their senses, the upper body of the monster had already appeared.
Green flame-flashing pupils, four spider-like limb arms!
And that disproportionate upper body.
Just the upper body, already exceeded a million meters!
At this moment, all the remaining Abyssal Monsters simultaneously shouted.
"Welcome Fearful Limb Demon God!!!"
The eyes of the Abyssal Monsters were incredibly fervent.
While the beings of the Holy Spirit Realm were completely stupefied.
They weren’t expecting the Abyss Realm to actually summon a divine-level creature.
A truly real Demon God!
Including Han Xing and the others, they felt incredibly unbelievable.
Simultaneously, the attributes of this monster also appeared in front of Han Xing.
[Fearful Limb Demon God]
[Level]: ???
[Attributes]: ???
[Skills]: ???
[Divine Power Value]: ???
A heap of question marks.
The aura released by this Demon God had completely surpassed the God of Tricks.
This was an existence stronger than an average Divine Spirit!
Han Xing and the others couldn’t help but try to interrupt its arrival.
However, they couldn’t even approach before being pushed back by the powerful flesh aura of this Demon God!
The Elf King trembled in astonishment as he said, "Is this the Demon God of the Abyss Realm?"
"Although they don’t master the power of rules, they have refined their flesh into a form of rules!"
"Breaking into the Divine Realm in another way."
"Too terrifying!"
