chapters.title: Chapter 773 - 431: Three Kings Battle the Demon God!
paragraphs: After hearing the Elf King’s answer, Han Xing and the others finally understood why the aura of this Demon God was so terrifying!
The flesh body was refined into a rule, a different kind of godhood.
This method of becoming a deity is more advanced than the flesh evolution of the Insect Race.
Therefore, Han Xing and the others simply couldn’t get close.
At this moment, when that Demon God completely appeared.
Like other Abyssal Monsters, it first felt the air of the Holy Spirit Realm.
Its eyes showed a look of intoxication.
Then, it looked at the entire battlefield.
Upon sensing the strength of this side’s powerful beings, a look of disdain appeared in its eyes.
"Is this the top combat power of the Holy Spirit Realm?"
"Not even one divine-level being, truly disappointing."
At this moment, the group of demons shouted in unison: "Lord Fearful Limb Demon God!"
"The ones fighting us are the Elf King of the Holy Spirit Realm and the Dwarf King, please quickly slay them."
"As long as the Two Kings are slain, the Holy Spirit Realm has lost half already!"
Fearful Limb is both its name and its title.
This Demon God glanced at those high-tier demons and then said disdainfully.
"Are you teaching me how to act?"
Before those high-tier demons could respond.
Unexpectedly by everyone, that Demon God directly reached out and grabbed!
Those few high-tier demons were caught in its hand just like that.
"You batch of guys, with the top combat power of the Holy Spirit Realm so weak, how did so many teleportation arrays still get destroyed?"
"What a bunch of useless trash!"
"Since you’re useless, there’s no value for you to exist!"
Then, in the frightened gaze of those high-tier demons,
the Fearful Limb Demon God opened its mouth full of sharp teeth and tossed them in.
With a scream, those high-tier demons were bitten to pieces in one bite by the Demon God.
"Crunch! Crunch!
The sound of chewing mixed with the sound of bones breaking sent chills down people’s spines.
The high-tier demons, who had entangled the Elf King and Dwarf King for so long, were swallowed in one bite.
There wasn’t even a chance to resist!
This scene was terrifying to behold!
The Fearful Limb Demon God finished eating and let out a satisfied burp.
Then, it continued to look at the demons on the field, as if it wasn’t full yet.
"So, explain to me why so many teleportation arrays got destroyed."
At this point, a middle-tier demigod-level demon spoke with a trembling voice: "L-Lord Fearful Limb!"
"It was those humans, constantly destroying our teleportation arrays."
"It seems they are the world children that the Emperor spoke of!"
Hearing these words, the planetary-sized head of Fearful Limb looked at Han Xing.
"World child?"
At the moment it locked eyes with Han Xing, Fearful Limb Demon God seemed to understand something.
"Golden Divine Power, such strong luck."
"Interesting, are you really the world child of the Holy Spirit Realm?"
It stretched out its arm directly toward Han Xing!
However, at the moment Fearful Limb Demon God took action.
The group only felt a terrifying seal appearing, completely locking the space around them for tens of thousands of meters!
A system prompt appeared.
[This area has been sealed by the Fearful Limb Demon God, movement ability reduced by 100%, and spatial displacement function unusable.]
At this moment, Han Xing understood.
Why those high-tier demigod-level demons didn’t escape when the Fearful Limb Demon God reached out its claws.
Because they simply couldn’t escape!
Just as the Demon God’s huge hand was about to shroud heaven and earth, Han Xing suddenly said, "Xiaoyang, activate the special effect of Divine Oracle Summon!"
Su Xiaoyang nodded, then directly activated the teleportation function of the Oracle Throne.
The next moment, an invisible force enveloped everyone, even breaking through the sealing effect of the Fearful Limb Demon God.
Then, the figures of the five people vanished from their original position.
"Crunch!"
The hand of the Fearful Limb Demon God grabbed nothing but air.
Even its ghostly green pupils showed some surprise.
"Interesting, able to evade my attack."
"It seems what these useless creatures said is true, these people are indeed world children."
It was only a casual grab from the Demon God, containing terrifying sealing powers, completely locking up space.
And coincidentally, the teleportation function of the Oracle Throne could ignore spatial seals.
Therefore, at the critical moment, Han Xing let Su Xiaoyang activate the Oracle Throne.
A key moment that saved their lives.
At this moment, after seeing the targets escape, the Fearful Limb Demon God was not surprised.
It stood proudly in the Void, its massive body taking up everyone’s sight.
"Able to break the seal, you indeed have some tricks."
"However, the prey I want to catch, no matter where you escape, you won’t get away!"
It extended its arm again.
At the same time.
Han Xing and the others appeared in a region a million kilometers away, the maximum teleportation distance of the Oracle Throne.
Everyone exhaled a long breath.
Cheng Jianyong spoke fearfully: "Damn, are Demon Gods this terrifying?"
"I feel it’s much more formidable than the Insect Mother in the ruins!"
Shen Yun nodded, "Didn’t you hear what the Elf King said? These guys refined their flesh into a rule, more terrifying than those deities controlling the rules in the Holy Spirit Realm!"
"Only legends of True Gods can be the opponents of such creatures!"
Shen Yun was correct.
Under the terrifying pressure of this Demon God, those Elder spirits hidden in the Holy Spirit Realm, who previously dared to release a bit of aura to watch the battle,
since the arrival of the Fearful Limb Demon God, all their auras vanished, seemingly afraid that the Demon God would track them down.

chapters.title: Chapter 774 - 431: Three Kings Battle the Demon God! (Part 2)
paragraphs: Han Xing’s expression was somewhat serious, "This is indeed troublesome."
"I don’t know if the Elf King and the Dwarf King can hold out."
"At the very least, they need to hold on until we bring Ten Thousand Stars City over!"
And just at this moment.
Suddenly, they saw a massive hand covering the sky and sun from behind, reaching towards everyone at an unimaginable speed.
Shen Yun exclaimed, "Damn, it seems this Demon God is still unwilling to let us go!"
"Damn it, why is its hand so long?" Cheng Jianyong cursed incessantly.
Even before that giant hand arrived, everyone already felt their bodies being restrained.
Han Xing said, "Lian Meng, activate the teleportation!"
Zhang Lianmeng nodded solemnly, and in the next moment directly activated the Divine Oracle Summon special effect.
The figures of the five people teleported a million kilometers once again.
At this moment.
In the central region of the Elf Realm, the Fearful Limb Demon God had a trace of surprise in its eyes again.
"Interesting, you can escape from my grasp twice, truly deserving of being chosen by the Holy Spirit Realm?"
"But how many more times can you teleport?"
The Fearful Limb Demon God chuckled lightly.
It continued to extend its arm,
This seemed to be some method of its own, capable of crossing space to capture its target.
Shortly after Han Xing and the others completed their second teleportation, that massive hand appeared again at an astonishing speed.
"Damn it!"
At this moment, Han Xing once again realized the terror of the divine-level creatures!
Their methods were almost beyond common sense, completely overturning Han Xing’s previous understanding.
Even when facing the God of Tricks, Han Xing hadn’t felt this way.
The Demon God was too terrifying!
Han Xing hurriedly said again, "Cheng Jianyong, teleport!"
Everyone’s figures disappeared from the original spot for the third time.
When they reappeared.
The distance to Ten Thousand Stars City was less than a million kilometers.
With one more teleportation, they could directly return to Ten Thousand Stars City.
At that time, Han Xing wouldn’t fear this Demon God.
But by doing so, Han Xing would have exhausted all his cards.
Han Xing felt very indignant in his heart.
Because from the start of the battle to now, it was he and the Elf Race and Dwarf Race who had been acting as the main force.
One could say, without these three races holding on continuously.
The Holy Spirit Realm would have been doomed in this wave!
Although the powerful individuals from other races weren’t as powerful as these three races, they were also using their lives to stop the demons’ advance.
From the start of this war until now, countless strong individuals from the Holy Spirit Realm had died.
However, up to now, there were still some races that hadn’t even shown their faces.
Even those ancient beings were just watching the show.
How could Han Xing not feel angry about this?
Compared to the demons of the Abyss Realm, these guys were the most disgusting.
At this moment, Han Xing shouted directly to the sky, "You guys, if you continue watching, I’ll take my people and run!"
"Whoever wants to defend the Holy Spirit Realm can damn well do it themselves!"
Han Xing was not joking, if no one from the Holy Spirit Realm showed up, he was really prepared to take his team and run.
Just then, the Fearful Limb Demon God’s arm extended towards Han Xing again!
A terrifying pressure came rushing in!
And as Han Xing was about to initiate the fourth teleportation.
A giant axe suddenly appeared in the sky!
"Swish!"
The giant axe brought with it boundless might, as if the creation of heaven and earth!
It violently struck the arm of the Fearful Limb Demon God.
"Crack!"
A bone-cracking sound that made one’s heart tremble echoed, resonating for a million miles!
The Fearful Limb Demon God, in pain, immediately withdrew the giant hand.
It angrily shouted, "Damn it! Who dares to injure me?"
The voice resonated for millions of kilometers, the entire Elf Realm heard that angry shout!
And just at this moment.
A figure appeared, instantly grasping the giant axe that flew out.
Han Xing saw a creature standing ten thousand meters tall, clad in heavy armor, like a steel giant, had appeared!
"Giant King!"
Someone shouted out his name.
At the same time.
The distant Elf King and Dwarf King also showed expressions of joy in their eyes.
"Giant King, you finally showed up!"
"Arthas, I thought you were too scared to appear!"
The Giant King gripped the giant axe, his gaze looking in the direction of the Two Kings.
"Hmph, I just wanted to see if the Abyss Realm had any other tricks up its sleeve."
"For me to even see a Demon God, it’s quite worthwhile!"
However, upon hearing this, the Dwarf King unceremoniously criticized, "Arthas, stop bragging!"
"As if you could take on this Demon God?"
The Giant King was unmoved, his eyes filled with raging war intent.
His voice was full of battle intent, "If I don’t try, how will I know?"
"I also wish to see how big the gap is between myself and the real divine spirits!"
At this moment, the Giant King shouted, "Giant God Descent!"
Boom!
A red lightning bolt suddenly appeared in the sky, striking the Giant King.
His body, already ten thousand meters tall, then explosively grew ten times larger!
It now was just about as large as the Fearful Limb Demon God’s head alone...
The Giant King transformed into a stream of light, rushing towards the Fearful Limb Demon God at an extremely terrifying speed.
His entire body began to ignite with divine power, like a world-burning celestial flame.
In between heaven and earth, it seemed like only this colossal figure remained.
As soon as he appeared, it was like the protagonist entering the stage.
At this moment, the Giant King’s divine power surged, shouting aloud:
"Godslaying Axe!"
This was the Giant King’s full-force strike!
All living beings couldn’t help but look towards him!
The Giant King rushed forward!
He went up directly!
Just as he was about to chop down on the Fearful Limb Demon God’s head, that terrifying Demon God casually glanced at him.

This seemed to be some method of its own, capable of crossing space to capture its target.
Shortly after Han Xing and the others completed their second teleportation, that massive hand appeared again at an astonishing speed.
"Damn it!"
At this moment, Han Xing once again realized the terror of the divine-level creatures!
Their methods were almost beyond common sense, completely overturning Han Xing’s previous understanding.
Even when facing the God of Tricks, Han Xing hadn’t felt this way.
The Demon God was too terrifying!
Han Xing hurriedly said again, "Cheng Jianyong, teleport!"
Everyone’s figures disappeared from the original spot for the third time.
When they reappeared.
The distance to Ten Thousand Stars City was less than a million kilometers.
With one more teleportation, they could directly return to Ten Thousand Stars City.
At that time, Han Xing wouldn’t fear this Demon God.
But by doing so, Han Xing would have exhausted all his cards.
Han Xing felt very indignant in his heart.
Because from the start of the battle to now, it was he and the Elf Race and Dwarf Race who had been acting as the main force.
One could say, without these three races holding on continuously.
The Holy Spirit Realm would have been doomed in this wave!
Although the powerful individuals from other races weren’t as powerful as these three races, they were also using their lives to stop the demons’ advance.
From the start of this war until now, countless strong individuals from the Holy Spirit Realm had died.
However, up to now, there were still some races that hadn’t even shown their faces.
Even those ancient beings were just watching the show.
How could Han Xing not feel angry about this?
Compared to the demons of the Abyss Realm, these guys were the most disgusting.
At this moment, Han Xing shouted directly to the sky, "You guys, if you continue watching, I’ll take my people and run!"
"Whoever wants to defend the Holy Spirit Realm can damn well do it themselves!"
Han Xing was not joking, if no one from the Holy Spirit Realm showed up, he was really prepared to take his team and run.
Just then, the Fearful Limb Demon God’s arm extended towards Han Xing again!
A terrifying pressure came rushing in!
And as Han Xing was about to initiate the fourth teleportation.
A giant axe suddenly appeared in the sky!
"Swish!"
The giant axe brought with it boundless might, as if the creation of heaven and earth!
It violently struck the arm of the Fearful Limb Demon God.
"Crack!"
A bone-cracking sound that made one’s heart tremble echoed, resonating for a million miles!
The Fearful Limb Demon God, in pain, immediately withdrew the giant hand.
It angrily shouted, "Damn it!
Who dares to injure me?"
The voice resonated for millions of kilometers, the entire Elf Realm heard that angry shout!
And just at this moment.
A figure appeared, instantly grasping the giant axe that flew out.
Han Xing saw a creature standing ten thousand meters tall, clad in heavy armor, like a steel giant, had appeared!
"Giant King!"
Someone shouted out his name.
At the same time.
The distant Elf King and Dwarf King also showed expressions of joy in their eyes.
"Giant King, you finally showed up!"
"Arthas, I thought you were too scared to appear!"
The Giant King gripped the giant axe, his gaze looking in the direction of the Two Kings.
"Hmph, I just wanted to see if the Abyss Realm had any other tricks up its sleeve."
"For me to even see a Demon God, it’s quite worthwhile!"
However, upon hearing this, the Dwarf King unceremoniously criticized, "Arthas, stop bragging!"
"As if you could take on this Demon God?"
The Giant King was unmoved, his eyes filled with raging war intent.
His voice was full of battle intent, "If I don’t try, how will I know?"
"I also wish to see how big the gap is between myself and the real divine spirits!"
At this moment, the Giant King shouted, "Giant God Descent!"
Boom!
A red lightning bolt suddenly appeared in the sky, striking the Giant King.
His body, already ten thousand meters tall, then explosively grew ten times larger!
It now was just about as large as the Fearful Limb Demon God’s head alone...
The Giant King transformed into a stream of light, rushing towards the Fearful Limb Demon God at an extremely terrifying speed.
His entire body began to ignite with divine power, like a world-burning celestial flame.
In between heaven and earth, it seemed like only this colossal figure remained.
As soon as he appeared, it was like the protagonist entering the stage.
At this moment, the Giant King’s divine power surged, shouting aloud:
"Godslaying Axe!"
This was the Giant King’s full-force strike!
All living beings couldn’t help but look towards him!
The Giant King rushed forward!
He went up directly!
Just as he was about to chop down on the Fearful Limb Demon God’s head, that terrifying Demon God casually glanced at him.

chapters.title: Chapter 775 - 431: Three Kings Battle the Demon God!_3
paragraphs: "Snap!"
The Fearful Limb Demon God slapped out.
The Giant King, along with the Giant Axe in his hand, was directly sent flying back millions of meters!
In midair, blood oozed from the corner of the Giant King’s mouth, and he said with a dazed look in his eyes, "Demon God, is this strong?"
This time, the billion of creatures in the Holy Spirit Realm were in complete silence...
They had thought that once the Giant King appeared, he would have a way to deal with the Fearful Limb Demon God.
But still, it was so vulnerable.
At this moment, the Dwarf King and Elf King both displayed a look of disdain on their faces.
"Arthas, didn’t I tell you you can’t do it?"
"You shouted the slogans loud enough, but you couldn’t even take a slap."
At this moment, listening to the Dwarf King’s ridicule, the Giant King felt a sense of defeat in his heart.
He seemed to have lost all fighting spirit.
The Elf King comforted, "Alright, Ah Ju, don’t be upset."
"After all, this guy is a true Divine-level creature, it’s normal not to beat him."
The Giant King looked at the Elf King and said emotionally, "Miris, you still understand me..."
Before the Giant King could finish, the Elf King whispered.
"Still, it’s a bit embarrassing..."
At this moment, the Giant King had a look of shame and annoyance on his face.
It was clear that the relationships among the Three Kings were quite decent.
As the top existence on the surface of the Holy Spirit Realm, they had similarly matched powers and comparable talents.
And the same concerns.
In an Eastern fantasy way of speaking, the Three Kings could call each other ’Dao Friend’.
For many years, the Three Kings were at a standstill at the peak of demigod level, exchanging experiences with each other.
Always searching for alternative ways to deify.
At this time, the Fearful Limb Demon God looked at the three of them and sneered, "How long are you three going to chat?"
"Just perfect, to take you three out first, would be a great achievement for the Abyss Realm!"
As the words fell, it directly extended four limbs towards the Three Kings.
The Dwarf King hurriedly said, "Want to catch me? No way!"
"Hammer, come!"
Boom!
A flash of dawn instantly tore through the dark sky.
A giant hammer, entirely gray-blue, infused with intense power appeared.
The moment that hammer appeared, it was as if storms erupted throughout the Elf Realm.
Over a dozen tornadoes with diameters reaching over ten thousand kilometers quickly formed.
All nearby Abyssal Monsters, once swept up by the tornadoes, didn’t even have time to scream before being torn to pieces by the horrific wind force.
And this, is the power of the Dwarf Race’s exclusive Holy Artifact: the Hammer of Storms!
After the Dwarf King gripped this giant hammer, his momentum began to soar.
Then, he swung it directly, hammering away the outstretched arm of the Fearful Limb Demon God.
"Clang!"
This strike caused the Fearful Limb Demon God’s flesh body to tremble.
Compared to the Giant King’s axe, this hammer inflicted more severe damage to the Fearful Limb Demon God.
The Dwarf King said smugly, "See? Ah Ju, this is what a threatening attack on a Divine-level creature looks like."
"Your little bit of strength is too weak."
The Giant King retorted disdainfully, "Hmph, you just rely on having a Holy Artifact weapon!"
"If you gave me a Holy Artifact weapon, I’d suppress this Demon God for you to see."
The Dwarf King was completely unconvinced, "Ha! Who doesn’t know how to boast?"
Just then, the voice of the Fearful Limb Demon God emerged, "Interesting, Holy Artifact level Hammer of Storms, is it?"
"At this level of treasure, even our Abyss Realm has only a few."
"However, even if you can block this strike, how will you block the attacks to follow?"
"I have four arms!"
As the words faded, the Fearful Limb Demon God’s four arms lashed out simultaneously.
The targets were the Three Kings!
Seemingly to pay extra attention to the Dwarf King, two of the arms were aimed at him!
The Three Kings all simultaneously became alert.
At this moment, the Giant King took a deep breath, with a look of determination in his eyes.
He lifted his Giant Axe, once again mustering all his strength, and struck fiercely at the arm!
"Boom!"
The Giant Axe met the arm.
This time, the Giant King was not blown away but withstood the force of the strike.
The immense counterforce caused the Giant King to spit a mouthful of blood.
Yet he did not feel fear, instead, he exclaimed excitedly, "See? Little dwarf, white-haired freak!"
"I held my ground! I faced the Demon God’s attack head-on!"
At this moment, the Dwarf King was not interested in his boasting.
Facing the dual-armed attack from the Fearful Limb Demon God, he stood at the ready!
He raised the Hammer of Storms, at this moment, a terrifying gale force concentrated between the hammer.
"Bang! Bang!"
After two dull collision sounds.
The Dwarf King was slammed flying for thousands of kilometers.
However, he too withstood this wave of the Demon God’s onslaught.
Yet, the Elf King showed no attempt to resist when facing the Demon God’s attack.
His silhouette flashed, transforming into a white light appearing behind the Dwarf King.
"Kruguman, I can’t hold on; it’s up to you now."
Upon hearing this, the Dwarf King’s eyes immediately widened.
"Grass, Miris!"
Before he could react.
The third arm of the Fearful Limb Demon God swung over.
"Grass!"
The Dwarf King cursed, but still gathered all his strength to withstand the third incoming arm!
Bang!
The Dwarf King was again struck flying!
The retreating Dwarf King wanted to curse harshly.
And just at this moment.
A sudden surge of white light emerged from the Elf King’s body, flowing into the bodies of the other two kings.
They discovered that the injuries they had just sustained from resisting the Demon God were actually healing at a very rapid pace.
Moreover, their auras rose again by a notch.
Now, they were faintly breaking the demigod limits, moving closer to becoming divine beings.
The Elf King’s figure appeared behind them.
"Don’t panic, I’m here."
Hearing this, the Dwarf King wanted to hit him with the hammer.
But the Elf King’s blessing effect was too powerful!
The Dwarf King and Giant King felt like they had boundless energy now.
"Arthas, take it down!"

chapters.title: Chapter 776 - 432: Blow It Up!
paragraphs: "Arthas, do it!" the Elf King and the Dwarf King shouted simultaneously,
The Giant King took a deep breath, lifted his giant axe and charged again.
The power of the two kings soared, one wielding a Big Hammer, the other chopping with a giant axe.
Madly attacking the arms of the Fearful Limb Demon God!
"Bang! Bang bang bang!"
The arms of the Fearful Limb Demon God were blasted away repeatedly.
Moreover, the Elf King kept shooting streaks of white light from behind, corroding the demon god’s body.
After several collisions,
The Fearful Limb Demon God, seeing that he hadn’t taken them down, gradually got serious.
"Three annoying ants!"
"Watch me squash you!"
With that, the Fearful Limb Demon God frantically swung his four arms.
The area was completely turned into a void.
The terrifying energy fluctuations caused the entire Sky Island of the Elf Realm to tremble incessantly.
Existences below the High-tier Demigod Level could not even approach the battlefield of these four formidable beings.
At this moment, the three top powerhouses of the Holy Spirit Realm joined forces to battle a demon god that reached a body size of over three million meters, possessing Divine Level power!
The raging storm, the soaring white light, and the swinging giant axe.
That day, the living beings of the Holy Spirit Realm recorded this scene.
Named: The Three Kings Battle the Demon God!
"Boom!!!"
At this moment, the three kings, working together, had achieved Divine Spirit Level strength.
Although it was only equivalent to a weak god like the God of Tricks.
Yet, by joining forces, they could barely contend with the Fearful Limb Demon God.
At this moment, the Fearful Limb Demon God continuously swatted the three kings away, watching them tenaciously charge back, sneering coldly.
"Three ants, is this the extent of your strength?"
"Is this the pinnacle of power in the Holy Spirit Realm?"
"Weak, weak, weak!"
Pop!
All four of his arms struck out simultaneously, sending the three kings flying tens of thousands of meters.
At this time, all the bones in the bodies of the three kings had been shattered.
However, under the healing white light of the Elf King, their injuries quickly recovered!
Then they charged again, only to be swatted away once more!
"Weak, too weak!" the Fearful Limb Demon God taunted mercilessly.
"With such a Holy Spirit Realm, it’s a wonder you’ve lasted till now."
"Any demon god could easily sweep through the entire Holy Spirit Realm."
However, the Giant King retorted, "Why are you barking?"
"If I could break through to a Divine Spirit, I would cut you down within ten moves!"
The Dwarf King chimed in, "Ah Ju is right!"
"If I could also break through to a Divine Spirit, I would crush you in three moves!"
The Giant King’s brows twitched, "Why three moves for you and ten for me?"
"Because I have a Holy Artifact Hammer, not convinced?"
"I’m not!"
Watching the two kings bickering again.
The Elf King said helplessly, "Gentlemen, let’s focus on dealing with the enemy in front of us."
The Fearful Limb Demon God showed a sinister smile on the corner of his abyss-like mouth.
"Indeed, if you could become Divine-level beings, you would be slightly stronger than me."
"But that’s it."
"The power of our Abyss Realm does not stop with just me as a demon god!"
"The Fallen, War, Nightmare... each is stronger than me."
"Moreover, above us are the even more powerful Ancient Demon Gods."
"What does the Holy Spirit Realm have to stop the advance of our Abyss Realm?"
The words of the Fearful Limb Demon God were not hidden but instead resonated millions of kilometers away.
The entire Elf Realm, all the clans heard these words.
For the first time, they truly felt the terror of the Abyss Realm.
The Fearful Limb Demon God was already terrifying enough.
And according to him, there were many demon gods in the Abyss Realm stronger than him.
Even higher-tier Ancient Demon Gods!
How strong must such beings be?
At this time, Han Xing and his companions also heard these words.
Shen Yun said with some relief, "Fortunately, we didn’t recklessly cross the Sea of Lava back then into the Abyss Realm."
"Otherwise, if those demon gods or Ancient Demon Gods sensed us, we wouldn’t have even been able to escape!"
The team members nodded in strong agreement.
On battlefields throughout the Elf Realm.
The strong ones of the Holy Spirit Realm found their war intent drastically reduced due to the words of the Fearful Limb Demon God.
They all felt despair at the power of the Abyss Realm.
Some even no longer wanted to continue resisting.
Because, it seemed there was completely no hope of victory.
And at that moment, the voice of the Elf King also appeared.
"Everyone! Don’t give up easily!"
"If the Abyss Realm was truly that powerful, they would have won that battle tens of thousands of years ago and wouldn’t have been beaten back by our Holy Spirit Realm’s powerhouses!"
"We in the Holy Spirit Realm also have many hidden powerhouses, don’t worry."
Hearing this, the powerhouses of the Holy Spirit Realm realized this point.
One by one, their spirits were rekindled.
However, the Fearful Limb Demon God derided, "The hidden powerhouses you speak of, are they those old guys who don’t even dare to reveal their auras?"
"Look, since I appeared, have those old turtles dared to come out?"
The Elf King didn’t respond.
Still aiding the Dwarf King and the Giant King against the Fearful Limb Demon God.
At this moment, the Fearful Limb Demon God continued to taunt while fighting.
"Elf King, you should know."
"The Holy Spirit Realm has long since decayed, with so many parasites constantly siphoning the energy of the Holy Spirit Realm and even cutting off the path of newcomers."
"What need do you have to protect such a world?"
"In comparison, our Abyss Realm is a world with complete laws!"
"Where the weak are eliminated by the strong, and the strong are eliminated by even stronger ones!"
"In the Abyss Realm, all beings, no matter your status or lineage, have the chance to evolve to a higher level!"

chapters.title: Chapter 777 - 432: Blow It Up!
paragraphs: "Just think about it, if the three of you were born in our Abyss Realm, with your talents, wouldn’t you have broken through to become Divine Spirits long ago?"
"Why end up in this situation now?"
The voice of the Fearful Limb Demon God, filled with temptation, echoed repeatedly.
And each question directly targeted the Three Kings’ pain.
If it were a weaker-minded existence, their resolve would’ve wavered already.
Even the Giant King and Dwarf King couldn’t help but start doubting themselves.
Perhaps... the Fearful Limb Demon God was right?
However, the Elf King quickly shook off the Fearful Limb Demon God’s temptation.
He shouted, "You don’t need to spread lies here!"
"The Holy Spirit Realm may indeed be decayed, but compared to that, living in the Abyss Realm is far too extreme."
"The weak have no chance of survival; all beings must devour others to survive."
"Such a world is twisted and shouldn’t exist!"
After hearing this, the Giant King and Dwarf King also shook off their hesitation.
Their attacks became unwaveringly determined once more.
Seeing his temptation fail, the Fearful Limb Demon God sneered, "Only an extreme survival model can produce more strong ones."
"Thus, the weak world should be dominated by the powerful world!"
"It seems that only by letting the Emperor conquer the Holy Spirit Realm can change your minds!"
Crack!
The Fearful Limb Demon God exerted more force.
The three kings flew backward simultaneously, blood gushed from their mouths.
Despite the Elf King’s healing ability,
at this point, the Three Kings already felt exhausted.
The Knight, even the Fearful Limb Demon God didn’t expect they could last this long.
The Fearful Limb Demon God’s eyes flashed with sinister intent, "You little ants, being able to fight me this long is already enough to boast."
"Now, it’s time for you to die!"
"Four Godslaying Blades!"
As soon as these words fell.
The limbs of the Fearful Limb Demon God turned into blades, slashing simultaneously.
Feeling the terror of this strike, the Three Kings cried out together!
"Little Dwarf, block it!"
The Dwarf King said in terror, "Ah Ju, I can’t do it!"
The Three Kings all realized that if they took this blade, even if they didn’t die, they would be severely wounded.
Despair appeared in the Elf King’s eyes as well.
His pale face was clenched tight!
"Damn it... Do I have to use the last resort?"
And at this moment.
A gigantic Sun suddenly appeared behind the Fearful Limb Demon God!
That Sun was no smaller than the Fearful Limb Demon God’s planet-like form, emitting waves of destructive aura.
The blazing light lit up the entire sky of the Elf Realm.
At this moment, everyone heard a voice rise.
"Blow it up for me!"
The next instant.
That Sun exploded directly!
"Boom!"
The violent destructive energy burst immediately,
under the intense light, tears streamed from the eyes of every living being in the Elf Realm.
Even the Three Kings instinctively closed their eyes.
And the Fearful Limb Demon God at the explosion’s center was directly engulfed by that energy.
This arrow was none other than Han Xing’s ultimate skill—the Sun-Destroying Arrow!
A 5000% damage coefficient, plus a 500% attack power increase under Endless Arrow Prison state.
In addition, with the amplification of various states,
this arrow was the strongest shot Han Xing had ever fired.
Even the God of Tricks would suffer severe damage facing this arrow!
At this moment, Han Xing stared expectantly at the area of the Sun’s explosion.
As for the aftereffect of the Sun-Destroying Arrow, it was directly neutralized by his Passive Skill [All Things in the Forest].
So, Han Xing was still full of life.
That’s also why he dared to rush over and attack the Fearful Limb Demon God.
Not only Han Xing but the surrounding strong ones, including the Three Kings, also turned their gaze.
They simultaneously watched the spot of the Sun’s explosion.
And when the terrifying energy fluctuations dissipated.
Disappointment appeared in the eyes of everyone simultaneously.
At this moment, on the body of the Fearful Limb Demon God, which was like volcanic rock, smoke rose.
His body also had some charred black areas.
This arrow did harm the Fearful Limb Demon God, but it was very limited.
"Still not enough..." the Elf King said in despair.
The other two kings felt waves of powerlessness as well.
They could all see that the arrow was full of potent destructive power.
But even such an attack didn’t hurt the Fearful Limb Demon God, not even breaking his defense.
Compared to everyone’s dismay, Han Xing himself felt nothing.
Or rather, not harming the Fearful Limb Demon God was within his expectations.
After all, this guy refined his flesh into a rule-based existence.
Far stronger than the God of Tricks’ flesh by many times.
The fact that Han Xing could inflict some wounds was already remarkable.
However, this arrow did succeed in catching the Fearful Limb Demon God’s attention.
"Interesting, you ant, having escaped with difficulty, don’t cherish your life chances, and still come running to die?"
Upon finishing, he was about to launch an attack on Han Xing.
At this moment, the Elf King exclaimed, "Saint Master Han Xing, run quickly!"
"This guy is too strong, you can’t possibly defeat him."
"You just got engaged to my daughter, we can’t let Nora lose her husband before marriage!"
"Run away with Nora quickly!"
Originally, Han Xing felt no emotion.
However, when he heard the Elf King’s last two sentences, he was so shocked that his mouth dropped open.
"What the hell... since when did I get engaged to your daughter?"
"Though you indeed mentioned it, I never agreed?"

chapters.title: Chapter 778 - 432: Blow It Up!
paragraphs: "And this kind of thing needs to be said in this kind of occasion?"
At this moment, all the beings of the Elf Realm heard it.
"Elf King, is it true what you said?"
"Divine Lady Elinora has really engaged to this Master of the Human Race?"
"It should... be true, right?"
"After all, the Elf King said it face-to-face, under normal circumstances, he wouldn’t joke about his daughter’s reputation, right?"
This time, the Abyss Realm invasion has gathered 80% of the Holy Spirit Realm’s races.
Among them, were many admirers of Elinora.
Upon hearing the Elf King say it face-to-face, these admirers were heartbroken on the spot.
Meanwhile, Elinora, who was fighting a high-tier legendary level demon, blushed with embarrassment.
Even the Giant King and Dwarf King looked at the Elf King in surprise.
"Minos, is it true what you said?"
"You really betrothed your daughter to this Master of the Human Race?"
The Elf King nodded, "How can there be any falsehood?"
However, the Dwarf King disdainfully said, "Minos, did you hastily shove your daughter to him seeing the limitless potential this Master of the Human Race displayed?"
The Elf King directly refuted, "How is that possible?"
"The two are fond of each other."
"Relying on my daughter’s charm, even if the contemporary Master of the Human Race is extraordinarily gifted, my daughter is well-matched with him."
The Elf King confidently responded.
Upon hearing this, the Giant King and Dwarf King were full of disbelief.
At this moment, the Fearful Limb Demon God sinisterly said, "Since that’s the case, I’ll eliminate you, then crush your race’s Divine Maiden to death, sending you below for a reunion!"
As the words fell, an arm directly swung over.
Just then, the Elf King suddenly burst forth with a power far exceeding before.
In an instant, he appeared in front of Han Xing.
"Do not harm my daughter’s betrothed!"
Bang!
He surprisingly relied on his own power to withstand the attack of the Fearful Limb Demon God.
In that moment, everyone’s eyes widened.
The crowd saw.
Above the Elf King’s head, a holy crown appeared, the powerful divine power fluctuations made everyone’s heart tremble.
"Elf race holy artifact, Elf Crown!"
The Dwarf King directly shouted the name of the crown.
And the Fearful Limb Demon God also seemed somewhat surprised, "Another holy artifact?"
"Your Holy Spirit Realm certainly has many treasures!"
The Three Kings are the top-notch strongmen in the Holy Spirit Realm, naturally possessing quite a few aces up their sleeves.
And Han Xing, seeing the Elf King block that blow for him, also gave up the idea of using the Oracle Throne to teleport away.
Instead, he quickly retreated.
That battlefield, once more, was handed over to the Three Kings and the Fearful Limb Demon God.
At this moment, Han Xing returned to the top of Ten Thousand Stars City, where Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong had long been prepared, continually watching the area around the Fearful Limb Demon God.
As soon as there’s an unexpected situation on Han Xing’s side, they would unhesitatingly activate all the sixteen hundred defense towers above to attack.
Directly killing the Fearful Limb Demon God in one blow.
Of course, this is the last resort, not easily used.
Once used, there’s no guarantee that the Abyss Realm won’t send out stronger entities.
Seeing Han Xing fly back, Cheng Jianyong hurriedly asked, "Brother Xing, are you alright?"
Han Xing nodded, "No problem."
Everyone simultaneously breathed a sigh of relief.
At this moment, Shen Yun asked, "Brother Xing, from what the Elf King said, is he planning to stick with you on this?"
"Saying publicly in front of so many people that the Divine Maiden has already engaged with you, isn’t he afraid you might deny it?"
Everyone also realized this.
Han Xing laughed, "This old fox has truly become wise with age."
"To publicly declare our union, betting on his daughter’s reputation."
"This guy is gambling that I won’t refuse."
"He just sent me a message, saying the World Tree can be opened to the Human Race limitlessly in the future."
The team members were also taken aback.
This time, the Elf King really went all out.
The goal is to lure Han Xing, binding the Human Race and the Elf Race in a united front.
"Then, Brother Xing, did you agree?" Cheng Jianyong asked.
Han Xing shook his head, "No, it’s not the time to talk about this."
"He chose neither sooner nor later, but to speak during a great battle, truly speechless."
At this moment, Zhang Lianmeng appeared to want to say something but hesitated.
However, before she could speak, the Elf King’s miserable cries directly came through.
"Ah! Save me!"
Han Xing cast his gaze over.
Seeing the Elf King directly struck by the Fearful Limb Demon God’s arm, turning into a meteor and disappearing into the sky.
Including the other two kings, after holding out for a while, were also smashed and sent flying by the Fearful Limb Demon God.
Seeing the situation about to collapse once more.
Han Xing said, "I need to go over and help."
"At this rate, the Three Kings won’t hold out much longer."
"I must find a way to take down this Fearful Limb Demon God!"
Upon hearing this, everyone looked grave.
Their faces showing concern.
Previously, Han Xing may not have taken such a risk.
However, he hadn’t forgotten, he still had yet to claim the reward for being the first to kill a divine-level creature.
Without using Ten Thousand Stars City, Han Xing had another godslaying tactic, which was the Beast’s Tail Spike.
This thing still had two chances left to use.
From dealing with that Insect Mother previously, it was evident.
Regular divine-level creatures can never withstand the Giant Beast Tail Spike.
Therefore, Han Xing is virtually certain in using it against this demon god.
But, to ensure absolutely no mishaps, Han Xing decided to let the Three Kings further deplete the Fearful Limb Demon God’s physical strength.
At this moment, under the tenfold speed boost from the Oracle Throne, Han Xing’s speed reached an extreme.
Quickly arriving at the Three Kings’ battlefield.

chapters.title: Chapter 779 - 433: My Killer! Han Xing of the Human Race!
paragraphs: Seeing Han Xing approaching, the eyes of the Three Kings showed different reactions.
Not waiting for them to speak.
Han Xing directly asked, "You three, do you have any means to explode?"
"Preferably, something that could harm the Fearful Limb Demon God."
The Three Kings were stunned for a moment, then looked at Han Xing helplessly.
The Elf King had already used his Holy Artifact Crown.
If there were any other means, they would have been used already.
They wouldn’t have been treated as a punching bag by the Fearful Limb Demon God for so long.
Han Xing rolled his eyes, knowing he couldn’t count on these three guys.
So, Han Xing said, "Then try your best to hold off the Fearful Limb Demon God for me. Today, watch me perform a godslaying!"
As soon as he said this, all the strong ones present looked at Han Xing in shock.
Although they knew Han Xing was very strong with many skills.
But when they heard Han Xing say he wanted to slay a god, they couldn’t help but feel waves of disbelief.
Even the Fearful Limb Demon God paused its attacking rhythm for a moment, with mocking eyes in its green pupils.
"Did you just say you want to slay me?"
Han Xing glanced at it, "You’re the only Demon God on the field, what do you think?"
As soon as he said this.
All the nearby monsters from the Abyss Realm couldn’t help but burst into laughter.
"I think this human just wants to die, must have lost his mind?"
"You should know, the Fearful Limb Demon God is not like those weak gods of the Holy Spirit Realm, it is a being that refined its flesh into rules!"
"That’s right, the Fearful Limb Demon God is also a strong one among the Demon God Level in our Abyss Realm! This human must be crazy!"
Listening to the taunting voices of the Abyssal Monsters, even the strong ones from the Holy Spirit Realm didn’t refute.
Because, like the creatures of the Abyss Realm, they didn’t believe Han Xing could slay a god either.
No, not to mention slaying a god.
It would be good enough to hurt the Fearful Limb Demon God.
However, there were still some strong ones who believed in Han Xing.
The Elf King and the Dwarf King had also interacted with Han Xing a few times before.
They knew he wasn’t someone who would boast.
At this time, the Dwarf King cautiously said, "Uh... Saint Master Han Xing."
"Even if you have the means to slay a god, isn’t it a bit inappropriate to say it out loud like this?"
As soon as he said this, even the Fearful Limb Demon God realized it.
The Fearful Limb Demon God laughed, "This guy reminded me."
"Since you are the child of the world from the Holy Spirit Realm, you might have a way to hurt me after all!"
"I, for one, need to be on guard against you a bit."
After saying this, the gray-red body gradually became shrouded in a layer of black energy.
Under that black energy, the attacks on the Fearful Limb Demon God would be greatly weakened.
Those below the demigod level wouldn’t even be able to get close to the Fearful Limb Demon God.
At this moment, the Three Kings looked at Han Xing helplessly.
They couldn’t help but feel regretful for missing a good opportunity.
At this moment, the Fearful Limb Demon God had already labeled Han Xing as the number one enemy.
In the next moment, its four arms swung simultaneously, targeting all of them at Han Xing!
"Block it for me!"
"Protect my daughter’s husband!"
The Three Kings rushed out at once, with everything they had, blocking this wave of attacks from the Fearful Limb Demon God.
In the center of the divine-level battlefield, Han Xing was in the middle of chaotic energy, almost being blown away.
However, his gaze remained unmoved.
In the next moment, Han Xing slowly drew the bowstring.
And at this time, the Three Kings were surprised to find that Han Xing’s aura seemed to have a different change.
From the previous sharpness, it turned into a form of returning to simplicity, somewhat resembling a saint.
They couldn’t help but divide a bit of their focus, investing it in Han Xing.
And at this time, Han Xing opened his eyes.
In the next moment, an arrow with faint golden divine power shot out!
"Whoosh!"
The speed of this arrow was extremely fast.
At this moment, the Fearful Limb Demon God was just about to dodge.
However, it didn’t sense any dangerous aura from this arrow.
The Fearful Limb Demon God also wanted to test Han Xing’s depth, so it simply stood there and took the arrow head-on.
"Crack!"
After the arrow hit.
The Fearful Limb Demon God looked confused.
Yet, it didn’t feel any other changes.
It was as if that arrow was just for show.
The Fearful Limb Demon God sneered, "Is this your godslaying method?"
"Such a child-like attack, trying to hurt me?"
"Hahaha..."
The Fearful Limb Demon God’s laughter had just begun when its expression froze the next moment.
It suddenly felt like part of its power seemed to have vanished...
Although it was just a part, it made the Fearful Limb Demon God’s eyes show a horrified expression.
In its heart, waves of shock arose!
One must know, ever since it refined its flesh into rules, it had reached a level where its energy did not leak at all.
Similar to Han Xing’s All Things in the Forest, it was nearly immune to most negative states.
However, it still felt a sense of power loss from Han Xing’s arrow.
This was really too bizarre!
"Human, what did you do?"
"How could a part of my power disappear!?"
The Fearful Limb Demon God asked in horror.
However, Han Xing did not answer.
That arrow was naturally the ultimate skill Han Xing had newly learned recently—the effect of the Six Jails Reincarnation Arrow.

[Six Jails Reincarnation Arrow]: Shoots six arrows, causing the hit enemy to be trapped in reincarnation. Each arrow hit reduces the enemy’s strength by a major realm, and they lose a large amount of memory. If all six arrows hit, the enemy’s strength and memory will be completely cleared (this skill is effective up to demigod level beings. For divine beings, the effect of each arrow is reduced by 80%, ineffective for True God level beings.)

All the nearby monsters from the Abyss Realm couldn’t help but burst into laughter.
"I think this human just wants to die, must have lost his mind?"
"You should know, the Fearful Limb Demon God is not like those weak gods of the Holy Spirit Realm, it is a being that refined its flesh into rules!"
"That’s right, the Fearful Limb Demon God is also a strong one among the Demon God Level in our Abyss Realm!
This human must be crazy!"
Listening to the taunting voices of the Abyssal Monsters, even the strong ones from the Holy Spirit Realm didn’t refute.
Because, like the creatures of the Abyss Realm, they didn’t believe Han Xing could slay a god either.
No, not to mention slaying a god.
It would be good enough to hurt the Fearful Limb Demon God.
However, there were still some strong ones who believed in Han Xing.
The Elf King and the Dwarf King had also interacted with Han Xing a few times before.
They knew he wasn’t someone who would boast.
At this time, the Dwarf King cautiously said, "Uh...
Saint Master Han Xing."
"Even if you have the means to slay a god, isn’t it a bit inappropriate to say it out loud like this?"
As soon as he said this, even the Fearful Limb Demon God realized it.
The Fearful Limb Demon God laughed, "This guy reminded me."
"Since you are the child of the world from the Holy Spirit Realm, you might have a way to hurt me after all!"
"I, for one, need to be on guard against you a bit."
After saying this, the gray-red body gradually became shrouded in a layer of black energy.
Under that black energy, the attacks on the Fearful Limb Demon God would be greatly weakened.
Those below the demigod level wouldn’t even be able to get close to the Fearful Limb Demon God.
At this moment, the Three Kings looked at Han Xing helplessly.
They couldn’t help but feel regretful for missing a good opportunity.
At this moment, the Fearful Limb Demon God had already labeled Han Xing as the number one enemy.
In the next moment, its four arms swung simultaneously, targeting all of them at Han Xing!
"Block it for me!"
"Protect my daughter’s husband!"
The Three Kings rushed out at once, with everything they had, blocking this wave of attacks from the Fearful Limb Demon God.
In the center of the divine-level battlefield, Han Xing was in the middle of chaotic energy, almost being blown away.
However, his gaze remained unmoved.
In the next moment, Han Xing slowly drew the bowstring.
And at this time, the Three Kings were surprised to find that Han Xing’s aura seemed to have a different change.
From the previous sharpness, it turned into a form of returning to simplicity, somewhat resembling a saint.
They couldn’t help but divide a bit of their focus, investing it in Han Xing.
And at this time, Han Xing opened his eyes.
In the next moment, an arrow with faint golden divine power shot out!
"Whoosh!"
The speed of this arrow was extremely fast.
At this moment, the Fearful Limb Demon God was just about to dodge.
However, it didn’t sense any dangerous aura from this arrow.
The Fearful Limb Demon God also wanted to test Han Xing’s depth, so it simply stood there and took the arrow head-on.
"Crack!"
After the arrow hit.
The Fearful Limb Demon God looked confused.
Yet, it didn’t feel any other changes.
It was as if that arrow was just for show.
The Fearful Limb Demon God sneered, "Is this your godslaying method?"
"Such a child-like attack, trying to hurt me?"
"Hahaha..."
The Fearful Limb Demon God’s laughter had just begun when its expression froze the next moment.
It suddenly felt like part of its power seemed to have vanished...
Although it was just a part, it made the Fearful Limb Demon God’s eyes show a horrified expression.
In its heart, waves of shock arose!
One must know, ever since it refined its flesh into rules, it had reached a level where its energy did not leak at all.
Similar to Han Xing’s All Things in the Forest, it was nearly immune to most negative states.
However, it still felt a sense of power loss from Han Xing’s arrow.
This was really too bizarre!
"Human, what did you do?"
"How could a part of my power disappear!?"
The Fearful Limb Demon God asked in horror.
However, Han Xing did not answer.
That arrow was naturally the ultimate skill Han Xing had newly learned recently—the effect of the Six Jails Reincarnation Arrow.
[Six Jails Reincarnation Arrow]: Shoots six arrows, causing the hit enemy to be trapped in reincarnation.
Each arrow hit reduces the enemy’s strength by a major realm, and they lose a large amount of memory.
If all six arrows hit, the enemy’s strength and memory will be completely cleared (this skill is effective up to demigod level beings.
For divine beings, the effect of each arrow is reduced by 80%, ineffective for True God level beings.)

chapters.title: Chapter 780 - 433: My Killer! Han Xing of the Human Race! (2)
paragraphs: Although it is said above that the effect on divine-level creatures is weakened by 80%, even if only 20% of the weakening effect remains.
The power lost is still terrifying for a divine spirit-level creature.
However, this is not the most bizarre aspect.
When the Fearful Limb Demon God regained its senses, its gaze suddenly wavered.
It seemed to have forgotten something...
The Six Jails Reincarnation Arrow not only weakens the enemy’s power but also erases the enemy’s memory.
This characteristic is the most terrifying.
The Fearful Limb Demon God looked at Han Xing with uncertainty, "What exactly did you do? Why do I feel like I’ve forgotten something?"
Hearing these words, not only the Fearful Limb Demon God.
Even the Three Kings exchanged strange glances.
They had seen methods to weaken the enemy’s power.
But a method to erase someone’s memory in battle, even the Three Kings had never seen before.
Even the Giant King, who rarely spoke, couldn’t help but exclaim, "This Master of the Human Race truly has strange methods."
Han Xing did not reply but directly drew the second arrow.
Having experienced the power of Han Xing’s arrows, the Fearful Limb Demon God immediately tensed up.
It swung its four arms, preparing to interrupt Han Xing’s attack preemptively.
At this moment, Han Xing hurriedly said, "Elf King, Giant King, don’t just stand there, help me block!"
At this moment, the Three Kings came to their senses.
Their entire momentum burst out again!
Receiving all four arms of the Fearful Limb Demon God.
"Boom!"
A terrifying collision sound emerged.
Although the Three Kings were once again knocked away.
They were surprised to find that the power of the Fearful Limb Demon God seemed to have weakened significantly.
This strike caused them much less damage than before.
At the same time, Han Xing’s second arrow had already been launched!
"Whoosh!"
Although the Fearful Limb Demon God was a divine-level creature, its body was too large.
It couldn’t easily avoid the attack at this moment.
After being hit by the arrow, the aura of the Fearful Limb Demon God dropped again.
Its expression was once again dazed.
Because it felt like it lost a lot of its memory again.
In its gaze towards Han Xing, there was already a trace of fear.
"Human... What exactly have you done to me?"
It knew it must get rid of this human kid quickly.
Otherwise, if this continued, it might really fall at the hands of this human.
The Fearful Limb Demon God frenetically attacked Han Xing.
However, at this moment, how could the Three Kings not see the strangeness of Han Xing’s arrows?
The Fearful Limb Demon God had weakened again!
At this rate, after Han Xing fires a few more arrows.
They might directly weaken the Fearful Limb to the extreme and then easily slay it!
The Three Kings began to use all their strength to protect Han Xing.
"Saint Master Han Xing, attack with all your might, we will hold off the Fearful Limb for you!"
"Brother Han Xing, we support you, shoot it!"
However, what Han Xing wanted to tell them was, you’re overthinking it!
The Six Jails Reincarnation Arrow, against creatures below the divine spirit level, can indeed reduce the power to the extreme.
But for a true divine-level creature like the Fearful Limb Demon God, even if all six arrows hit, it can only reduce its power by less than 40%.
It’s impossible to make it fall out of the divine realm.
However, for the current situation, that’s already enough!
A 40% weakening can bring the Fearful Limb Demon God out of that invincible state.
Under the protection of the Three Kings, Han Xing quickly fired the third arrow!
"Puff!"
After being struck by the arrow, the Fearful Limb Demon God’s figure staggered again.
It felt again as if it had lost a segment of memory.
Looking at its enemies in front, the Fearful Limb Demon God suddenly murmured in confusion, "Why am I here..."
"Wasn’t I in Abyss City?
Listening to the Fearful Limb Demon God’s murmurs.
The Three Kings felt a chill rise behind them simultaneously!
They looked back in terror at the young man.
These arrows are indeed too bizarre!
If it were them, suddenly forgetting why they were here in battle.
They might be instantly obliterated by the enemy!
However, could one still call it a demon god?
After experiencing the initial daze, it seemed to remember something and said angrily, "Damn human kid!"
"You’ve tampered with my memory with your demon technique again!"
Han Xing still did not answer but drew the bowstring.
However, at the moment the fourth arrow was launched.
The Fearful Limb Demon God, just about to attack Han Xing, but it seemed to recall something.
Hurriedly retracting its moves, in front of everyone.
It directly ran away!
This scene left the Three Kings dumbfounded on the spot.
The Fearful Limb Demon God, who regarded dignity as life, unbelievably fled in fear of Han Xing’s arrows.
Even the Abyssal Monsters nearby looked at this scene with shock.
In their impression, their invincible Lord Demon God, in front of that human’s attack, ran away like a stray dog!
"Fearful Limb, aren’t you being too cowardly?" the Dwarf King mercilessly mocked from behind.
However, at this moment, the Fearful Limb Demon God had not fled far.
Its figure appeared above the Elf Royal City.
"Hmph! Strange human kid!"
"And you few, don’t rush yet."
"Let me first devour your Elf Race, regain some strength, and then deal with you!"
Hearing these words, a sense of foreboding arose in countless elves within the Elf Royal City.
The Fearful Limb Demon God’s power had been greatly drained.
It intended to compensate by devouring the creatures of the Holy Spirit Realm.
In the next moment, the Fearful Limb Demon God’s figure suddenly appeared above the Royal City.

chapters.title: Chapter 781 - 433: My Killer! Han Xing of the Human Race! (3)
paragraphs: It extended its four pillar-like arms suddenly and struck down.
If this blow landed, the entire Elf Continent might be shattered by it!
The Elf King watched this scene, his eyes blazing with intense Holy Light.
His whole body transformed into a stream of light and disappeared.
However, his speed was ultimately no match for the Demon God.
By the time the Elf King arrived, countless casualties would have already occurred in the Royal City below!
At this moment, three decaying auras simultaneously appeared in the Elf Royal City.
One of them even possessed Divine Level strength.
"Ugly Abyssal Demon God! Don’t dream of invading the Royal City!"
A furious shout echoed from the Royal City.
However, when facing the Fearful Limb Demon God.
That Divine Level aura was instantly struck flying, crashing into the ground of the Royal City, creating a ten-thousand-meter-wide crater!
Fearful Limb’s four arms continued to strike down without hindrance!
And at this moment.
Han Xing suddenly disappeared from his original position.
The movement speed of Demon God Level creatures was too fast.
He was still hundreds of thousands of kilometers away from the Fearful Limb Demon God.
So, he directly utilized the teleportation function of the Oracle Throne.
The next moment, Han Xing’s figure appeared directly behind its massive body.
Fearful Limb felt the crisis from behind and quickly retracted its arms.
Even this Demon God himself probably couldn’t have imagined that a human would suddenly appear behind it.
"Human!"
"Daring to rush up to me to seek death, I’ll fulfill your wish!"
However, just before it could turn its massive body around.
Han Xing’s lips curled into a smile.
"Fearful Limb Demon God, let me show you my treasure!"
With these words, a gigantic tail spike appeared in Han Xing’s hand.
Then he fiercely stabbed it towards the back of the Fearful Limb Demon God.
After doing all this, Han Xing hesitated not at all and frantically fled, controlling the Oracle Throne.
However, at this moment, the gigantic body of the Fearful Limb Demon God suddenly froze in place.
It felt something was wrong at the place where it had been stabbed in the back.
Before it could recover.
A terrible stinging sensation quickly spread from the wound.
It even spread across its entire back.
The Fearful Limb Demon God glanced at its back and saw that it had already turned an ominous blue-purple.
This was the first time fear appeared in the eyes of the Fearful Limb Demon God!
Even when it was previously hit by Han Xing’s Six Jails Reincarnation Arrow, this expression hadn’t appeared.
Before this, although its power was weakened, the Fearful Limb Demon God was still incredibly confident, believing that there was no way these few ants could kill it!
But now, it felt an overwhelming sense of impending doom!
No, not just impending doom, but the certainty that the next moment, it would die!
"How could this be possible?"
"What a joke?"
"How could I, the Oracle, die in the Holy Spirit Realm at the hands of this ant-like human?"
However, the Giant Beast Poison wasn’t joking with it.
Bear in mind, it’s a terrifying toxin that even True Gods could be harmed by.
The Fearful Limb Demon God watched helplessly as its body quickly decayed, unable to do anything to stop it.
It couldn’t even slow it down for a moment.
If not for the fact that its Demon God body had become the carrier of the Rule, allowing it to hold on longer.
Otherwise, it would have ended up like that Insect Mother, turned into a pool of blood!
Even so, now the Fearful Limb Demon God had already lost all its fighting strength.
It was doing everything it could, mobilizing its entire Power of the Demon God to fight against the Giant Beast Poison within.
Seeing that the Fearful Limb Demon God wasn’t chasing him, Han Xing, after escaping to a safe distance, looked back.
He saw that although the Demon God’s appearance had changed in color, it still hadn’t died.
"Huh? Not dead yet?"
"Fine, let me assist you."
Thinking this, Han Xing drew another arrow!
After all, there were still two arrows of the Six Jails Reincarnation Arrow that hadn’t been shot!
"Whoosh!"
The Fearful Limb Demon God also sensed the arrow shot by Han Xing, containing the same bizarre power as the previous arrows.
But now, it had no strength left to resist!
"Damn human brat!"
"Even if I die, I’ll make sure you won’t get away!"
Han Xing was speechless; you’re already dead, how do you plan to not let me get away?
"Pfft!!"
The arrow hit the target.
This arrow seemed to be the last straw that broke the camel’s back.
After a moment of daze, the Fearful Limb Demon God felt that another portion of its memory had been lost.
At the same time.
The lower half of the Fearful Limb Demon God’s body began to rapidly decay.
"Splash..."
Black pus rained down from the sky.
If it fell into the Elf Royal City, it would turn into a disaster.
Fortunately, a light barrier quickly rose up from the city below.
Then the entire Elf Continent began to move.
At this time, the Fearful Limb Demon God watched as its millions-of-meters-tall body melted halfway.
Its eyes showed a dazed expression once again.
The memory-erasing function of the Six Jails Reincarnation Arrow started taking effect again.
And this time, more memory was erased than ever before.
The Fearful Limb Demon God forgot how it came to the Holy Spirit Realm.
It also couldn’t remember how it suddenly fell into this state on brink of death.
But in its mind appeared a figure.
A human figure.
As it was about to completely turn into pus, the remaining head of the Fearful Limb Demon God had its pupils blaze with towering wrath.
This human had brought it to such a state.
He was the one who caused it, a dignified Demon God, to die here!
Unfathomable malice engulfed it.
The Fearful Limb Demon God suddenly shouted: "All creatures of the Abyss Realm, remember!"
"The Master of the Human Race who killed me is Han Xing!"
"Tell the Emperor, make sure he avenges me!!!"

chapters.title: Chapter 782 - 434: First Divine Spirit Kill Reward, Holy Artifact Battle Armor!
paragraphs: Boom!
At the moment when the Fearful Limb Demon God died completely.
Below the Holy Spirit Realm, it seemed as if a surge of monstrous black gas appeared.
An eerie green eye emerged, as if it had heard the final call of the Fearful Limb Demon God.
The terrifying eye scanned everyone present, then locked its gaze onto Han Xing.
At this moment, Han Xing felt as though he had returned to when he first arrived in this world.
Insignificant, powerless...
Cold sweat immediately soaked his entire body.
Han Xing couldn’t even muster a single thought of resistance.
As if what was watching him was not a living creature.
But a ghoul devouring the world!
Just as Han Xing was about to be overwhelmed into unconsciousness by the terrifying pressure,
the sky above the Holy Spirit Realm suddenly appeared covered by a massive thundercloud.
This thundercloud enveloped the entire Elf Realm.
It was far grander than the one Han Xing faced during the Trial of the Master of War Ghosts.
Then, a lightning bolt as thick as ten thousand meters struck straight into the black gas below.
At the moment the lightning appeared, everyone felt their hairs stand on end!
And Han Xing also broke free from that feeling of powerlessness.
Boom!
The lightning erupted, dispelling the black aura below the Holy Spirit Realm.
The eerie green eye gradually disappeared.
The entire living beings of the Holy Spirit Realm couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief.
However, Han Xing seemed to have walked through the gates of hell, drenched in cold sweat.
"Holy shit... What was that eye?"
"It was damn terrifying!
"This was even more terrifying than when I faced the God of Light during my Fourth Transformation!"
Han Xing’s expression was filled with shock.
At this moment, he suddenly thought of a possibility.
"Could it be, that thing is the legendary Demon Emperor?"
"This is utterly ridiculous, it almost invaded the Holy Spirit Realm without even using a teleportation array!"
"What level of existence is this guy?"
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong, Shen Yun, and others also noticed something off about Han Xing’s state.
They quickly maneuvered Ten Thousand Stars City to come over.
When Han Xing returned to Ten Thousand Stars City, he finally felt a trace of security.
Han Xing breathed a sigh of relief.
At the same time, Han Xing also saw a string of system notifications.

[Successfully killed Abyssal Demon God: Horror Limb, gained 2407.3 billion Experience Value, received special item: Demon God’s Heart*1, automatically absorbed the opponent’s Divine Power, Divine Power value +1000]
[As you are the first on the server to kill a divine-level creature, you receive the first kill reward: Supreme Star Country Armor (Holy Artifact), Night Goddess Longbow (Fragment)]
[Due to your outstanding performance, you receive an additional 500 Legendary Points, World Mark +20 layers!]
A series of system notifications left Han Xing in a state of bewilderment.
Then, his eyes directly showed a look of surprise.
"Holy shit! This wave of rewards is a total fortune!"
Looking at the three rewarded items in his backpack, Han Xing trembled with excitement!
The fear from being watched by that eye vanished without a trace.
Now there was only the joy of harvest!
He first examined the black armor made of unknown materials, with stars flowing over its surface, in his backpack.
This item is called [Supreme Star Country Armor], which is also the third Holy Artifact of the Master of Stars Set!
Before him appeared the attributes of this armor.
[Supreme Star Country Armor lv60, Quality: Holy Artifact, Armor: 32732~35871, Power +10000, Constitution +10000,]
[Attached Effect]: Star Guardian (when attacked, 50% of the damage will be deducted over 5 times), Star Armor (absorb 30% of enemy’s armor to increase own armor by 20%),
Star Counterattack (after receiving 10 attacks from a single target, reflect the accumulated damage back, effective even against True God-level creatures).

Supreme Star (Divine-level Effect, reduces 30%~90% of incoming damage from targets with lower Attack Power, the greater the difference, the higher the damage reduction. Reduces 20%~40% of incoming damage from targets with higher Attack Power, the greater the difference, the higher the damage reduction.)
[Reboot Timeline]: Holy Artifact exclusive effect, when encountering an unbeatable enemy, sacrifice the Supreme Star Country Armor to reboot the timeline, returning 1 hour earlier.

Note: Part of the Holy Artifact Set, can be combined with [Master of War Ghosts], [Magic Mist Forged Heart Lower Armor], [Decaying Dream Traveler’s Cloak], [Galaxy Dream-Casting Necklace], [Ring of the Master of Illusions], to form [Master of Stars Set].
After reading the attributes of this equipment, Han Xing was in shock for a long time.
Undoubtedly, since it is armor, it exists to protect the user’s safety.
And this armor does an excellent job.
The front several effects all enhance the wearer’s survivability.
Especially the final divine-level effect.
Whether facing units with higher or lower Attack Power, one can receive varying degrees of damage reduction!
It can be said that if Han Xing wears this armor, his Defense and survivability could even surpass Shen Yun.
Keep in mind, Shen Yun also has a full set of Abyssal Demon Armor, plus a Divine Artifact-level shield.
Yet Han Xing still has confidence in surpassing him.
This is the fearsome power of Holy Artifact-level equipment.
One piece of equipment can significantly transform one’s power.
"However... the most terrifying is still the final Holy Artifact exclusive effect."
At this moment, a thoughtful look appeared in Han Xing’s eyes.
"Does Reboot Timeline mean time reversal?"
"But the cost is that this Supreme Star Country Armor will be sacrificed..."
The one-hour time reversal effect is enough to free the user from a deadly predicament.

chapters.title: Chapter 783 - 434: First Divine Spirit Kill Reward, Holy Artifact Battle Armor! (Part 2)
paragraphs: There is no doubt this Holy Artifact effect is extremely against the heavens.
It is even the most terrifying effect Han Xing has ever seen.
No matter which world it is, any ability involving time and space is very formidable.
Of course, Han Xing hopes he won’t have the chance to use this [Reboot Timeline].
After all, once Han Xing uses this opportunity,
it means he has encountered an undefeatable enemy.
To the extent of having to rely on Time Reversal to escape.
Han Xing shook his head, not intending to dwell on it further.
He began to check the second rewarded item.
It was a throbbing heart, burning like a flame!
At this moment, just in the backpack, Han Xing could feel the heartbeat’s frequency.
"Thump! Thump! Thump!"
The dull heartbeat, like the constant beating of a drum.
If below the level of Legend, one couldn’t even withstand this heartbeat’s frequency.
It can be imagined, how terrifying the power contained in this heart is.
Before Han Xing appeared the attributes of the heart.
[Demon God’s Heart]: Special item.
Can be used as special alchemy material for crafting some top-tier items, or directly devoured.
After devouring the Demon God’s Heart, Divine Power Value +1000, Flesh Body Rule evolution degree +1% (once Flesh Body Rule reaches 100%, can break through to Demon God Realm).
Note: If the flesh body is not strong enough, devouring the Demon God’s Heart risks exploding.
Seeing that final note, Han Xing’s pupils shrank again.
Good heavens, he thought this Demon God heart was only used for constructing a Divine Demon Battleship.
But now, it seems it has an even more powerful use!
That is, to directly devour it, allowing the flesh body to evolve towards the rules!
What does this mean?
You have to know, in the Holy Spirit Realm where all the rules are monopolized, even geniuses like the Three Kings,
have been stuck at the Demigod Realm for many years, unable to progress further.
Even Han Xing, so far, has not thought of a way to break through this limitation.
But now, this [Demon God’s Heart], undoubtedly provides Han Xing a path to the Divine Realm.
It is an evolutionary path unique to the Abyss Realm, besides using a Divine Format.
However, the price is also terrifying, actually requiring the devouring of 100 Demon God Hearts to become a Demon God.
If Han Xing tells the Three Kings about this evolutionary method, surely they would be eager to try it.
Of course, provided they can slay that many Demon Gods.
Han Xing pondered, "My goal is not to become just an ordinary Divine Spirit."
"Compared to gathering 100 Demon God Hearts, using them to create a Divine Demon Battleship better enhances my strength."
After all, the two main cannons of the Divine Demon Battleship have an Attack Power of 5 million.
With the enhancement of the Sun Crown Stele, that becomes a full 15 million Attack Power!
Han Xing even has confidence to severely injure a Divine Spirit like the God of Tricks with a single shot!
Thinking of this, Han Xing glanced at his blueprint interface.
At the top, the construction interface for the Divine Demon Battleship has already lit up.
Which also means, Han Xing has gathered all materials needed to build the battleship.
He directly clicked on construct.
The system prompt appeared.

[Do you wish to consume materials: Philosopher’s Stone*1 million, Rhythm Black Iron*8 million, Ancient Elf Secret Ingot*100k, Shimmering Terra Stone*500k, Calamity Divine Gold*20k, Abyssal Seal*100, Demon God’s Heart*1... to construct the Divine Demon Battleship?]
"Yes."
[Constructing, remaining time 78 hours 32 minutes...]
Han Xing nodded with satisfaction.
"Very good, once the Divine Demon Battleship is completed, I’ll have another trump card!"
Thinking of this, Han Xing began to check the third rewarded item.
[Night Goddess Longbow (Fragment)]: Special item, through this longbow fragment, the position of the Night Goddess’s palace in the Chaotic Void can be found.
After viewing the information note on this item,
Han Xing glanced back at the statues on Ten Thousand Stars City.
Among a heap of goddess statues,
stood a tall, cool-tempered goddess, her gaze straight forward.
This is the statue of the Night Goddess.
Han Xing thought to himself, "Speaking of which, the Night Goddess and I are somewhat fated."
"Not only did I get her statue blueprint, last time I also found the Night Goddess’s Attendant Divine Hall."
"And now, I’ve obtained a fragment of her weapon."
"I just wonder, what’s in the Night Goddess’s palace?"
"Could it be, encountering the Night Goddess there?"
Thinking of this, Han Xing was instantly interested.
Of course, it’s not because he thinks the Night Goddess is beautiful and tall and wants to admire the goddess’s charm.
Rather, Han Xing wants to learn more about those Divine Spirits’ information.
And to gain this information, undoubtedly, directly inquiring those era’s Divine Spirits is more efficient.
Besides, Han Xing indeed intends to visit the Void next.
Then, he could conveniently look for the Night Goddess’s palace.
The tasks ahead just increased by one.
Thus, the three rewards for being the first to kill a Divine-level Creature have been fully checked.
At this moment,
the first gleam of dawn appeared before daybreak.
And the battle across the Elf Realm was nearing its end.
After the death of the Fearful Limb Demon God, the remaining Abyss Realm creatures were like a leaderless horde.
At this time, under the joint siege of strong warriors from the Holy Spirit Realm, their numbers were drastically reduced to very sparse.
When the faraway sky turned white,
the last Abyss Demon was also jointly vanquished by the Holy Spirit Realm’s strong warriors.
After enduring a night of brutal combat, all the warriors’ faces were etched with grief and exhaustion.
