chapters.title: Chapter 784 - 434: First Divine Spirit Kill Reward, Holy Artifact Battle Armor!_3
paragraphs: During last night’s battle, the Holy Spirit Realm didn’t escape unscathed.
On the contrary, the casualty ratio was quite high.
In each major clan, one or two Legendary Powerhouses, and even some Demigod Level powerhouses, fell.
As for ordinary soldiers below the Fifth Transformation, the death toll was incalculable.
Among these war victims, there might have been their former friends, relatives, lovers...
At this moment, the crown above the Elf King’s head released endless Holy Light, covering the entire central area of the Elf Kingdom.
The powerhouses of each major clan, upon contact with that white light, felt a warm Power surge within them.
It also dispelled everyone’s fatigue.
The voice of the Elf King appeared.
"Everyone in the Holy Spirit Realm, you have worked hard."
"This battle is a great victory!"
Upon these words, the entire Elf Kingdom resounded with countless thunderous shouts.
They shouted in unison!
"Great victory!!"
"Great victory!!"
The warriors of each clan were moved to tears of joy.
They looked at their comrades beside them, with complex emotions in their eyes.
Having experienced such a massive war, they became more aware of the insignificance of individual strength.
Even if the strength of an entire clan is poured into it, in such a war, it doesn’t have much effect.
Only by uniting the strength of the entire Holy Spirit Realm is there a chance to resist such a formidable enemy.
Gradually, the clans began to put aside their differences.
At this moment, it was as if they returned to a time ten thousand years ago.
The clans of the Holy Spirit Realm worked together to fend off the Abyss Realm!
The celebration lasted for a long time.
Han Xing and others also wore smiles on their faces.
Just as they were preparing to leave.
They suddenly heard the voice of the Elf King.
"Saint Master Han Xing, please rest for a moment, in the afternoon, please bring your companions to the Elf Royal City for a meeting."
It wasn’t just Han Xing.
The strong ones of each major clan also heard the Elf King’s message.
After this large-scale battle, the Abyss Realm probably won’t invade again soon.
Each clan indeed needed to reflect well.
Han Xing looked at his teammates and said, "The Elf King wants us to go over in the afternoon for a conference of all races."
Upon hearing this, the team members nodded.
"No problem, Brother Xing, you make the decision," Cheng Jianyong said directly.
Following this.
The Elf Kingdom began post-war repairs.
After this battle.
Although many powerhouses of the Holy Spirit Realm were lost, the Abyss Realm also suffered heavy losses.
After all, they managed to take down a Demon God, plus a dozen high-tier demons.
As for Legendary Level demons, who knows how many there were.
No matter how profound the foundation of the Abyss Realm, they couldn’t keep waging such large-scale wars continuously for insane invasions.
Moreover, the key point is that this time the Fearful Limb Demon God died.
From the perspective of the Abyss Realm, it looks like the Holy Spirit Realm has the Power to slay a Demon God.
Therefore, rashly, the Abyss Realm should not launch a large-scale invasion again.
At least, it will remain quiet for a few days.
Han Xing, with his team, peacefully returned to Ten Thousand Stars City to rest.
Half an hour later.
In the Lord’s Mansion, Han Xing was checking the materials in his warehouse.
At this time, there came a knock on the door from outside.
With Han Xing’s current strength, he naturally knew who was outside.
Thus he directly said, "Come in, Lian’Er."
Zhang Lianmeng, upon hearing this, pushed open the door of the Lord’s Mansion.
Looking at the beauty’s shy glance, Han Xing chuckled and said, "What’s wrong, Lian’Er?"
Zhang Lianmeng didn’t speak but instead sat skillfully on Han Xing’s lap.
The warm softness of her thighs brought a soft touch, and the twist of her waist further aroused infinite desire in one’s heart.
Han Xing caressed Zhang Lianmeng’s voluptuous thigh.
They were now extremely familiar with each other, and the room’s atmosphere was gradually heating up.
In the next moment, Han Xing directly carried this explosively shaped beauty to the bedroom.
Soon, the room was filled with low, deep breaths.
Two hours later...
Zhang Lianmeng snuggled in Han Xing’s arms, her face flushed with satisfaction.
At this time, Han Xing gently patted her shoulder and said, "Lian’Er, can you tell me now what’s on your mind?"
Zhang Lianmeng whispered, "Brother Xing, what do you think about what the Elf King said last night?"
Han Xing paused, understanding what Zhang Lianmeng wanted to discuss.
He shook his head, brushing Zhang Lianmeng’s hair lightly, "You know, that was the Elf King’s unilateral decision; I didn’t agree to it."
However, Zhang Lianmeng shook her head, "That’s not what I mean, Brother Xing..."
She bit her lip gently, seemingly hesitant to speak.
Moments later, Zhang Lianmeng mustered her courage and said.
"What I mean is, I want you to accept the Elf King’s proposal and marry the Elf Goddess!"
This time, Han Xing was completely stunned, looking at Zhang Lianmeng in surprise.
Aware of Han Xing’s reaction, Zhang Lianmeng pressed him down beneath her.
Their exquisite features were less than a centimeter apart.
Zhang Lianmeng whispered, "Remember what I told you before?"
"I wanted Brother Xing to also bring in Little Sister Yang..."
"But you didn’t seem to do that. Does Brother Xing not like Little Sister Yang?"
Hearing this, Han Xing shook his head, "That’s not it."
In fact, Han Xing indeed understood Su Xiaoyang’s feelings.
However, she and Zhang Lianmeng are very good friends.
Han Xing always felt such a relationship was a bit strange...
However, Zhang Lianmeng seemed to know his thoughts, continuing, "Brother Xing, I’ve talked with Little Sister Yang long ago."
"Actually, neither of us minds if you have more women around..."
"Anyway, Little Sister Yang and I know the ones who can accompany you the most are just us."
"The Elf Goddess is very beautiful, even more beautiful than me; I think she deserves Brother Xing as well..."

Looking at the beauty’s shy glance, Han Xing chuckled and said, "What’s wrong, Lian’Er?"
Zhang Lianmeng didn’t speak but instead sat skillfully on Han Xing’s lap.
The warm softness of her thighs brought a soft touch, and the twist of her waist further aroused infinite desire in one’s heart.
Han Xing caressed Zhang Lianmeng’s voluptuous thigh.
They were now extremely familiar with each other, and the room’s atmosphere was gradually heating up.
In the next moment, Han Xing directly carried this explosively shaped beauty to the bedroom.
Soon, the room was filled with low, deep breaths.
Two hours later...
Zhang Lianmeng snuggled in Han Xing’s arms, her face flushed with satisfaction.
At this time, Han Xing gently patted her shoulder and said, "Lian’Er, can you tell me now what’s on your mind?"
Zhang Lianmeng whispered, "Brother Xing, what do you think about what the Elf King said last night?"
Han Xing paused, understanding what Zhang Lianmeng wanted to discuss.
He shook his head, brushing Zhang Lianmeng’s hair lightly, "You know, that was the Elf King’s unilateral decision; I didn’t agree to it."
However, Zhang Lianmeng shook her head, "That’s not what I mean, Brother Xing..."
She bit her lip gently, seemingly hesitant to speak.
Moments later, Zhang Lianmeng mustered her courage and said.
"What I mean is, I want you to accept the Elf King’s proposal and marry the Elf Goddess!"
This time, Han Xing was completely stunned, looking at Zhang Lianmeng in surprise.
Aware of Han Xing’s reaction, Zhang Lianmeng pressed him down beneath her.
Their exquisite features were less than a centimeter apart.
Zhang Lianmeng whispered, "Remember what I told you before?"
"I wanted Brother Xing to also bring in Little Sister Yang..."
"But you didn’t seem to do that.
Does Brother Xing not like Little Sister Yang?"
Hearing this, Han Xing shook his head, "That’s not it."
In fact, Han Xing indeed understood Su Xiaoyang’s feelings.
However, she and Zhang Lianmeng are very good friends.
Han Xing always felt such a relationship was a bit strange...
However, Zhang Lianmeng seemed to know his thoughts, continuing, "Brother Xing, I’ve talked with Little Sister Yang long ago."
"Actually, neither of us minds if you have more women around..."
"Anyway, Little Sister Yang and I know the ones who can accompany you the most are just us."
"The Elf Goddess is very beautiful, even more beautiful than me; I think she deserves Brother Xing as well..."

chapters.title: Chapter 785 - 435: The Myriad Races Conference
paragraphs: "Moreover, I think that Divine Maiden has quite an interest in Brother Xing."
"Now that the Elf King has publicly mentioned this matter, virtually all beings in the Holy Spirit Realm know about the Elf Goddess wanting to marry you."
"If you refuse, it would be equivalent to ruining a woman’s reputation..."
"So, I hope Brother Xing can agree to this marriage."
"In this way, not only can it preserve the reputation of the Divine Maiden, but it can also unite the Human Race and the Elf Race. Isn’t this a win-win situation?"
Zhang Lianmeng spoke so many words for the first time, as if she was pouring out all the thoughts from her heart at once, making Han Xing a bit unaccustomed.
After contemplating for a moment, Han Xing smiled and said, "Lian’Er, aren’t you afraid of losing your place to someone else?"
Zhang Lianmeng blushed and softly replied, "No... not afraid..."
Han Xing hugged her tightly, and they were entangled passionately again.
It wasn’t until noon that Han Xing got up from the bed.
As for the matter of the Elf Goddess, Han Xing decided to think about it later.
Because High Priest Xiao had already arrived with a group of Thunder Beasts and a large number of Witch Race forces.
They took over Han Xing and the others’ tasks.
Next, Han Xing and his team didn’t have much to do.
The region they were responsible for no longer had any Abyss Realm Teleportation Arrays appearing.
In the afternoon.
Han Xing then led his team to the Elf Royal City to attend the so-called Multi-Racial Conference.
At this moment, the Elf Royal City was undergoing post-disaster reconstruction work.
Because it was located in the central area of the battlefield.
The Elf Royal City had suffered wave after wave of brilliance.
If not for the ancient divine-level aura above, the Elf Royal City would have been destroyed by now.
In the sky above the Sky Island of the Elf Royal City, many battleships from various races were parked.
They were all invited by the Elf King to attend the Multi-Racial Conference.
Among the crowd, an elf girl saw Han Xing and others appear and gracefully flew over.
Upon closer inspection, it was Eliza.
When Eliza saw Han Xing, she immediately exclaimed excitedly, "Lord Han Xing! You’re finally here!"
"I’ve been waiting for you here for so long!"
Compared to the respect from their previous meeting.
Eliza’s attitude had undergone another drastic change this time.
The look in her eyes toward Han Xing was filled with strong admiration!
Han Xing smiled, "Was it the Elf King who asked you to wait for us here?"
Eliza shook her head, revealed a cute smile, and said, "No~ I applied to wait here for you myself."
"Just so I could see you, Lord Han Xing, at the first moment."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing laughed and said, "Then you’re giving me special treatment."

Eliza laughed lightly again and said, "Of course! After all, Saint Master Han Xing is now the great hero of our Elf Race and the fiancé of our Divine Maiden, so of course, we have to treat you specially~"
"Everyone admires and is curious about you!"
At this moment, Han Xing did indeed see many eyes watching him around.
These gazes bore no hostility; rather, they were filled with strong gratitude.
This time, Han Xing had defeated the Fearful Limb Demon God, which was equivalent to indirectly saving the entire Elf Royal City.
So, they all expressed their deep gratitude to Han Xing.
The team members also looked around at the elves’ gazes with great interest.
At this time, Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but jest, "It feels like these elves, ever since they heard about Brother Xing’s engagement to the Elf Goddess, their gazes have changed."
"But thankfully, they aren’t hostile gazes."
"It seems these elves quite approve of this marriage."
Shen Yun laughed and said, "What’s wrong, do you want Brother Xing to put on a show of talented young elves trying to steal the bride, only to be ruthlessly crushed by Brother Xing?"
Cheng Jianyong was taken aback, "It seems... that wouldn’t be impossible."
"Isn’t that how it’s always played out in movies and novels? But Brother Xing would play the villain, haha."
As everyone chatted, under Eliza’s guidance, they arrived at the Royal Capital Center.
In front of them appeared a magnificent Royal Palace.
Powerful figures from various races began to file in under the reception of the Elf Race envoys.
Han Xing and the others followed inside.
Immediately, a broad plaza appeared.
On the plaza, depending on the sizes of the largest races, thousands of chairs were arranged.
As everyone was confused about where to sit, Eliza poked her head out in front, waving at Han Xing, "Saint Master, over here, over here!"
Everyone walked over to where Eliza was.
Then they took their seats one by one.
Subsequently, more and more powerful figures from various races entered.
Before long, all these thousands of chairs were filled.
Han Xing and his team sat in the front row, with a vacant space in front, where three massive thrones were placed.
At the same time.
With a clear voice.
Three figures with powerful auras suddenly appeared.
They were the kings of the three great races.
At this moment, the Elf King stood in the center, his previous majesty restored.
He scanned the arena, pausing his gaze on Han Xing for a moment, then nodded slightly.
Moments later, the Elf King began his speech.
What he talked about.
Was nothing more than the unity of the Holy Spirit Realm, aiming at one goal, grasping two cores, and so on.
He talked for nearly half an hour, leaving people drowsy.
Beside him, the Dwarf King couldn’t hold back and cursed, "Miris, stop with the nonsense!"
"Get to the point quickly!"
Even the Giant King seemed speechless.
Upon hearing this, the Elf King coughed twice and said, "Cough, cough, sorry everyone, I got carried away."
"Well then, let’s officially begin this meeting to jointly discuss how to respond to the Abyss Realm."
Upon hearing this, the powerful figures from each race straightened up.

chapters.title: Chapter 786 - 435: Assembly of the Myriad Races (Part 2)
paragraphs: They also knew, the conversation to follow was quite crucial.
The Elf King said, "From the scale of this Abyss Realm invasion, we can see that the power of the Abyss Realm far exceeds our imagination."
"Countless Legendary Level and Demigod Level demons are not even the worst of it; each of these demons possesses a Burning Demon Body, a divine skill that significantly enhances their power."
"Their combat power at the same level is not weaker than our Holy Spirit Realm’s legends and demigods, perhaps even stronger."
"And besides these legends and demigods, there are even more powerful Demon Gods above them, and not just one."
"At present, it seems, our Holy Spirit Realm has no hope of stopping the Abyss Realm!"
As the Elf King spoke to this point, even his tone was a bit despondent.
The other strong figures present couldn’t help but feel a bit of despair as well.
No matter how unwilling they were to accept it, what the Elf King said was the truth.
With the current power of the Holy Spirit Realm, there’s fundamentally no way to resist the Abyss Realm.
At this moment, a demigod from the Centaur Race asked, "Elf King, according to what you’re saying, if the Abyss Realm invades us fully, we can’t even fight back."
The Elf King nodded, "If no other forces join us, then indeed, that is the case."
These words stirred discussions among the powerful figures of the various races.
The demigod from the Centaur Race continued to ask, "The three major races have developed for so long, surely there must be some hidden power?"
The Elf King shook his head, "As for the hidden power of the three major races, you’ve all probably seen it."
"It is an extremely old Divine Spirit."
"He is the fourth-generation Elf King of my race, having experienced the battle from a thousand years ago."
"To protect the safety of the Elf Race, the fourth-generation Elf King has held on by a breath."
"However, he has become too weak, nearly falling from the Divine Realm."
"Not even the Fearful Limb Demon God can he manage."
"Including the Dwarf Race and the Giant Race, their hidden power is also an ancient Divine Spirit..."
Upon hearing this, the people fell into silence once again.
But they believed that what the Elf King said was true.
After all, he disclosed his deepest secrets.
The Elf King continued, "However, everyone need not be too pessimistic."
"According to our understanding, the Abyss Realm currently cannot unreservedly activate teleportation arrays."
"To teleport a single Demon God over is already the Abyss Realm’s limit."
"If it’s only one Demon God, we can handle it by joining forces."
"If we coordinate with Saint Master Han Xing’s abilities, we might even kill it!"
Hearing this, the eyes of everyone from the various races lit up.
Yes!
They still have the power of the Human Race, and last night they witnessed firsthand the scene where a member of the Human Race took down the Fearful Limb Demon God!
Then, tens of thousands of eyes were all fixed on Han Xing and his group.
Han Xing quickly shook his head and said, "Don’t look at me."
"I am just a legend, not even a demigod."
"Last night, taking down the Fearful Limb, I had to use my trump card!"
"And trump cards can’t be used all the time."
Hearing this, the strong figures of the races were momentarily stunned.
At that moment, they also realized that this Master of the Human Race only had Legendary Level strength.
Previously, his repeated accomplishments, causing shock among the races, had caused people to unconsciously overlook his actual strength.
Especially last night, when even the Fearful Limb fell at his hands.
Such a feat is simply not something a legend can accomplish.
In a corner, a demigod-level strong figure, with a head like a chrysanthemum worm, asked, "Master of the Human Race, do you mean taking down the Fearful Limb was just a coincidence?"
Han Xing didn’t deny it.
At this, the scene was once again filled with sighs.
They all saw the regret in each other’s eyes.
The Three Kings exchanged glances, evidently surprised.
Because, if Han Xing had lost the godslaying ability, it greatly affected their plans.
The Elf King tentatively inquired, "Saint Master Han Xing, are you unable to use that method like last night again?"
Han Xing nodded.
The Giant Beast Tail Spike only had one use left.
This was something he held onto for life preservation, and he certainly couldn’t just use it all up like that.
The Elf King frowned, "This is problematic."

At this moment, a strong figure from the Ice Crystal Tiger Race stood up and said, "Then how are we supposed to fight? Without the godslaying method from the Human Race, any Demon God could come and slaughter us all."
"If you ask me, we might as well surrender directly."
A young man with a tri-colored deer emblem on his forehead spoke up in agreement, "Exactly."
"I think if the Human Race has lost its godslaying method, the marriage between the Elf Goddess and the Master of the Human Race can be called off."
"Only a true strong figure is worthy of the Divine Lady Elinora."
This statement garnered the agreement of many admirers of the Divine Maiden.
One by one, they chimed in support, demanding that the Elf King cancel the marriage between the Human Race and the Divine Lady Elinora.
The Giant King snorted, "A bunch of useless fools. Just because the Master of the Human Race lost the godslaying method, you don’t dare to fight against the Abyss Realm?"
"Your races have developed for so long, and you don’t have the backbone to sit here."
The young man with the tri-colored deer emblem angrily responded, "Giant King, what do you mean by that?"
"A race unable to fight against divine beings isn’t qualified to sit here?"
"You must remember, we’re here to help the Elf Race."
"If you think we’re unworthy, we can leave right now!"
With that, the young man stood up directly.

chapters.title: Chapter 787 - 435: Assembly of the Myriad Races (Part 3)
paragraphs: The Giant King didn’t stop them, still standing in place with a hint of coldness in his eyes.
At this moment, as the young man stood up, more powerful warriors from various races also stood up, seemingly about to leave the Elf Royal City.
The nearby warriors of various races showed concern in their eyes.
Now, with the Abyss Realm invasion, having one more warrior means having a bit more power,
but with so many warriors leaving all at once, the battles ahead will be even tougher.
The warriors of various races tried to persuade them, but they were directly refused.
Especially the young man from the Tri-colored Deer Race, who shouted loudly: "This is what the Giant King himself said!"
"Weak races are not qualified to participate in this war, so we don’t need to stay here with a thick face."
"You don’t need to stop me; if the Giant King doesn’t personally apologize to me, we won’t stay!"
Other warriors who intended to leave echoed: "That’s right, let the Giant King apologize to us!"
"Apologize!"
"Cancel the marriage between the Master of the Human Race and the Elf Goddess!"
Beside them, Han Xing’s eyes widened as he watched the commotion.
Damn it, you guys can argue, but why always drag me into it?
However, everyone knew what was going on in the minds of these people planning to leave.
They just wanted the Giant King to back down and to put pressure on the Elf King to cancel Elinora and Han Xing’s engagement.
At this moment, the Giant King still stood motionless.
Under everyone’s gaze, the Giant King slowly opened his mouth and said: "You guys are really good at twisting the facts here."
"You say you’re here to help, but who are you helping?"
"Even if you don’t fight, will the demons from the Abyss Realm spare you after invading?"
"And some of you are just afraid of the Abyss Realm’s power, worried about losing all your power here, finding this excuse to run away."
"I actually understand your little schemes."
Pointed out by the Giant King, those powerful warriors from various races intending to leave stood frozen.
They still wanted to argue.
Yet, the Giant King directly said: "But, you can leave if you want."
"However, while the entire Holy Spirit Realm is fighting to the death against the Abyss Realm, we won’t allow some races to hide in the back and watch.
"So, to support those races who dare to stand up and fight."
"Leaving races need to hand over all resources from their tribes to us, leaving only what is needed for daily life."
"Do you have any objections?"
The Giant King’s words shocked everyone on the field, who stared in astonishment at the towering giant.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong whispered in the team channel: "What does the Giant King want to do?"
"Such a demand, no one would agree to this, right?"
Han Xing thought for a moment and nodded: "Indeed, they wouldn’t agree, but let’s see how he handles it."
The team members listened and said no more.
Meanwhile, the warrior from the Tri-color Deer Race, upon hearing the Giant King’s demand, was momentarily stunned.
Then, he straightforwardly refused: "Delusional!"
"You want us to hand over all our resources? Why don’t you just rob us!"
Other warriors from various races echoed: "Exactly, exactly!"
"Why should we hand them over? I think this Giant King has gone mad!"
"Ignore him, let’s just go. Whoever wants to fight this war can fight it!"
Watching their departing figures, the Giant King remained unmoved.
Neither did the other two kings make any motion.
The remaining warriors of other races were left confused, with some inner doubts arising.
It was only then that the Giant King slowly spoke again: "It seems there’s something I didn’t make clear."
"So, let me reiterate."
"Today, any races leaving from here."
"If you refuse to submit resources, we will mobilize our armies to wage racial war against you."
"Until all the warriors of this tribe are completely eliminated from the Holy Spirit Realm."
"By the way, this statement is a notification, not a request."
Upon hearing this, not only did the group of warriors intending to leave freeze, but other warriors present were also immensely surprised.
The Giant King’s words meant that these departing races would face a war of retribution!
This became very serious.
It’s crucial to know that those leaving represent at least dozens of races.
If a war truly breaks out, a lot of people will die.
"Giant King, what do you mean by this?"
"Do you want to use force to make us comply?"
The warrior from the Tri-color Deer Race exclaimed in anger.
However, the Giant King nodded directly.
"That’s right, and this isn’t just the opinion of my tribe."
"This is the collective decision of our Three Major Races."
After saying this, the Elf King and Dwarf King both stepped forward.
The imposing auras of the three kings exploded at once.
The warriors intending to leave were struck as if by lightning, turning ghastly pale.
Especially the demigod from the Tri-color Deer Race, who was given special attention.
He was pressured by the aura of the Three Kings until blood trickled from the corner of his mouth.
At this, the Dwarf King snorted coldly: "Ah Ju is right! This is the joint decision of our Three Major Races!"
"We will not permit some others to hide in the back watching a joke while the rest bleed and battle!"
"If you disagree, we’re willing to forsake the fight against the Abyss Realm to annihilate you first!"
The Dwarf King said with murderous intent.
Although the Elf King didn’t speak, his divine power, now unleashed, proved his attitude.
Facing the pressure of the Three Major Races, those warriors from various races intending to leave found themselves in an awkward position.
The demigod from the Tri-color Deer Race seemed to attempt rallying other races’ warriors against the Three Major Races.
"Everyone, can you see this?"
"This is hegemonism by the Three Major Races! If we don’t comply, we’ll face extinction!"
"What do they take us for? Cannon fodder?"

At this moment, as the young man stood up, more powerful warriors from various races also stood up, seemingly about to leave the Elf Royal City.
The nearby warriors of various races showed concern in their eyes.
Now, with the Abyss Realm invasion, having one more warrior means having a bit more power,
but with so many warriors leaving all at once, the battles ahead will be even tougher.
The warriors of various races tried to persuade them, but they were directly refused.
Especially the young man from the Tri-colored Deer Race, who shouted loudly: "This is what the Giant King himself said!"
"Weak races are not qualified to participate in this war, so we don’t need to stay here with a thick face."
"You don’t need to stop me; if the Giant King doesn’t personally apologize to me, we won’t stay!"
Other warriors who intended to leave echoed: "That’s right, let the Giant King apologize to us!"
"Apologize!"
"Cancel the marriage between the Master of the Human Race and the Elf Goddess!"
Beside them, Han Xing’s eyes widened as he watched the commotion.
Damn it, you guys can argue, but why always drag me into it?
However, everyone knew what was going on in the minds of these people planning to leave.
They just wanted the Giant King to back down and to put pressure on the Elf King to cancel Elinora and Han Xing’s engagement.

Under everyone’s gaze, the Giant King slowly opened his mouth and said: "You guys are really good at twisting the facts here."
"You say you’re here to help, but who are you helping?"
"Even if you don’t fight, will the demons from the Abyss Realm spare you after invading?"
"And some of you are just afraid of the Abyss Realm’s power, worried about losing all your power here, finding this excuse to run away."
"I actually understand your little schemes."
Pointed out by the Giant King, those powerful warriors from various races intending to leave stood frozen.
They still wanted to argue.
Yet, the Giant King directly said: "But, you can leave if you want."
"However, while the entire Holy Spirit Realm is fighting to the death against the Abyss Realm, we won’t allow some races to hide in the back and watch.
"So, to support those races who dare to stand up and fight."
"Leaving races need to hand over all resources from their tribes to us, leaving only what is needed for daily life."
"Do you have any objections?"
The Giant King’s words shocked everyone on the field, who stared in astonishment at the towering giant.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong whispered in the team channel: "What does the Giant King want to do?"
"Such a demand, no one would agree to this, right?"
Han Xing thought for a moment and nodded: "Indeed, they wouldn’t agree, but let’s see how he handles it."
The team members listened and said no more.

Then, he straightforwardly refused: "Delusional!"
"You want us to hand over all our resources?

Other warriors from various races echoed: "Exactly, exactly!"
"Why should we hand them over?
I think this Giant King has gone mad!"
"Ignore him, let’s just go.
Whoever wants to fight this war can fight it!"
Watching their departing figures, the Giant King remained unmoved.
Neither did the other two kings make any motion.
The remaining warriors of other races were left confused, with some inner doubts arising.
It was only then that the Giant King slowly spoke again: "It seems there’s something I didn’t make clear."
"So, let me reiterate."
"Today, any races leaving from here."
"If you refuse to submit resources, we will mobilize our armies to wage racial war against you."
"Until all the warriors of this tribe are completely eliminated from the Holy Spirit Realm."
"By the way, this statement is a notification, not a request."
Upon hearing this, not only did the group of warriors intending to leave freeze, but other warriors present were also immensely surprised.
The Giant King’s words meant that these departing races would face a war of retribution!
This became very serious.
It’s crucial to know that those leaving represent at least dozens of races.
If a war truly breaks out, a lot of people will die.

"Do you want to use force to make us comply?"
The warrior from the Tri-color Deer Race exclaimed in anger.

chapters.title: Chapter 788 - 436: Hidden Powerhouses of All Races Emerge
paragraphs: In the face of the demigod’s questioning from the Tri-colored Deer Race, the Three Kings remained unmoved.
And at that moment, an entirely pitch-black figure suddenly appeared.
"I think the Dwarf King is right. When we were battling in the frontlines, if other races wanted to hide behind us and develop peacefully, it would be too unfair to us."
"For those races that only want to reap benefits without making any contributions, there’s no need for their existence; just annihilate them."
After saying this, all the powerful figures present turned their gaze towards him.
They found it was indeed the Divine Son of the Realm of Darkness.

The demigod of the Tri-colored Deer Race angrily retorted, "Dark Divine Son! It’s easy for you to say, but when the Abyss Realm invades and the Demon God descends, what will we use to defend ourselves?"
"We’ll use our lives to defend." The Dark Divine Son replied directly.
"If we cannot hold it off, then the complete annihilation of the Holy Spirit Realm is inevitable."
Hearing such straightforward words from the Dark Divine Son, the strong figures of various races were momentarily stunned.
Yet Han Xing and his companions looked at the Dark Divine Son with more than a hint of admiration in their eyes.
It had to be said, this guy’s temperament truly suited their taste.
Quite direct, not wasting words at all.
The demigod of the Tri-colored Deer Race fell silent.
A moment later, he swung his sleeve and said, "Then you use your lives to defend."
"I won’t be accompanying you, at worst, I’ll take my people and hide in the void."
"The void is vast, we’ll surely find a place to shelter."
Having said that, this demigod was about to leave.
And just at this moment.
A giant axe whistled down from the sky above his head!
The demigod of the Tri-colored Deer Race’s eyes widened in an instant, "Giant King, dare you!"
Before he could even finish speaking, that giant axe had already struck down!
"Damn it!"
The demigod of the Tri-colored Deer Race instantly burst forth with all his divine power, trying to resist.
However, he was merely an initial-tier demigod.
Compared to a top demigod like the Giant King, the gap was simply too vast.
The resistance with divine power lasted less than a second before his domain of divine power was directly cleaved by the Giant King’s axe.
"Clang!"
With a single strike, a blood line appeared in the middle of the demigod from the Tri-colored Deer Race’s body.
Then, blood gushed out.
In the astonished gazes of everyone present, this demigod was actually split in two!
At the same time, a bloody cloud appeared in the sky.
This was a sign that only appeared after a demigod from the Holy Spirit Realm died!
"I said, for the races that don’t agree, if they leave the Elf Royal City today, we will directly declare a war of annihilation."
The Giant King’s calm voice sounded.
"So, I ask you again, do you want to stay and fight together, or leave?"
At this moment, in the entire Elf Royal City, all beings gasped!
They did not expect the Giant King to be so decisive, striking just like that.
And moreover, this time he directly killed a demigod!
And indeed, they saw the determination of the Giant King.
Those major races that were about to leave sat back in their seats at this time.
When the Giant King’s gaze swept over them, they didn’t even dare to make eye contact with him.
Then, the Giant King looked at the remaining legends of the Tri-colored Deer Race with murderous intent.
Their bodies trembled like a screen, and they directly knelt on the ground, loudly saying, "N-No...don’t kill us!"
"The Tri-colored Deer Race is willing to fight alongside you all!"
Hearing this, the Giant King nodded in satisfaction and gradually retracted his imposing killing intent,
The remaining strong members of the Tri-colored Deer Race, as if having been granted a new life, breathed a sigh of relief.
Including the other races, none dared to bring up leaving again.
At this point, the Elf King said, "Then, let the meeting continue."
"Let us continue discussing how to respond to the invasion of the Abyss Realm."
However, this time, due to the bloody incident, the experts of various major races dared not speak.
The atmosphere became somewhat heavy.
At this time, the Dark Divine Son chuckled lightly, "Why is everyone being so serious?"
"That fellow with no sense is dead, so what is there to care so much about?"
Seeing the Dark Divine Son speak, a powerful member of the One-Eyed Ape Race beside him asked, "But, that was a demigod."
"Our Holy Spirit Realm already lacks powerful figures, killing him like this, isn’t it inappropriate?"
The Dark Divine Son laughed, "Nothing to worry about, our Hel Divine Son has already awakened."
"Moreover, he will also fight alongside us."
Upon hearing the name Hel Divine Son, everyone seemed to feel a bit familiar.
Someone tentatively asked, "Is Hel Divine Son the one from the Realm of Darkness three thousand years ago?"
The Dark Divine Son nodded.
The room immediately erupted with excitement!
"Oh my, that Hel Divine Son was reputed to be the most talented Divine Son of the Dark Divine Race in millennia, also the most hopeful to break through to the Divine Realm!"
"But wasn’t there a rumor that he had died, having failed to find an alternative method to break through to the Divine Realm?"
The Dark Divine Son explained, "Hel Divine Son did not die, he merely felt hopeless in breaking through to the Divine Realm, so he sealed all his powers and fell into a dormant state."
"Now, sensing the threat from the Abyss Realm, he has awakened from his dormant state and his power has progressed further."
"Currently, Hel Divine Son also possesses the combat strength of a top demigod!"
As if responding to the words of the Dark Divine Son,
on the Sky Island Continent of the Elves, from the direction of the army of the Realm of Darkness, an immensely strong aura suddenly erupted!
The ascending black light instantly enveloped the entire Elf Royal Capital.
Its might was not even inferior to the aura the Giant King had just released!

chapters.title: Chapter 789 - 436: Hidden Powerhouses of All Races Emerge (Part 2)
paragraphs: Feeling the strength of this aura, Cheng Jianyong exclaimed, "Brother Xing, is there such a powerful presence hidden in the Realm of Darkness?"
"Last time when we went there, didn’t we only discover an extremely ancient Divine Spirit?"
Han Xing nodded and said, "At that time, I did feel a peculiar aura in the Realm of Darkness besides that Divine Spirit, but it was so weak, it seemed almost dead, so I didn’t pay attention to it."
"I never expected this existence could reawaken and possess the power of a top Demigod."
If even Han Xing didn’t expect it, it’s no wonder others wouldn’t have either.
Shen Yun sighed at this moment, "It seems the Giant King was right. After so much development, no race would be without some hidden cards."
Han Xing nodded, "That’s right. If these peculiar auras are all those strong presences that have sealed themselves."
"Then perhaps it’s not just the Realm of Darkness that has such hidden powers."
"The Sea of Light, the three major races, they might all have them."
As if to validate Han Xing’s speculation.
Just as the words fell, the strong figures from other races began to speak up.
"Our Black-winged Bird Race’s Dusk Race Master has sensed the invasion of the Abyss Realm and has awakened from slumber."
"The Mingyao Divine Son of the Sea of Light has awoken."
"The Child of the Earth from the Dwarf Race has awakened."
Strong figures of various major races began to speak, revealing names that had disappeared for thousands of years, yet were still familiar to the ears.
Each name mentioned brought another wave of excitement to everyone’s hearts!
At the same time, terrifying auras began to rise around.
Among them were some that were not inferior to the Divine Son Hel from the Realm of Darkness!
Seeing this scene, the various races of the Holy Spirit Realm gained a significant boost in confidence.
Although, there still hadn’t appeared any Divine Level strong figures, the various races felt quite gratified.
After all, it’s a publicly acknowledged fact that the strong figures in the Holy Spirit Realm can’t break through to the Divine Realm.
Otherwise, these ancient genius demons would not have chosen to seal their powers.
At this time, Han Xing couldn’t help but exclaim in admiration.
"It seems indeed, there are quite a lot of geniuses in the Holy Spirit Realm."
"All of a sudden so many ancient high-tier demigods and top demigods have appeared."
"These strong figures were able to cultivate to this level in this era. If the rules weren’t entirely occupied, they could all break through to Divine Spirit, or even True God."
The members nodded in agreement, feeling deeply regretful at the same time.
If the Holy Spirit Realm suddenly produced so many Divine Spirits, it wouldn’t be so difficult to counter the Abyss Realm this time around.
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly sensed a familiar aura among those top-tier strong figures.
He said with interest, "Huh? This guy is here too?"
"Perfect, I was about to go find him."
However, the meeting was still ongoing, so Han Xing didn’t leave midway.
He waited until the Elf King finished speaking mostly.
Only then did Han Xing stand up and leave.
A dozen minutes later.
Han Xing and his group were casually strolling in the Elf Royal Capital, taking in the local customs.
Almost eighty percent of the races in the Holy Spirit Realm had representatives in the Elf Realm.
So the Royal Capital seemed incredibly prosperous.
Walking through several streets filled with greenery, Han Xing navigated this plant-maze-like Elf Main City.
The passing elves would eagerly greet Han Xing.
Of course, Han Xing and the others would respond with smiles.
After crossing several streets.
In a rather secluded area, Han Xing saw an old man sitting quietly at a distance.
When Han Xing approached, the old man slowly lifted his head, revealing a peculiar smile.
His skin cracked like bark, his body extremely thin, as if a gust of wind could blow him over.
The team members searched their memories but had no impression of such an old man.
However, Han Xing said with interest, "Yo, Old Tree, it seems you’ve recovered quite well over this long time?"
Hearing this, the old man laughed and shook his head, "It’s thanks to Saint Master Han Xing for helping me with my persistent illness."
"Otherwise, I might not even be able to stand here to meet Saint Master Han Xing."
The team members realized.
This old man was the ancient tree in the Sky Island Forest, possessing top demigod strength.
No wonder his aura was so astonishing.
This guy was a super strong figure with top demigod strength!
"Oh my, Old Tree, it’s you!" Cheng Jianyong exclaimed.
The old man nodded with a smile toward the team members, "It’s me, my friends of the Human Race, you all look well."
"Last time we met, you had just broken through to the Legend."
"Looking at you now, you’ve all reached the Legendary Limit."
Cheng Jianyong proudly said, "Of course, our speed in becoming stronger far exceeds your imagination."
"But, it seems like your recovery isn’t going so well, is it?"
"You look like you’re half a step into the grave!"
Faced with Cheng Jianyong’s joke, the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots wasn’t angered, but laughed and shook his head, "Yes, I’m too old now, can’t compare to you young people."
"I now find it difficult even to move a few steps. It was the news of the Abyss Realm’s invasion that made me risk my life to painstakingly come here."
Hearing how the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots described his plight so miserably, Cheng Jianyong felt embarrassed to joke further.
Instead, he patted his shoulder and said, "I didn’t expect you’d be so righteous, Old Tree, not even caring about your own life for the sake of the Holy Spirit Realm."

paragraphs: "A true man!"
Cheng Jianyong slapped his shoulder with a crisp sound.
The Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots appeared frail as if it couldn’t withstand a gust of wind.
However, Han Xing stood beside him with a face full of disdain and said, "Enough, Old Tree, stop pretending."
"Even in your weakened state before, you were about on par with the Elf King and the others in terms of power."
"Now after recovering for so long, you should be nearing that breakthrough, right?"
The Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots shook its head with a wry smile, saying, "Saint Master Han Xing, you overestimate this old fool."
"Even at my peak, I could at best be an equal with beings like the Elf King."
"My advantage is vast life force; fighting is not my strong point."
Han Xing still didn’t believe him.
Yet, the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots was embarrassed to keep pretending.
The next moment, a surge of vast life force burst forth from it.
The purity of this life force’s aura even exceeded the limits of an average demigod!
Throughout the Elf Royal Capital, countless plants grew wildly in an instant.
This scene made Cheng Jianyong gasp in shock.
He slapped the old man’s shoulder and spoke aloud, "Damn, Old Tree, are you playing the disguised tiger with me?"
The Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots shook its head helplessly.
It looked at Han Xing and said, "Saint Master Han Xing, did you come here specifically to find me for something?"
Han Xing nodded, "There are two things I wanted to ask you about."
"The first thing, I think you should know."
"Currently, so many top demigods from various races are stuck at this stage, unable to break through."
"You’ve lived for so long, do you have any other methods to help them break through to the Divine Realm?"
"If successful, it would be a great achievement!"
The Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots sighed helplessly, "Saint Master Han Xing, you overestimate me yet again.
"Those geniuses you see today are the most dazzling prodigies of their era."
"Over the years, they must have tried countless methods."
"If even those genius demons can’t break through, how could an old tree like me?"
"The only thing I have over them is my long lifespan."
Han Xing nodded as he listened.
He could tell that the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots wasn’t lying.
Moreover, if it really had a method to break through the divine realm, it would have tried it out already.
It wouldn’t have been tormented by the God of Tricks’ curse for so long either.
However, Han Xing knew of two methods to possess divine-level combat power without mastering rules.
The first method is like the one in the ancient ruins, where the Insect Race modified flesh bodies, a unique path to godhood.
The second method is to devour 100 Demon God’s Hearts, refining oneself into a rule.
However, both methods are difficult and not suitable for the current Holy Spirit Realm’s strong individuals.
Thus, mentioning them isn’t much help.
At this moment, Han Xing continued, "Then the second question."
"I want to know, you mentioned last time that breaking through by condensing your own divine format wouldn’t be restricted by rules.
"So, what exactly are the conditions needed to condense a divine format?"
This was the question Han Xing most wanted to know and the reason he sought out this ancient tree.
Upon hearing this, the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots’ expression immediately changed.
It cast a divine power seal instantly, covering the area where everyone was.
Moments later, the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots took on a cryptic demeanor and whispered, "Saint Master Han Xing, it’s best not to ask about this method."
"With the Abyss Realm invasion, the rules in various places have become active again."
"Talking about this further might result in punishment from certain forces!"
Han Xing was taken aback, and without the taboos of the ancient tree, he asked directly, "Are you saying that even mentioning this method would result in punishment by the rules?"
The Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots nodded, "Yes."
Hearing this, Han Xing was somewhat infuriated and said, "Damn these old guys."
"The Holy Spirit Realm is in danger, yet they won’t act, instead finding ways to prevent us from breaking through to the divine realm.
"What exactly do they want?"
Everyone was naturally aware of who Han Xing was cursing.
At that moment, thunderclouds had already gathered above their heads.
Same as before, any creature that spoke disrespectfully of those beings would be sensed and then punished by the thunderclouds.
However, because the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots had set a divine power seal in advance, the thunderclouds couldn’t find a target to attack.
At this point, the ancient tree sighed and said, "This method is actually one of the Holy Spirit Realm’s taboos, and hardly any living beings know it now."
"Taboo? Why?" Han Xing asked in confusion.
The ancient tree replied, "Because the two existences that condensed their divine formats had such tremendous impacts that they even disrupted those beings’ ruling positions."
"As a result, they united to establish rules again, prohibiting any mention of such matters."
"Including recording them on sound recording stones, verbal elaboration, etc..."
"Even those who knew of these methods have been dying off, one by one."
Speaking of this, the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots said with some lingering fear, "I even suspect that the curse from the God of Tricks against me was because I knew of related methods."
"If I hadn’t sensed this early on, I might have been directly erased!"
"So, it’s not that I won’t tell you this matter, but this old fool is also powerless."
Han Xing furrowed his brows.
Just knowing it might bring death upon oneself.
Were it not for the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots’ incredible life force, it probably would have died long ago.
No wonder the tree’s face changed when it heard this question.
Han Xing pondered for a moment and then asked again, "Since it would be sensed within the Holy Spirit Realm."
"What if we go into the Void?"
The Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots shook its head, "Same."

chapters.title: Chapter 791 - 437: Methods to Break the Rule
paragraphs: "Those beings are omniscient and all-knowing."
"No matter where you are, as long as you discuss these topics or touch upon the taboos set by them, they will sense it."
"You must understand, even as powerful as the Demon Emperor, he cannot resist these beings who infiltrate the Abyss Realm with the Power of Rules."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing’s eyes were filled with intense shock,
"You mean, even the Demon Emperor is no match for those who set the rules?"
The Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots quickly shook its head, "Cannot say, cannot say..."
Han Xing furrowed his brows once more.
He realized the gravity of the situation.
From the few words of the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots, he gleaned a terrifying piece of information.
That is, as powerful as the Demon Emperor is, he might also be no match for those beings.
And he is a supreme force of a world.
Even surpassing True God-level existence.
Yet still, he isn’t a match for those who control the rules.
Just how powerful are those guys?
Han Xing’s heart grew heavier.
The more he understood, the more it filled him with despair...
Even though he already possessed the power to slay gods.
But now, he realized that godslaying was merely a threshold.
Above there are still stronger True Gods, Demon Emperors, and those beings who set the rules...
How many such powerful existences are there in this world?
Han Xing increasingly felt a sense of pressure.
At this moment, as everyone conversed, the thunderclouds above gathered more terrifyingly.
Almost reaching the level to severely wound a Middle-tier Demigod.
Once the Divine Power Barrier of the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots was lifted,
the thunderclouds would become even stronger.
However, Han Xing was unwilling to give up.
Knowing now that there were so many terrifying enemies above.
He was determined to work hard to enhace his own strength,
Condensing his own Divine Format was one of the goals Han Xing set for himself.
No matter how difficult this task was, he would complete it.
Han Xing did not plan to break into the Divine Realm using ordinary methods,
Because, even beings like the Demon Emperor and the Hunter who had condensed their own Divine Formats,
one perished and the other entered the Abyss Realm.
If Han Xing couldn’t achieve similar levels, or even surpass them, then there was no point in discussing the future.
Thinking of this, Han Xing said, "Old Tree, if, I mean if."
"I have the power to confront True God-level entities in my hands, would you be willing to risk telling me the method?"
Upon hearing this, the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots was instantly shocked.
It stared at Han Xing in amazement and said, "Saint Master Han Xing, are you speaking the truth?"
Han Xing nodded.
He decided to show the power of Ten Thousand Stars City to the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots.
According to Han Xing’s current estimates.
Advanced Defense Towers in a volley should be able to severely injure True God-level beings.
Once the Elf King provided the materials promised during the last sacrifice of the Ancient Spirit Wood,
and when the Divine Demon Battleship was completed,
Han Xing’s strength could improve further.
Seeing Han Xing’s acknowledgment, the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots was already beyond shocked!
Do you know what it means to deal with a True God?
It’s an existence that integrates itself with the rules and is indestructible!
Far beyond the likes of ordinary Divine Spirits like the God of Tricks.
Even beings like the Fearful Limb Demon God have no ability to resist against a True God.
And now, this Legendary Level human claimed that he had the power to deal with True Gods.
This was truly overturning the understanding of the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots!
Looking at Han Xing’s determined gaze, the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots struggled for a moment, seemingly making a decision.
"Saint Master Han Xing, I can tell you!"
"However, once I reveal this method, an extremely terrifying thunder tribulation will definitely be drawn!"
"At that time, this thunder tribulation will need the help of Saint Master Han Xing to block it."
Han Xing nodded, "That is of course no problem."
Without further delay, Han Xing immediately took the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots, and with a flash, left the Elf Royal Capital.
Half an hour later.
Han Xing, along with five others and an elder, simultaneously arrived atop Ten Thousand Stars City.
At the same time.
Han Xing removed the Divine Power Barriers from the defense towers and Calamity Towers of Ten Thousand Stars City.
The instant the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots saw those defense towers, its pupils shrank.
"High-tier Ancient Weapon, Frozen Star Cannon, Godslaying Cannon! And the Abyss Realm’s Dark Energy Cannon!"
"And these strange structures, could they be the Catastrophe-level Defense Towers developed recently by the Dwarf Race?"
This ancient tree truly lived for tens of thousands of years.
It recognized the names of these defense towers with a single glance.
After witnessing the full extent of the high-tier defense towers atop Ten Thousand Stars City, the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots looked at Han Xing in astonishment.
"Saint Master Han Xing, you must have spent a fortune on materials to build so many defense towers?"
"Where did you get so many High-Level Materials from?"
Han Xing smiled, "I have my ways, of course."
Han Xing certainly couldn’t tell the ancient tree that he raided a Divine Treasure Vault and a civilization’s relic.
Upon hearing this, the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots didn’t inquire further but said, "Saint Master Han Xing, these defense towers are strong indeed, but from what I understand,"
"even the quantity of these in your territory would only pose a threat to beings of Divine Spirit Level."
"It is still far from harming a True God."
Han Xing seemed to know the tree would say that and nodded, "If it were just these defense towers, I wouldn’t dare claim I have the confidence to contend with a True God."

chapters.title: Chapter 792 - 437: Methods to Break the Rule
paragraphs: "Old Tree, take another look."
At this moment, Han Xing directly activated all the high-tier defense towers on the territory.
Simultaneously, the two Sun Crown Steles began to emit endless Holy Light, amplifying all the defense towers.
At this moment, those defense towers, which already possessed destructive power, seemed to undergo a qualitative change in an instant!
"Buzz!"
The terrifying power’s pressure caused the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots to tremble.
"Holy Artifact! Such a strong aura of a Holy Artifact!"
"My heavens... this is actually a special type of Holy Artifact that can enhance defense towers!"
"The power of those defense towers has increased by at least two or three times!"
Seeing the shocked gaze of the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots, Han Xing chuckled lightly and said, "Old Tree, now can these defense towers’ firepower harm a True God?"
The Old Tree nodded with difficulty, "Indeed they can."
"I didn’t expect that Saint Master Han Xing would still be hiding such terrifying power."
"With this Sky Island, even if five or six Demon Gods from the Abyss Realm were to be transmitted simultaneously, they wouldn’t be your match!"
The Old Tree praised sincerely.
Han Xing nodded; this roughly matched his predictions.
With the firepower of Ten Thousand Stars City, it could at most deal with five or six Divine Spirit Level experts simultaneously.
"Old Tree, remember to keep this secret for me," Han Xing reminded.
The Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots nodded repeatedly, "Saint Master Han Xing, rest assured."
"However, there’s one more thing I need to remind you of."
Han Xing replied, "Go ahead."
"The firepower on your Sky Island, combined with the Holy Artifact’s enhancement, is indeed sufficient to harm an average True God."
"But you should know that a True God is an existence fully integrated with the rules."
"Saint Master Han Xing, do you understand what that means?"
Han Xing furrowed his brow and then shook his head, "I don’t understand."
The Old Tree continued, "This means that a True God can infinitely absorb power from the rules, just as they can infinitely resurrect, as long as you don’t strike them down in one blow."
"No matter how severe the damage a True God suffers, they will instantly recover.
"Do you understand now, Saint Master Han Xing?"
Han Xing was stunned for a moment upon hearing this.
He understood the Old Tree’s implication: it’s not enough just to harm a True God; one must strike them down in a single blow to hope to slay them.
This was too unbelievable.
Even the team members beside him inhaled sharply.
Cheng Jianyong said in shock, "Old Tree, are True Gods really that abnormal?"
The Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots rolled its eyes at him, "What else do you think? What does it mean to be one with the rules?"
"The gap between a True God and a Divine Spirit is even greater than the gap from Tier Five to Legendary."
"A True God represents true invincibility."
"Even if a Demon God from the Abyss Realm encounters a True God, they would merely be poked to death with a finger."
Everyone was left stunned again upon hearing this.
At the same time, they felt even more despair in their hearts.
The Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots seemed to know that this would discourage everyone.
So it consoled them, "There’s no need to be disheartened, everyone."
"You must know, you are merely at the Legendary Level, and a True God is three major realms away from you."
"Although you rely on defense towers, being able to harm a True God is an unprecedented feat throughout history."
Upon hearing the Old Tree’s consolation, everyone seemed to realize this point.
Yeah! Heck, I’m only a Legend!
Not even a Demigod yet!
Han Xing also seemed to regain his confidence.
He looked at the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots and said, "Old Tree, now can you tell me the method to condense a Divine Format within oneself?"
The Old Tree asked, "Are you sure you want to say it here?"
Han Xing was a bit puzzled, "Is there a problem?
The Old Tree shook its head and pointed skyward, saying, "If you say it here, it might elicit a violation of the rules, triggering a terrifying lightning tribulation."
"The extent of that lightning tribulation is so terrifying, it might even cover the entire Elf Realm."
Hearing this, Han Xing understood the Old Tree’s concern.
If such a lightning tribulation were to descend, and Han Xing used the territory defense towers to withstand it, the commotion would be great.
By then, everyone would know his trump card.
Thinking of this, Han Xing patted the Old Tree’s shoulder and said, "Good thinking, Old Tree."
"Let’s leave the Elf Realm and find a void region first."
With that, Han Xing controlled Ten Thousand Stars City, heading outside the Elf Realm with the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots.
At this moment, the Elf King also sensed Han Xing’s departure, feeling a bit puzzled.
And when he saw that the Thunder Beasts brought by the High Priest of the Witch Race were still there, he thought no more of it.
A day later.
Han Xing and the others had already traveled tens of millions of kilometers away from the Elf Realm.
In the void, Han Xing looked at the Old Tree beside him and asked, "Can you speak now, Old Tree?"
The Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots chuckled and nodded, "I can."
"Then, let me start with the first condition for condensing a Divine Format."
Han Xing’s expression turned serious as he began to listen carefully.
"The first condition is to complete a qualitative transformation of your own divine power."
"Transformation?" Han Xing asked, puzzled.
"Yes, it’s similar to the Dwarf King and the Elf King in elevating the quality of their divine power to the limit."
As the Old Tree finished this sentence, a massive thundercloud had already appeared out of thin air in the void, covering tens of thousands of kilometers in the blink of an eye.
"Rumble! Rumble!"
The sound of thunder echoed continuously, as if warning them.
However, the people present paid it no mind.
The Old Tree, ignoring the thundercloud above, continued, "It seems to me, Saint Master Han Xing, that you have already met this condition."

"Saint Master Han Xing, do you understand what that means?"
Han Xing furrowed his brow and then shook his head, "I don’t understand."
The Old Tree continued, "This means that a True God can infinitely absorb power from the rules, just as they can infinitely resurrect, as long as you don’t strike them down in one blow."
"No matter how severe the damage a True God suffers, they will instantly recover.
"Do you understand now, Saint Master Han Xing?"
Han Xing was stunned for a moment upon hearing this.
He understood the Old Tree’s implication: it’s not enough just to harm a True God; one must strike them down in a single blow to hope to slay them.
This was too unbelievable.
Even the team members beside him inhaled sharply.
Cheng Jianyong said in shock, "Old Tree, are True Gods really that abnormal?"
The Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots rolled its eyes at him, "What else do you think?
What does it mean to be one with the rules?"
"The gap between a True God and a Divine Spirit is even greater than the gap from Tier Five to Legendary."
"A True God represents true invincibility."
"Even if a Demon God from the Abyss Realm encounters a True God, they would merely be poked to death with a finger."
Everyone was left stunned again upon hearing this.
At the same time, they felt even more despair in their hearts.
The Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots seemed to know that this would discourage everyone.
So it consoled them, "There’s no need to be disheartened, everyone."
"You must know, you are merely at the Legendary Level, and a True God is three major realms away from you."
"Although you rely on defense towers, being able to harm a True God is an unprecedented feat throughout history."
Upon hearing the Old Tree’s consolation, everyone seemed to realize this point.
Yeah!
Heck, I’m only a Legend!
Not even a Demigod yet!
Han Xing also seemed to regain his confidence.
He looked at the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots and said, "Old Tree, now can you tell me the method to condense a Divine Format within oneself?"
The Old Tree asked, "Are you sure you want to say it here?"
Han Xing was a bit puzzled, "Is there a problem?
The Old Tree shook its head and pointed skyward, saying, "If you say it here, it might elicit a violation of the rules, triggering a terrifying lightning tribulation."
"The extent of that lightning tribulation is so terrifying, it might even cover the entire Elf Realm."
Hearing this, Han Xing understood the Old Tree’s concern.
If such a lightning tribulation were to descend, and Han Xing used the territory defense towers to withstand it, the commotion would be great.
By then, everyone would know his trump card.
Thinking of this, Han Xing patted the Old Tree’s shoulder and said, "Good thinking, Old Tree."
"Let’s leave the Elf Realm and find a void region first."
With that, Han Xing controlled Ten Thousand Stars City, heading outside the Elf Realm with the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots.
At this moment, the Elf King also sensed Han Xing’s departure, feeling a bit puzzled.
And when he saw that the Thunder Beasts brought by the High Priest of the Witch Race were still there, he thought no more of it.
A day later.
Han Xing and the others had already traveled tens of millions of kilometers away from the Elf Realm.
In the void, Han Xing looked at the Old Tree beside him and asked, "Can you speak now, Old Tree?"
The Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots chuckled and nodded, "I can."
"Then, let me start with the first condition for condensing a Divine Format."
Han Xing’s expression turned serious as he began to listen carefully.
"The first condition is to complete a qualitative transformation of your own divine power."
"Transformation?" Han Xing asked, puzzled.
"Yes, it’s similar to the Dwarf King and the Elf King in elevating the quality of their divine power to the limit."
As the Old Tree finished this sentence, a massive thundercloud had already appeared out of thin air in the void, covering tens of thousands of kilometers in the blink of an eye.
"Rumble!
Rumble!"
The sound of thunder echoed continuously, as if warning them.
However, the people present paid it no mind.
The Old Tree, ignoring the thundercloud above, continued, "It seems to me, Saint Master Han Xing, that you have already met this condition."

chapters.title: Chapter 793 - 437: Methods to Break the Rule (Part 3)
paragraphs: Han Xing nodded.
That is true indeed.
Ever since the trial with the Master of War Ghosts, Han Xing’s Divine Power had undergone a mystical transformation.
According to the Ancient Tree, it was about enhancing one’s Divine Power Value to its limits.
"What about the second condition, Old Tree?" Han Xing continued to ask.
The Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots said, "The second condition also relates to Divine Power."
"Besides the transformation of Divine Power, it is necessary to enhance one’s Divine Power Value to an extreme degree in the Legendary Realm."
Boom!
The Leiyun above expanded once again by double, and a lightning bolt several kilometers thick swiftly formed, striking directly toward Ten Thousand Stars City.
At the same time.
Above Ten Thousand Stars City, ten Towers of Annihilation Lightning erupted simultaneously, blasting toward the sky.
Pop!
The two distinct forces of lightning clashed in an instant and then neutralized each other.
In an instant, they dissipated into nothingness.
Han Xing didn’t pay attention to the commotion above his head but continued to ask, "Is there a limit to the enhancement of Divine Power Value?"
The Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots nodded, "Of course, every power has its limit."
"The reason why we ordinary Legends and Demigods cannot sense it is that, despite our Talent, we may never reach the limit in our lifetime."
Having heard this, Han Xing nodded and continued to ask, "Old Tree, to what extent must it be enhanced to be considered at the limit?"
The Ancient Tree pondered for a moment, seemingly considering how to explain it to Han Xing.
A moment later, the Ancient Tree said, "Saint Master Han Xing, release your Divine Power, let me sense its strength."
Han Xing complied.
The next moment, a pure golden Divine Power was released from Han Xing’s body.

Feeling this immense Divine Power, the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots nodded appreciatively, saying, "Impressive, Saint Master Han Xing’s Divine Power Value has already reached such a formidable level."
"It even approaches surpassing this old tree!"
Han Xing asked, "How far is it from the limit you mentioned?"
The Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots was about to answer.
The Leiyun above suddenly flashed.
Dazzling light illuminated the endless radiance.
Then, a terrifying lightning bolt, over ten thousand meters in diameter, descended fiercely from the sky!
Everyone felt the terror of this strike!
Even a top Demigod like the Elf King would likely be severely injured by directly confronting this wave of lightning bombardment.
This time, Han Xing added twenty Spiritual Godslaying Cannons and twenty Dark Energy Cannons to the ten Towers of Annihilation Lightning.
Boom!
A concentrated assault surged into the sky.
It collided instantly with that terrifying lightning.
The collision of energy against energy made the already chaotic Void become even more volatile!
But ultimately, Han Xing managed to offset the power of this lightning tribulation.
The Ancient Tree continued to speak, "I see that Saint Master Han Xing’s Divine Power strength has already far exceeded that of an ordinary Legendary Powerhouse."
"But it is still a long way from the limit."
"According to my estimation, you have reached about one-eighth of the level."
Upon hearing this figure, Han Xing fell into contemplation.
His current Divine Power Value had reached twenty-three thousand.
One-eighth, that means at least two hundred thousand!
At this moment, not only Han Xing but also the other team members felt a bit shocked in their hearts.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed in surprise, "Are you kidding?"
"Two hundred thousand Divine Power Value, even a top Demigod like the Elf King can’t reach this number, right?"
"A Legendary Level requiring 200,000 Divine Power Value, that’s too outrageous..."
The Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots laughed, "If it weren’t outrageous, there wouldn’t have been only two people achieving this feat throughout the ages."
Everyone nodded.
Han Xing then asked, "Old Tree, are these the only two conditions?"
The Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots shook its head, "Of course not."
"Besides these two conditions, there’s a final one, which is also the most difficult."
As it was about to speak.
The Leiyun above seemed to be stimulated, starting to flicker madly.
The next moment, at least dozens and even hundreds of thunders fell wildly like a torrential rain.
Boom! Boom!
The horrifying energy fluctuations made everyone’s hair stand on end!
And Han Xing was not polite with these thunders.
At that moment, he directly activated all the High-tier Defense Towers on Ten Thousand Stars City.
To directly endure that terrifying thunderstorm.
Buzz!
Two vast energies touched instantly.
The entire Void fell into a state of chaos.
Even Ten Thousand Stars City was shaking violently.
However, this Ten Thousand Stars City, which was infused with Han Xing’s blood and various materials, at this moment demonstrated its terrifying power!
Not only did it take all the devastating thunders from above.
It even charged into the sky, directly shattering that Leiyun.
Yet, this act seemed to anger some kind of existence!
The next moment, a more enormous Leiyun began to brew.
Han Xing did not mind, and instead looked at the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots, saying, "Old Tree, please continue."
The Ancient Tree nodded, "The third condition is to master ten Powers of Rules."
At these words, Han Xing’s pupils instantly contracted.
"To master ten Powers of Rules means to take on those Divine Spirits..."
The Ancient Tree nodded, "That’s correct."
"It is for this reason that the method to condense a Divine Format has been collectively sealed by those entities..."
At this moment, Han Xing fell into deep thought.
The Leiyun above was still forming, and in a split second, it broke through the limits of the Demigod, reaching a level truly capable of seriously injuring a Divine Spirit!
However, that seemed to be the limit of Leiyun.
The next moment, dozens of thunders capable of severely injuring a Divine Level crashed down!
Han Xing didn’t spare a glance and directly controlled all the Defense Towers on Ten Thousand Stars City to engage in a frontal collision.
After resolving the Leiyun, Han Xing was about to bid farewell to the Ancient Tree.
And at that moment, the Ancient Tree said something strange to Han Xing...

chapters.title: Chapter 794 - 438: Defense Tower Expansion, Divine Demon Battleship Completed!
paragraphs: As everyone was about to leave, the Ancient Tree suddenly said something strange to Han Xing.
"Saint Master Han Xing, if one day, I mean if."
"I suddenly disappeared from this world, would you still remember my existence?"
Han Xing, puzzled, replied, "Old Tree, what are you talking about? Even if you got taken down, I would still remember you."
"What’s going on, did you provoke some old eternal being, afraid no one will collect your body?"
"Tell me who it is, and I’ll help you take them down!"
The Ancient Tree smiled and shook its head, "No, it’s just a vague premonition in my heart."
"In the future, I hope Saint Master Han Xing remembers what you said today."
"To be honest, I’m really afraid of death, but I’m even more afraid of being forgotten..."
Half an hour later.
The Ten Thousand Stars City returned from the Void to the Holy Spirit Realm.
However, at this time, Han Xing was deeply thinking about the last words said by the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots.
Clearly, the Ancient Tree was worried about something but didn’t dare to say it.
After pondering for a long time, Han Xing was still at a loss.
Then he shook his head and said, "Forget it, never mind."
"Once I have enough power, these things will reveal themselves."
"For now, let’s study the method of condensing the Divine Format."
Han Xing summarized the three conditions mentioned by the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots.
The first is to reach 200,000 Divine Power Value in the Legendary Realm.
As it stands, Han Xing is still far from this, needing at least 170,000 more Divine Power Value.
Han Xing pondered, "To quickly increase my Divine Power Value, I have several methods here."
"The first is through killing a large number of creatures, refining their souls into Soul Crystals."
"But this method requires a vast number of creatures to be killed, like last time when I wiped out so many ogre soldiers, it only boosted my Divine Power Value by about 4,000 points."
"The second method is to collect a lot of Divine Formats and absorb the divine power contained within them."
"A single Divine Format can also increase several thousand Divine Power Value.
"And then the third method is using Ancient Spirit Wood to help the World Tree recover, enabling this Holy Tree to bestow more blessings."
Without a doubt, these three methods.
Using Ancient Spirit Wood offers the highest cost-effectiveness.
But now, the Survivors have very few Ancient Spirit Woods left.
Therefore, using all three methods, Han Xing can reach 200,000 Divine Power Value in a short time!
Thinking of this, Han Xing already had a direction.
As for the second condition, the transformation of divine power.
He has already achieved this, so there’s nothing more to say.
Then comes the third condition.
Master at least ten rules.
Which means Han Xing has to slay at least ten divine spirits.
No wonder only two entities have completed these three conditions throughout history.
Because it’s just too outrageous.
Even Han Xing can only strive towards this goal.
A day later.
Han Xing returned to the Elf Realm again.
As everyone anticipated, after the Abyss Realm’s failed invasion this time, they wouldn’t conduct large-scale invasions again in a short period.
Over two days passed.
The Elf Realm saw the Abyss Realm’s teleportation array open only four or five times.
This also gave the strong individuals of the Holy Spirit Realm some breathing room.
And shortly after returning to the Elf Realm, Han Xing received a message, his expression somewhat perplexed.
Cheng Jianyong, with a puzzled look, asked, "What’s up Brother Xing?"
Han Xing shook his head and said, "The Elf King wants us to go over again."
Everyone was startled for a moment after hearing this.
It seems the Elf King has taken a liking to calling Han Xing often.
Shen Yun curiously asked, "Did he say what it’s about?"
Cheng Jianyong joked, "This Elf King, won’t he scare Brother Xing away because of the marriage proposal?"
Everyone couldn’t help but chuckle.
Han Xing nodded, "He didn’t mention the marriage, just said that the materials from last time are ready."
Last time, Han Xing traded with the Elf King for 130,000 pieces of Ancient Spirit Wood.
In exchange, the Elf King was to provide them with a batch of particularly valuable materials.
Everyone nodded in understanding.
Since parting with the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots, Han Xing realized his current power was still insufficient.
Therefore, he needed more resources to enhance his strength.
Thinking about this, Han Xing kept the Ten Thousand Stars City in place.
He controlled the Oracle Throne and headed to the Elf Realm.
An hour later.
On a Sky Island near the World Tree, Han Xing and the others found the Elf King.
Compared to a few days ago, the Elf King looked less worried.
Now, he seemed in better spirits.
Since the last meeting, where the strong individuals stood up, the Elf King had more confidence to deal with the Abyss Realm.
Seeing Han Xing, the Elf King had a kind smile on his face.
He appeared to be an honest person.
However, after seeing the Elf King’s true colors, Han Xing and the others no longer believed him to be an honest person.
Seeing Han Xing and the others approach, the Elf King smiled and said, "Saint Master Han Xing, sorry to trouble you to come here."
"Last time, the items I promised you have been prepared."
After speaking, the Elf King waved his hand.
Dozens of chests placed on both sides of the palace opened up.
In an instant, a strong wave of divine power dispersed.
In those chests, Han Xing saw a large number of Ancient Elf Secret Ingots, Thunder Divine Stones, Extreme Ice Divine Stones, and more.
According to Han Xing’s exchange rate at the time.
Ordinary Divine Stones were exchanged at a rate of 100 for 1 piece of Ancient Spirit Wood.
