chapters.title: Chapter 795 - 438: Defense Tower Expansion, Divine Demon Battleship Completed!
paragraphs: And the Ancient Elf Secret Ingot is exchanged at a rate of 20 per piece of Ancient Spirit Wood.
As for the Chaos Divine Stone and Calamity Divine Gold, the Elf King did not present them this time.
Materials of this level are rare even for the Elf Race.
However, Han Xing didn’t care much about that.
Because the materials in front of him were already enough to make Han Xing pleasantly surprised!
What he needed was a large amount of Divine Stones.
The Elf King, this time, could be said to have alleviated Han Xing’s urgent need.
Besides these familiar Divine Stones, in other large boxes, Han Xing also saw a pure white, magnet-like metal.
"Your Majesty the Elf King, what is this?" Han Xing asked.
The Elf King smiled and said, "Waveless Metal, the one you mentioned last time, I specifically had people exchange some from the major races."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing’s expression immediately became serious.
He still lacked the materials to build the last type of Calamity Defense Tower: Fury Heart Storm.
What he needed was Waveless Metal.
These boxes of materials from the Elf King could be said to have brought Han Xing precisely what he needed most.
In his heart, his impression of this somewhat scheming individual improved greatly.
The Elf King then said, "Saint Master Han Xing, these metals were exchanged according to your previous rates."
"Do you need to check the quantity?"
Han Xing smiled, "No need for that."
With that said, he waved his hand, and Han Xing stored all the materials into his pack.
A system prompt appeared.
[Obtained [Extreme Ice Divine Stone]*2 million, [Thunder Divine Stone]*3 million, [Waveless Metal]*6 million, [Ancient Elf Secret Ingot]*100,000.]
Han Xing didn’t need to count; the system would mark out the quantities of materials for him.
Luckily, the Elf King didn’t withhold materials from him, and the quantities were sufficient.
Seeing so many materials, all of which he urgently needed, Han Xing was filled with excitement!
According to the construction requirements of those Calamity Towers.
This round, Han Xing could at least build hundreds of Calamity Defense Towers!
His strength would greatly increase.
Previously, the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots said his territory’s firepower could barely scratch a True God.
However, after Han Xing’s current surge.
He would truly have the power to heavily wound a True God.
Thinking about this, Han Xing was invigorated!
Han Xing cupped his hands, "Thank you, Your Majesty the Elf King!"
However, the Elf King smiled and said, "What are you thanking me for? We’ll all be family in the future anyway."
Hearing this, Han Xing didn’t feel awkward like before.
Ever since Zhang Lianmeng had confessed her true feelings to him, Han Xing had come to terms with it.
Thus, Han Xing asked, "Your Majesty the Elf King, how is the Divine Maiden doing recently?"
Hearing Han Xing mention it, the Elf King’s eyes brightened.

chapters.title: Chapter 796 - 438: Defense Tower Expansion, Divine Demon Battleship Completed!
paragraphs: Han Xing shook his head; obviously, such opportunities are rare and hard to come by.
The locations of the divine treasures are extremely concealed.
And the Ancient Ruins are not open yet.
For a moment, Han Xing really couldn’t find a good place to go to.
Moreover, before the danger in the Abyss Realm is resolved, Han Xing can’t run too far.
Although the Elf King hasn’t restricted the actions of various clans, if one leaves too far, and the Abyss Realm suddenly invades, there would be no way to respond immediately.
Time flew by, and a week had passed.
During this week, the invasion frequency of the Abyss Realm gradually began to increase.
This conveyed a signal to the mighty warriors.
That is, the invasion from the Abyss Realm is far from over.
On this day,
Near Han Xing’s Sky Island, appeared a massive object with a completely black and red body, measuring 1632 kilometers in length and 74 kilometers in width!
(Adjusted the size of the battleship, from 174 kilometers in length to 1632 kilometers; previous Chapters were locked and couldn’t be modified, sincere apologies to the readers!)
A pair of demon horns stood proudly on the towering bow, and at the stern was a menacing face of a six-eyed demon.
Hundreds of gunports lined both sides of the battleship, showcasing its terrifying firepower.
Especially the demon cannons, each over two kilometers in diameter, mounted at the front and back, which are truly intimidating!
This is the latest top technological creation from the Abyss Realm: the Divine Demon Battleship, crafted by Han Xing.
Its appearance is, quite simply, the ultimate fusion of technology and magic!
"This battleship is so cool!"
"The look, the design, the firepower strength, I’m in love!"
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed endlessly, "Thanks to Brother Xing, I fulfilled my dream of piloting a battleship!"
Shen Yun rolled her eyes at him, "Since when was your dream to pilot a battleship?"
Cheng Jianyong replied earnestly, "To be honest, when I was a kid, my dream was to pilot a mecha."
"But now, I think piloting a battleship is cooler, hahaha!"
Everyone looked at him, speechless.
Not only Cheng Jianyong, even Han Xing was very pleased looking at this Divine Demon Battleship.
It features an appearance full of Abyss Realm characteristics, and its firepower is very powerful.
Even without the Sun Crown Stele’s amplification, its two main cannons are enough to harm ordinary divine spirits.
Moreover, it can also be equipped with hundreds of advanced cannon towers, such as the Godslaying Cannon, Dark Energy Cannon, Frozen Star Cannon, etc.
However, Han Xing didn’t equip these cannons on it.
Because compared to being mounted on the battleship, keeping them in Ten Thousand Stars City is safer.
After all, in Ten Thousand Stars City, they can benefit from the Sun Crown Stele’s enhancement.
At this moment, Shen Yun sat directly on the deck, looking at Han Xing, "Brother Xing, I remember this battleship has a teleportation function covering ten million kilometers!"
"One jump almost equals the distance we used to travel in a day, doesn’t it?"
Han Xing nodded, "Indeed, and this teleportation ability only has a 500-second cooldown, it’s quite absurd."
Shen Yun marveled, "It truly is a divine-level battleship; its maneuverability is almost no different from a real divine spirit."
Everyone else nodded in agreement.
After all, even the Oracle Throne’s group teleportation only spans one million kilometers.
And the Divine Demon Battleship’s teleportation is at least ten times that distance.
At this, Cheng Jianyong, hearing Shen Yun mention divine-level mobility, seemed to recall something.
Suddenly, he said, "Right, Brother Xing, since this battleship’s mobility is so absurd,"
"Shouldn’t we take advantage of the calm in the Abyss Realm now and make a trip to Crystal Mountain and the Monsoon Islands to grab the remaining two divine formats?"
Hearing this, Han Xing also fell into contemplation.
Clearly, the Divine Demon Battleship grants them divine-level mobility, enough for them to traverse extremely vast distances in a short time.
However, if they took the battleship, they couldn’t bring Ten Thousand Stars City with them.
This might pose some security risks.
However, even without Ten Thousand Stars City, the Divine Demon Battleship is enough to deal with ordinary divine spirits.
And even if they couldn’t win, Han Xing still had the Giant Beast Tail Spike as a deadly weapon.
Thinking of this, Han Xing said directly, "We can, let’s first make a trip to Crystal Mountain."
"Hooray!" The team cheered in unison.
They indeed wanted to go out and explore.
They also wanted to see Zhang Lianmeng’s changes after breaking through to demigod!
After all, she is the first demigod among the Survivors!
Han Xing continued, "The distance to Crystal Mountain from here would require about 50 teleportations to reach."
"Counting our round trip and the time to retrieve the divine formats, about a day should suffice."
"However, if any unexpected events occur in the Elf Realm, we must return as quickly as possible."
Hearing this, everyone simultaneously nodded.
Compared to those two divine formats, preventing the invasion of Abyss Demons is more important.
At this point, Han Xing said, "Let’s go, enter the battleship."
"The energy fluctuations during teleportation are intense; it would be uncomfortable for us outside."
Everyone nodded.
Then, on the expansive deck, they found the battleship’s entrance and went inside together.
After crossing a long staircase, a massive space emerged inside.
The Divine Demon Battleship’s immense size, over a thousand kilometers, meant its interior space was massive.
Moving with several hundred thousand people together wouldn’t be a problem.
As soon as Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun entered, they were amazed by the facilities inside.
There were numerous nutrition cabins and various large instruments, exuding a tech-centric vibe.
It’s just that the appearance of these instruments was somewhat sinister.
Shen Yun exclaimed, "I always thought the Abyss Realm demons only knew how to kill and destroy."
"But now it seems their technological level isn’t weak either."
Everyone nodded.
However, thinking about it, this was normal.
After all, the Abyss Realm is a complete world, with an energy tier higher than the one where the Insects reside.
Having this level of technology is not surprising.

chapters.title: Chapter 797 - 439: Entering Teleportation State...
paragraphs: The team members moved around inside the battleship.
They touched here and looked there.
Compared to the battleship images they had seen in movies and animations before, this all felt a bit unreal.
But now, they were physically touching this powerful technological creation.
The excitement in everyone’s hearts was imaginable.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun were studying the instruments.
Meanwhile, Han Xing began studying the interior map of the battleship.
Yes, the battleship also had a small map inside.
It was divided into living areas, rest areas, training areas, etc...
Obviously, this battleship not only had strong firepower but also well-equipped living facilities.
With enough supplies, hundreds of thousands of people could live in it for years without any problems.
If it really came to the end of the world, this battleship could even take a group of humans and escape into the Void.
Thinking of this, Han Xing quickly interrupted his thoughts.
"It’s better not to think about these things, I don’t want to really live a life of exile."
Then Han Xing quickly found the location of the control room on the battleship map.
Looking at the team members still wandering around, Han Xing said, "Let’s go and check out the control room."
The team members, hearing this, came over one after another.
Then they all proceeded to the front section of the battleship.
A few minutes later, they opened a pitch-black Demon door, revealing a large space inside.
This was where the battleship’s control room was located.
The space inside was large, with several projection screens above everyone’s heads.
Covering the entire inside and outside of the battleship in 360 degrees without any blind spots.
Everyone was dumbfounded by this dense array of projection screens!
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed: "Wow... this is too cool!"
"This is what I imagined the inside of a battleship would look like!"
"It’s brimming with technology!
However, Shen Yun looked at those projection devices and pondered: "Looking at it like this, there really isn’t any private space inside this battleship."
Cheng Jianyong scoffed: "The Abyss Realm created this battleship for war; who cares about your personal privacy."
Everyone nodded; after all, they weren’t living inside the battleship.
Compared to the guys, Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang were more interested in those control panels.
The curiosity in their hearts drove them to want to press the dense array of buttons.
Of course, they knew that operating a battleship was extremely complex and shouldn’t be messed with.
At this time, Cheng Jianyong and the others came over as well.
Looking at the control panel buttons, everyone exchanged glances.
"Xiaoyunzi, do you know how to operate a battleship?"
"I don’t. Brother Xing, do you?"
Han Xing shrugged, "I have a C1 driver’s license, but I don’t know how to operate a battleship."
Everyone rolled their eyes.
Is this even the same thing?

Cheng Jianyong said, somewhat frustrated, "This is a problem now. With so many buttons inside the battleship and none of us knowing how to operate it, does that mean this battleship can’t be started?"
Just when everyone was a little confused, a system prompt appeared in front of Han Xing.
[Detected Divine Demon Battleship holder: Han Xing has entered, battleship control interface activated...]
The prompt dissipated.
A battleship control interface appeared in front of Han Xing.
Similar to the control interface in those flight simulation computer games.
The operation methods on it were simple, with functions for moving up, down, left, and right, as well as high-speed rotation, sidestepping, firing, teleportation, and invisibility.
Yes, this battleship even had an optical invisibility function.
Although it could only deceive some weaker beings, there was no energy fluctuation on the battleship before it was started.
This meant that even if strong beings sensed the battleship’s existence, they wouldn’t pay much attention to it.
Apart from this, the battleship could be divided into: automatic mode, semi-automatic mode, and manual mode.
Each mode had its own differences.
In automatic mode, you set a target, and the battleship can move, avoid attacks, fight, etc., on its own.
In semi-automatic mode, you can assist and make adjustments at any time during the battleship’s automatic attack.
Manual mode relies entirely on your own operation.
After reading the introduction on the operation interface, Han Xing had a look of understanding in his eyes.
"I see, this operation interface is quite convenient."
"Moreover, it can be operated using Divine Power without the need to go hands-on."
Han Xing released Divine Power and tried to touch the forward function.
"Rumble!"
The massive battleship started moving smoothly without any delay.
Han Xing showed a pleased expression.
He continued to test other functions.
Including high-speed rotation, sidestepping, charging, and other actions...
Just like moving, the operation was unbelievably smooth.
The team members watched Han Xing’s actions curiously and noticed that the battleship had already started moving.
Sparks of anticipation appeared in their eyes.
After familiarizing himself for a while, Han Xing nodded in satisfaction and said, "This is quite handy."
"Moreover, I can also grant control permissions to all of you."
Upon hearing this, Cheng Jianyong directly cheered.
This meant everyone could control the battleship.
Han Xing opened up the access, and the team members began to control it one by one.
Throughout the control room, their exclamations could be heard from time to time.
The massive Divine Demon Battleship continued to change its movements in the air, even capable of executing complex maneuvers like the Thomas spin.
Half an hour later, everyone had enjoyed a thrill by controlling the battleship.

In automatic mode, you set a target, and the battleship can move, avoid attacks, fight, etc., on its own.
In semi-automatic mode, you can assist and make adjustments at any time during the battleship’s automatic attack.
Manual mode relies entirely on your own operation.
After reading the introduction on the operation interface, Han Xing had a look of understanding in his eyes.
"I see, this operation interface is quite convenient."
"Moreover, it can be operated using Divine Power without the need to go hands-on."
Han Xing released Divine Power and tried to touch the forward function.
"Rumble!"
The massive battleship started moving smoothly without any delay.
Han Xing showed a pleased expression.
He continued to test other functions.
Including high-speed rotation, sidestepping, charging, and other actions...
Just like moving, the operation was unbelievably smooth.
The team members watched Han Xing’s actions curiously and noticed that the battleship had already started moving.
Sparks of anticipation appeared in their eyes.
After familiarizing himself for a while, Han Xing nodded in satisfaction and said, "This is quite handy."
"Moreover, I can also grant control permissions to all of you."
Upon hearing this, Cheng Jianyong directly cheered.
This meant everyone could control the battleship.
Han Xing opened up the access, and the team members began to control it one by one.
Throughout the control room, their exclamations could be heard from time to time.
The massive Divine Demon Battleship continued to change its movements in the air, even capable of executing complex maneuvers like the Thomas spin.
Half an hour later, everyone had enjoyed a thrill by controlling the battleship.

chapters.title: Chapter 798 - 439: Entering Teleportation State..._2
paragraphs: Han Xing said, "Alright, while the frequency of Abyss Realm invasions isn’t high right now, let’s make a trip to Crystal Mountain first."
"Then hurry back."
The team members nodded in agreement.
After Han Xing took over the control authority.
He directly set the target to head towards Crystal Mountain, billions of kilometers away.
"Buzz!"
The battleship’s energy system started, then it accelerated rapidly.
"Swoosh!"
The massive battleship turned into a stream of light and quickly disappeared from its original location.
Even without using the teleportation function, the Divine Demon Battleship can achieve movement speeds of a high-tier demigod level.
Everyone sat inside the battleship, marveling at the rapidly receding scenery on the projection screen.
At this moment, a voice broadcast came on inside the battleship.
"Would you like to switch to scene virtual mode?"
Everyone in the cockpit heard this system prompt.
Cheng Jianyong, with an incredulous expression, said, "Scene virtual, is it what I imagine?"
Everyone’s faces were filled with anticipation.
Han Xing directly selected ’Yes’.
In the next moment, in front of everyone, the scene of the control room disappeared.
They felt as if they were directly in mid-air in the Holy Spirit Realm.
"Whoa... this function is so cool!"
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed excitedly, "I’ve really made it in life, actually sitting on a battleship of this level!"
Looking at the rapidly receding Sky Islands of the Elf Realm, the group was in awe.
Because this feeling was no different from piloting a Sky Island forward.
Han Xing chuckled, "Alright, this high-tier demigod level speed is still far from enough."
"Get ready, we’re about to initiate teleportation."
Everyone’s expression turned serious simultaneously.
Teleportation is different in principle from a teleportation array.
So the sensation is also different.
In the next moment, Han Xing directly activated the teleportation function.
The voice broadcast prompt appeared.
"Preparing for teleportation, countdown: five seconds before teleportation starts..."
"Five...
"Four..."
Buzz!
In the battleship core, the Demon God’s Heart began absorbing heaven and earth energy at full power.
The rapidly traveling Divine Demon Battleship became incredibly phantom-like.
As if it were about to vanish from this space.
That area even had waves of spatial ripples.
When the countdown hit zero.
The Divine Demon Battleship instantly disappeared.
Inside the battleship, Han Xing and the others felt as if they had entered a tunnel of time and space.
All around were black and gray lines, and within these lines, they could even see scenes rapidly receding.
Everything seemed to fold together.
It felt like a second had passed, or perhaps a year.
When they appeared again.
The surrounding scene had changed once more.
The mini map showed they had left the Elf Realm.
The five of them took a deep breath simultaneously.
The energy compression felt during teleportation left them breathless.
It took a while to recover.
"We really made it out!"
Cheng Jianyong marveled, "The distance of this teleportation is truly ridiculous!"
In just a few seconds, they traversed over ten million kilometers, truly ridiculous.
Han Xing became increasingly satisfied with this Divine Demon Battleship.
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly thought, "If the Abyss Realm sent a few more Demon Gods, it would be great."
"I could remove all the Demon God’s Hearts from them, and then I could build a few more battleships."
After exiting teleportation mode.
The Divine Demon Battleship resumed steady forward travel mode.
Then, it was a matter of waiting for a 500-second cooldown to end.
Han Xing proceeded with the teleportation action again.
Each activation caused that area of space to fluctuate violently.
Time passed slowly.
Very soon, seven hours went by.
Along the way, they conducted nearly 50 teleportations.
Traversing countless billions of kilometers.
Also passing through many racial territories.
But due to the invisibility function of the Divine Demon Battleship, only demigod level entities could spot the battleship.
However, before they could come out to check, Han Xing was already piloting the Demon God far away.
After all, the movement speed of a high-tier demigod level is no joke.
In the entire Holy Spirit Realm, there aren’t many high-tier demigods.
Moreover, since this is wartime, most of the strong have gone to the Elf Realm.
Thus, Han Xing and the others had an unobstructed journey.
Upon completing their 51st teleportation, the scene in front of them suddenly changed.
From the previous cloud-covered Sky Islands.
They arrived in an area filled with tawny Sky Islands.
On those Sky Islands stood mountain ranges with crystal-like tawny hues.
System prompt appeared.
[You have successfully reached the new area: Crystal Mountain, World Influence +67, Legendary Points +5.]
The group exchanged smiles.
"We’ve finally arrived," Cheng Jianyong sighed.
Meanwhile, Han Xing also piloted the battleship, withdrawing from the rapid advance mode and switching to a steady flight mode.
In this mode, the maximum movement speed is about the same as a middle-tier legend.
Quickly, they approached the first tawny Crystal Sky Island.
There was no cloud cover, indicating this Sky Island had already been conquered.
Yet, they found no living creatures on it.
Cheng Jianyong asked at this moment, "Brother Xing, there should be living races here at Crystal Mountain, right?"
Han Xing shook his head, "I’m not sure."
The group was momentarily stunned, "Even Brother Xing doesn’t know?"
Han Xing nodded, "Yes, based on the data I’ve collected,"
"Other regions have civilizations and races that communicate with the outside world."
"However, Crystal Mountain and the Monsoon Islands do have life, but they refuse to communicate with the outside world."

chapters.title: Chapter 799 - 439: Entering Teleportation State..._3
paragraphs: "This time, even the Elf Race did not send strong warriors to support when faced with the Abyss Realm invasion, neither Crystal Mountain nor the Monsoon Islands."
"I’m worried there might be danger inside, so previously, I’ve placed these two regions at the very end."
Everyone nodded in understanding.
Shen Yun pondered, "Then this time, we should have a chance to explore the real situation of Crystal Mountain and the Monsoon Islands."
"Ignoring such an important event as the Abyss Realm invasion, what exactly are these guys planning?"
Han Xing nodded.
They jumped straight out of the warship, landing on the massive Sky Island.
In front of them were numerous small hills, each standing a hundred meters tall.
These hills seemed to be a unique feature of Crystal Mountain, looking just like transparent crystals, in keeping with its name.
However, despite having arrived on the Sky Island, they still saw no signs of life.
"It’s a bit strange, where have all the creatures of Crystal Mountain gone?"
Cheng Jianyong asked suspiciously.
Han Xing thought for a moment and directly released his Divine Power to explore the Sky Island.
It seemed his Divine Power disturbed something.
In the next moment, Han Xing and his companions heard a series of thunderous noises.
"Rumble!"
The entire Crystal Mountain shook violently.
At the same time, to Han Xing’s surprise, all those small hills stood up!
From these hills, they could feel intense life waves.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed in shock, "Wow... so these small hills are actually the creatures of Crystal Mountain?"
These small hills, when they remained inactive, really looked like ordinary mountains with no signs of life.
But now, it’s as if they have collectively awakened.
In the blink of an eye, they transformed into bear-like creatures towering at a hundred meters, with no fur, appearing as if made of earthy-yellow crystals.
"Bears?" Everyone asked in confusion.
At this moment, the earthy-yellow giant bears, which were integrated with the ground, all turned their gaze towards them.
Han Xing and his companions saw pairs of blood-red eyes.
[Divine Creation: Bear Spirit Form]: Lord-level creatures.
[Level]: 53
[Attributes]: Power 17241, Agility 13423, Spirit 19231, Constitution 21321
[Skills]: Crystal Body, Giant Mountain Strike, Earth Domain.
These bear-like creatures generally possessed considerable strength.
None were below Tier Five.
Underneath them followed a large group of crystal bear cubs, each only a few dozen centimeters tall.
Compared to the giant bears, these cubs seemed like miniatures, mere ornaments.
They clumsily extended their chubby legs, trying to climb up the legs of the giant bears, as if wanting to reach their backs.
However, perhaps due to the smoothness of the giant bears’ crystal bodies.
The cubs could only climb a few meters before tumbling down, landing on their butts on the ground.
At this moment, little stars appeared in the eyes of the two young girls in the group.
"So... so cute..."
Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang instinctively wanted to approach the bear cubs.
And just then, a dull roar sounded.
"Roar!"
It was as if something was rushing towards them at high speed, causing the ground to tremble violently.
From the sound, the group could discern the power of a high-tier Legendary Level.
Although this level of power seemed insufficient for them, they still entered a combat state!
"Boom! Boom!"
Sounds like artillery shells exploding emerged.
In the next moment, they saw a distant earthy-yellow figure leaping high and landing right in front of Han Xing and his companions.
"Boom!!!"
It was as if a nuclear bomb had hit, the violent shockwave even lifted all the bear cubs over a meter high.
They fearfully grasped onto the feet of the large bears.
Meanwhile.
In front of Han Xing appeared a crystal giant bear standing several kilometers tall!
[Divine Creation: Bear Spirit Form (High-tier Legend)]
[Level]: 58
[Attributes]: Power 47239, Agility 32993, Spirit 27312, Constitution 35232.
[Skills]: Power Burst, Power Form, Crystal Body, Crystal Domain, World-Ending Fury!
This was a purely power-based creature, like the other Bear Spirits, possessing extremely terrifying attributes.
However, these attributes seemed inadequate for the group.
At this moment, the high-tier Legendary Level giant bear seemed to realize the group wasn’t to be messed with either.
It continuously emitted low, threatening growls.
Yet, aside from growling, the giant bear didn’t attack them.
It sensed the intimidating nature of these humans.
Han Xing attempted to communicate with these crystal giant bears using Divine Spirit.
However, Han Xing’s Divine Power seemingly vanished without a trace, receiving no response at all.
Han Xing frowned, "No response to Divine Power?"
It was his first time encountering a creature in the Holy Spirit Realm that couldn’t be communicated with using Divine Power.
Han Xing tried to move a few steps closer.
Only to see the giant bear tense its limbs, adopting a combat stance directly.
As if any further approach would lead it to attack without hesitation.
"Roar... Roar..."
The giant bear issued a series of threatening low growls.
Of course, Han Xing ignored it and continued moving closer.
The crystal giant bear opened its mouth and let out a roar even more terrifying than before.
"Boom!!!"
The horrifying sound waves rippled out, and if it were any ordinary Legendary Powerhouse, just hearing it would cause their blood to boil and heart to race.
Even leading to violent death!
However, Han Xing and his companions felt nothing at all.
They exchanged glances.
Shen Yun spoke with some concern, "Brother Xing, this is a bit troublesome."
"The creatures here cannot communicate, and if we forcibly take the Divine Format, they might try to stop us."
Everyone realized this as well.
By then, if conflict arises due to the Divine Format, it would inevitably lead to more bloodshed.

chapters.title: Chapter 800 - 440: Go Slap It Twice
paragraphs: Everyone realized that a bloody event might happen next.
Cheng Jianyong’s gaze darkened as he sternly said, "Brother Xing, let me handle it."
He picked up his weapon and assumed an attack stance.
A fierce aura burst from his body!
The crowd understood Cheng Jianyong’s intention.
Since the creatures here couldn’t communicate, he would be the bad guy.
He would directly kill all obstacles and forcibly take the Divine Format.
Han Xing shook his head and said, "I’ll go try first."
"If it’s truly impossible to communicate, we’ll consider other methods."
After speaking, Han Xing continued to take a few steps forward.
However, this action seemed to completely enrage the Crystal Giant Bear.
It suddenly stood upright, its two gigantic bear paws glowing with an earthy yellow light, crazily pounding its chest!
"Boom! Boom! Boom!!!"
With each pound, the bear’s Power increased by a few degrees, seemingly on the verge of breaking through the Legendary Limit.
Han Xing glanced at the bear and said, "You’re too noisy; let your kind teach you what quiet means."
As he spoke, he raised his Bow and Arrow.
Then, a terrifying roar sounded.
"Roar!!!"
In front of everyone, an enormous creature appeared, covered entirely in snow-white fur and several thousand meters tall!
The moment the massive creature appeared, a terrifying aura far exceeding a regular demigod, directly reaching the Middle-tier Demigod Level, emerged.
Like a true prehistoric beast, the ferocious aura immediately left the upright Crystal Giant Bear momentarily dazed.
This enormous creature was none other than one of Han Xing’s Legendary Skills: Bear Spirit Gangtu.
Having inherited 150% of Han Xing’s Attributes, Bear Spirit Gangtu’s momentum had already surpassed that of a typical middle-tier demigod.
At this moment.
The two bear species faced each other.
The Crystal Giant Bear seemed to feel the waves of threat emanating from Bear Spirit Gangtu.
Yet it refused to be intimidated, continuing to pound its chest and roar incessantly.
Han Xing looked at Bear Spirit Gangtu and said, "Make it shut up."
Bear Spirit Gangtu understood.
The next moment, its eyes turned completely red.
At the same time, a killing intent resembling a primordial beast suddenly locked onto the Crystal Giant Bear.
Under the shroud of that killing intent, the Crystal Giant Bear felt like a helpless cub, utterly unable to resist.
And when Bear Spirit Gangtu opened its gigantic mouth.
A terrifying roar echoed for miles around.
"Roar!!!"
This roar was dozens of times stronger than the Crystal Giant Bear’s and carried an aura of majesty.
The surrounding crystal mountain ranges shattered completely, exploding into powder!
Especially the Legendary Giant Bear, which received Bear Spirit Gangtu’s focused attention.
Everyone saw that under the pressure, the ground beneath the Crystal Giant Bear’s paw was covered in numerous cracks.
Yet it stubbornly held its ground, refusing to yield.
It even tried to struggle to stand up and fight Bear Spirit Gangtu to the end.
Bear Spirit Gangtu seemed to lose patience.
At this moment, its gargantuan body vanished from its spot.
Having inherited 150% of Han Xing’s Attributes, its agility now approached 200,000!
Even regular middle-tier demigods couldn’t match its agility.
Before the Crystal Giant Bear reacted.
A fan-like huge bear paw suddenly appeared in front of it.
Then, a muffled slapping sound occurred.
"Boom!"
Bear Spirit Gangtu used about half its strength with the slap.
But it still sent the mountain-sized body of the Crystal Giant Bear flying, spinning several times in the air before crashing down.
"Boom!
The Crystal Giant Bear’s body created a giant crater over ten thousand meters wide.
Meanwhile, the small bear cubs nearby were completely stupefied.
Watching their leader get slapped away by another bear.
Their eyes lost their light as they sat down directly, whimpering sadly.
"Whimper... Whimper..."
On the ground, the Legendary Giant Bear seemed dazed by Bear Spirit Gangtu’s slap.
Laying in the giant crater, it didn’t respond for quite a while.
When Han Xing walked over, the giant bear no longer extended its paw towards everyone, staying silent.
Seeing this, the team members’ eyes lit up.
Cheng Jianyong joked, "As expected, dealing with these unrefined, uncommunicative creatures, it’s more efficient to use brute force."
Han Xing said little.
As they prepared to approach further, a deep voice suddenly came to their ears.
"Who are you? Why are you attacking me?"
At this moment, everyone stopped in their tracks, suddenly realizing something.
Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but curse, "You damn well could communicate, huh?"
The Crystal Giant Bear said nothing, appearing to be reserved with words.
Han Xing asked, "Are you a race that lives in the Crystal Mountain?"
A wave of Divine Power emanated from the giant bear once more.
"I asked first, and you haven’t told me why you attacked me!"
Han Xing furrowed his brow.
No need for words from it.
Bear Spirit Gangtu directly grabbed the Crystal Giant Bear’s head and smacked it twice.
"Boom! Boom!"
The Crystal Giant Bear’s sight sparkled, its form swaying.
The nearby bears saw their leader get slapped and dared not approach.
Only after over ten seconds did the Legendary Giant Bear recover from its daze.
At that moment, Han Xing asked again, "I’ll ask you one more time, are you a race that lives in the Crystal Mountain?"

The moment the massive creature appeared, a terrifying aura far exceeding a regular demigod, directly reaching the Middle-tier Demigod Level, emerged.
Like a true prehistoric beast, the ferocious aura immediately left the upright Crystal Giant Bear momentarily dazed.
This enormous creature was none other than one of Han Xing’s Legendary Skills: Bear Spirit Gangtu.
Having inherited 150% of Han Xing’s Attributes, Bear Spirit Gangtu’s momentum had already surpassed that of a typical middle-tier demigod.
At this moment.
The two bear species faced each other.
The Crystal Giant Bear seemed to feel the waves of threat emanating from Bear Spirit Gangtu.
Yet it refused to be intimidated, continuing to pound its chest and roar incessantly.
Han Xing looked at Bear Spirit Gangtu and said, "Make it shut up."
Bear Spirit Gangtu understood.
The next moment, its eyes turned completely red.
At the same time, a killing intent resembling a primordial beast suddenly locked onto the Crystal Giant Bear.
Under the shroud of that killing intent, the Crystal Giant Bear felt like a helpless cub, utterly unable to resist.
And when Bear Spirit Gangtu opened its gigantic mouth.
A terrifying roar echoed for miles around.
"Roar!!!"
This roar was dozens of times stronger than the Crystal Giant Bear’s and carried an aura of majesty.
The surrounding crystal mountain ranges shattered completely, exploding into powder!
Especially the Legendary Giant Bear, which received Bear Spirit Gangtu’s focused attention.
Everyone saw that under the pressure, the ground beneath the Crystal Giant Bear’s paw was covered in numerous cracks.
Yet it stubbornly held its ground, refusing to yield.
It even tried to struggle to stand up and fight Bear Spirit Gangtu to the end.
Bear Spirit Gangtu seemed to lose patience.
At this moment, its gargantuan body vanished from its spot.
Having inherited 150% of Han Xing’s Attributes, its agility now approached 200,000!
Even regular middle-tier demigods couldn’t match its agility.
Before the Crystal Giant Bear reacted.
A fan-like huge bear paw suddenly appeared in front of it.
Then, a muffled slapping sound occurred.
"Boom!"
Bear Spirit Gangtu used about half its strength with the slap.
But it still sent the mountain-sized body of the Crystal Giant Bear flying, spinning several times in the air before crashing down.
"Boom!
The Crystal Giant Bear’s body created a giant crater over ten thousand meters wide.
Meanwhile, the small bear cubs nearby were completely stupefied.
Watching their leader get slapped away by another bear.
Their eyes lost their light as they sat down directly, whimpering sadly.
"Whimper...
Whimper..."
On the ground, the Legendary Giant Bear seemed dazed by Bear Spirit Gangtu’s slap.
Laying in the giant crater, it didn’t respond for quite a while.
When Han Xing walked over, the giant bear no longer extended its paw towards everyone, staying silent.
Seeing this, the team members’ eyes lit up.
Cheng Jianyong joked, "As expected, dealing with these unrefined, uncommunicative creatures, it’s more efficient to use brute force."
Han Xing said little.
As they prepared to approach further, a deep voice suddenly came to their ears.
"Who are you?
Why are you attacking me?"
At this moment, everyone stopped in their tracks, suddenly realizing something.
Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but curse, "You damn well could communicate, huh?"
The Crystal Giant Bear said nothing, appearing to be reserved with words.
Han Xing asked, "Are you a race that lives in the Crystal Mountain?"
A wave of Divine Power emanated from the giant bear once more.
"I asked first, and you haven’t told me why you attacked me!"
Han Xing furrowed his brow.
No need for words from it.
Bear Spirit Gangtu directly grabbed the Crystal Giant Bear’s head and smacked it twice.
"Boom!
Boom!"
The Crystal Giant Bear’s sight sparkled, its form swaying.
The nearby bears saw their leader get slapped and dared not approach.
Only after over ten seconds did the Legendary Giant Bear recover from its daze.
At that moment, Han Xing asked again, "I’ll ask you one more time, are you a race that lives in the Crystal Mountain?"
